bluejetty:00185926:ios.description:
Epic 64-voice Virtual Analog / PCM iPad Synth
Inspired by the Digital Synths of the 80s and 90s
- ** TOP 3 iOS MUSIC APPS OF 2018 *** - Music Radar Awards
(Computer Music & Future Music Magazine)
- * Featured By Apple in "New Apps We Love!" **
"Fans of the D-50, JD-990, 01/W, Wavestation... Rejoice!" - Music Radar
FULLY LOADED w/ 500+ presets by Brice Beasley, Matthew Fecher, Red Sky Lullaby, Jakob Haq, Dean Daughters (Electronisounds), Sound of Izrael, Brian Funk, and more
DIGITAL D1 is AWESOME:
- 64-voice Hybrid Digital Poly Synthesis.
- Full 1+ Gigabyte of original samples recorded from analog & fm synths over 30+ years old
- Stand-alone iPad Synth, plus IAA & Audiobus
- Basic AUv3 Plugin support. Works best with AUM. We're working on upgrading Audio Unit support.
- Space-saving Compression - The whole app is under 200mb!
- Dual layers per voice. Keyboard splits. Velocity Scaling.
- Vintage-style Arp/Step Sequencer that can be routed to specific layers.
- 3 LFOs. Fun Routings. LFOs can modify other LFOs.
- Dual Independent per-Layer filters
- Plus, per-voice Harmonic key-tracked Envelope filters.
"Digital D1 Sounds and plays AMAZING!" - The Sound Test Room
"Rad retro synth sounds" - Cult of Mac, App of the Week
"AudioKit Digital D1 is a beautiful Synthesizer app that recreates the spirit of legendary synths" - Synth Anatomy
ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
- FX: Glorious Reverb, Phaser, Digital Delay, Distortion, Flanger, Chorus, Crush, and more.
- Perfect with a MIDI Keyboard
- Ableton Link
- All kinds of awesome stuff
- The Sound. Oh, the sound. You won't believe it.
"Digital D1 synth is pure ‘80s and ‘90s digital lushness" - Computer Music/Music Radar
"Beautiful. Lush. Modern and Amazing… An Instant Classic."
REQUIREMENTS:
Requires newer iPads for best performance. May be slow on iPad 4.
IAA is being deprecated by Apple in iOS 13. We're moving to AUv3 as well. Please replace IAA with AUv3 in your projects.
GarageBand Audio Unit (AUv3):
You can run one instance of D1 as an AUv3 in GarageBand. With a host like AUM, you can run 3 or more instances at once.

For iPad 4 - Open the "Settings" button (to the upper left above the keyboard). Turn the buffer to 512 or above. And turn the "CPU Efficient" toggle to on. If still having trouble, try closing other music apps and/or rebooting your iPad. Thanks!

bluejetty:00063580:ios.description:
Nothing to fan over today? Turn your bias photos into cross stitch.
K-POP STARPIC is the all-in-one K-pop fandom app — stitch your favorite
star's photo, share it with fans worldwide, and vote for your bias.

Those bias photos sleeping in your gallery? They deserve better.
Upload a photo and it becomes a stitch pattern — pick a size, fill in the colors.
Stitch away, and before you know it, your bias is complete.
Every last pixel, memorized. The most immersive way to stan.
▶ A fandom feed built around your bias
Set your bias and their photos and posts gather in your feed.
Any HD photo shared by fans can become your next stitch pattern.
Your people are already here.
▶ Today's No.1? You decide.
Vote for your favorite members and groups to push them up the rankings.
Watching your votes carry your bias to the top — nothing beats it.
▶ When support becomes a real gift
Every month, the birthday vote TOP3 leads to a donation made in that star's name.
Your vote becomes a good deed in your bias's name. That's true fandom.
▶ Hearts, and plenty of them
3,000 hearts just for signing up.
Stack more with daily check-ins, earn extra by watching ads,
plus streak bonuses. Easy to collect, fun to spend.
▶ On the subway, on a plane
Once started, your cross stitch works offline too.
Save finished pieces to your gallery and show them off on social media.
Supports both phones and tablets.

Rights and responsibilities for posts belong to the member who posted them.
Content violating laws or third-party rights, or subject to a rights holder's
request, will be removed immediately and handled under applicable law.
See our Terms of Service and content policy for details.
※ Contact: cs@metastar.be

bluejetty:00119599:ios.name: SnagID - Snagging and Defects
bluejetty:00119599:ios.summary: SnagID offers a comprehensive project and site management solution that spans from project initiation to completion. It encompasses tasks like defect identification, inspections, punch lists, and more. This tool streamlines your workflow an
bluejetty:00119599:ios.description:
SnagID offers a comprehensive project and site management solution that spans from project initiation to completion. It encompasses tasks like defect identification, inspections, punch lists, and more. This tool streamlines your workflow and enhances the quality of supervision while reducing time consumption.
All your project sites are systematically organised into projects and multi-level locations. SnagID is a versatile application that supports users in various tasks including site auditing, snag detection, safety inspections, survey organisation, work list compilation, and even quotation creation.
KEY FEATURES
* Organise all your project sites into structured projects and multi-level locations
* Move snags between projects or locations anytime for maximum flexibility
* Categorise snags under projects with client details included in PDF reports
* Break down projects into locations (floors, sections, apartments, etc.) and link related snags
* Document snags with titles, assignees/contractors, status updates, completion dates, comments, and more
* Add up to 10 images per snag with powerful annotation tools (pencil, shapes, arrows, text, etc.)
* Record audio notes for each snag for better clarity and communication
* Share projects, locations, or individual snags with team members for seamless collaboration
* Combine reports for better team coordination and visibility
DASHBOARD & INSIGHTS
* Track project status with a smart dashboard
* Visualise progress using graphs and powerful filters
* Gain better insights into project performance and completion status
REPORTING & EXPORTS
* Create detailed and customisable reports for clients
* Export multiple PDF and Excel reports easily
* Share reports worldwide with ease
* Support for AirPrint for quick and efficient printing
BACKUP & RESTORE
* Take full backup of the entire application data
* Save and share backups securely
* Restore or import backups anytime to continue your work without interruption
CUSTOMIZATION & FLEXIBILITY
SnagID is highly adaptable across various industries, offering customisable labels to meet diverse reporting needs:
* Customise the label "Snag" to match defects, issues, problems, inspections, observations, etc.
* Adjust location labels (floors, sections, apartments, etc.)
* Personalise assignee labels (companies, contractors, clients, etc.)
* Adapt date formats according to your requirements
CORE CAPABILITIES
Key features of the primary app comprise project and location organisation, detailed reporting, audio notes for each item, clearance notifications, site audits, and more. SnagID boasts a user-friendly interface that simplifies operations while improving efficiency across all project stages.
Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us. Please don't hesitate to contact us at support@appculus.com.

bluejetty:00073990:ios.description:
When I woke up, I found that I was no longer stay in the familiar room, a world as beautiful as heaven greeted my eyes.
"Where am I?"
"Welcome to the Utopia land, the land of Beia," a voice said. "I am your guide, Xiaxia."
Looking up, a flying sprite was talking to us. 
"You are the first adventurer to be recruited. Take this manual and start your adventures!"
No one could have imagined that mine adventure legends was about to begin.
◆ If You don't Build the House Well, You'll be Caught
Xiaxia Tips ①: There will be a little demon and skeleton soldier at night, and it is very dangerous if don’t have your own campfire and house!
“Let’s build our house today! There's wood and stone everywhere. Come on!” No one ever did chopping, mining or carpentry, but it was as if we have been given the magic by the land, and everyone learned to master all sorts of skills. Wood and stone were transported to the worktable, processed into boards and bricks, and a two-story building slowly formed with the sweat from everyone. As night fell, a mysterious mist filled the air. As Xiaxia said, a group of small demons with green flames appeared in the mist, but the fire in front of their homes made them dare not go further.
◆ The World is so Big, I Want to Explore it with You!
Xiaxia Tips ②: You can ride a dragon in this world, but first, tame a pony!
After the home was built, everyone can't wait to explore the world. In order to ride the wild horses back home, let’s prepare horse feed first. There was a faint smell of carrot and wheat balls baked with a soft fire, and several horses came to us, rubbed our hands and ate happily. Lightly on the back of the horse, let the sun shine on the shoulders, we planned to go to explore the wilderness tomorrow!
◆ The Best Sights in Beia is that We Fight Side by Side!
Xiaxia tips ③: Treasure often accompanied by danger!
Mount and weapon are ready, and nothing can stop us from exploring. It is said that in the islands, forests, deserts and snow-capped mountains, the treasure left by the creator gods is now guarded by monsters and Evils. For about half a day north, a ruin was visible, and a troop of skeletons wandered through the wreckage, with a golden chest in the middle. The battle began, the seemingly vulnerable skeletons were so powerful unexpectedly. Finally we beat them, after opening the treasure chest, a gem appeared with its soft light, as if healing our wounds.
◆ Play in Your Way!
I have climbed the most remote ruins, sailed to the most romantic heart island, even cut off the teeth of the dragon, but I still need more friends, do things we enjoy together, do you want to come together?
Contact US
Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/utopiaorigin
Official YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCu0aYQp6QDgLT19yZ72uHdQ
Official Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/UtopiaOrigin
Customer Service Email: utopia@herogame.com
Note: Utopia: Origin is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00062408:ios.description:
Speak a new language - don't just study it. Lingocard turns vocabulary into real conversation: learn words with smart flashcards, then use them live with native speakers who are ready to talk right now.
Trusted by 100,000+ learners and 1,000+ teachers in 180+ countries. 67 languages. 2,000,000+ ready-made flashcards.
WHY LINGOCARD WORKS
- Learn 30 new words a day: AI spaced repetition shows each word at the exact moment you're about to forget it, so vocabulary moves into long-term memory with the fewest reviews.
- Speak from day one: smart AI search finds your perfect practice partner in seconds - matched by native language, level, and interests. No awkward searching, no dead-end chats.
- Real friendships, real fluency: message, send voice notes, and jump on audio or video calls without leaving the app. Practice partners here often become friends for life.
- Learn hands-free: turn any word set into audio and listen while you drive, cook, or work out.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP
- Speaking practice with real people: built-in chat with audio and video calls
- Smart AI search that finds the best practice partners for you
- A worldwide community where practice turns into friendship
- 2,000,000+ flashcards with images and native-speaker audio
- Frequency dictionaries: the 10,000 most-used words in each of 67 languages
- Thematic sets: travel, business, idioms, and real-life slang
- Create your own cards with photos, or import texts and listen to them
- Daily goals, streaks, and progress charts that keep you motivated
- Cloud sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web
FOR TEACHERS AND SCHOOLS
Create study sets on the web, assign them to students, and track everyone's progress from one dashboard. Your students get premium learning tools at no extra cost.
LEARN ANY OF 67 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese, and many more - in any combination with your native language.
Every day you wait, someone else is having the conversation you want to have. Start now: your first dictionary takes two minutes, and your first real conversation is closer than you think.
Optional Premium subscription unlocks the full library and all dictionaries. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://lingocard.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Welcome to Idle Electricity Outpost – an electrifying idle simulation game where you build and manage your energy empire in a post-apocalyptic wasteland! Generate electricity, produce powerf
bluejetty:00140961:ios.description:
Power Up Your Factory and Survive the Wasteland!
Welcome to Idle Electricity Outpost – an electrifying idle simulation game where you build and manage your energy empire in a post-apocalyptic wasteland! Generate electricity, produce powerful batteries, and defend your factory from relentless zombie hordes. Are you ready to light up the future?
Manage Your Resources
Start by harvesting essential minerals, creating glass cases, and forging metal components. Combine these resources to produce high-tech batteries and sell them for profit. Use your earnings to expand and optimize your factory!
Upgrade Your Machines
Boost your production capabilities by upgrading key machines:
Furnace: Refine raw minerals into usable materials.
Assembly Unit: Build battery components with precision.
Charging Station: Power up and prepare your batteries for sale.
Efficient Logistics
Run an electric train to deliver minerals to your factory while your hard-working bots and skilled workers keep everything running smoothly. Every process counts towards creating an efficient energy empire.
Connect the Grid
Take charge of the power lines! Strategically connect electricity across your factory to keep the machines running and the lights on. This unique gameplay feature sets you apart from other tycoons.
Defend Against Zombies
Survive the post-apocalyptic wasteland by defending your factory from zombies! Tap to eliminate threats and keep your workers safe. Can you protect your outpost while growing your energy empire?
Expand Your Outpost
Use your profits to expand your operations, discover new technologies, and create the ultimate electricity hub. Turn your wasteland factory into a beacon of light for the future!
Idle Electricity Outpost offers addictive idle gameplay, engaging strategy, and an exciting mix of survival and simulation. Download now and start building your energy empire today!

bluejetty:00119901:ios.name: AtlasMission, #1 kids learning
bluejetty:00119901:ios.summary:
Based on path-breaking research from Carnegie Mellon University, the Atlas Mission involves your child taking part in an epic learning adventure along with Atlas Finch, the traveling Robot!
See why parents LOVE the Atlas Mission...
+++++++
bluejetty:00119901:ios.description:
Based on path-breaking research from Carnegie Mellon University, the Atlas Mission involves your child taking part in an epic learning adventure along with Atlas Finch, the traveling Robot!
See why parents LOVE the Atlas Mission...
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
"As a teacher, I recommend the Atlas Mission to parents because with the Atlas Mission, kids learn without realizing that they are learning... because they have so much fun playing, giggling... and just having an amazing time learning. I also love how the Atlas Mission takes kids around the world when they don't have the opportunity to do so themselves.
When my own daughter played the game, she smiled, laughed, giggled... and wanted to play it again and again and again."
- Erin Goodwin, Elementary School Teacher, USA
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
During the adventure, your child will complete a number of missions set in different countries (the U.S., Canada, Mexico, the U.K., India, Brazil, Australia, etc.)
IMPROVE YOUR CHILD'S READING, WRITING, STEM & 21st CENTURY SKILLS
Each mission involves a mini game designed to significantly improve your child's skills in the following areas:
* Vocabulary, Spelling & Reading
* Writing
* STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering & Math)
* 21st Century Skills (Creativity, Critical Thinking, Problem Solving & Coding)
HELP YOUR CHILD LEARN ABOUT OTHER COUNTRIES AND CULTURES
Each mission will also help them understand some of the unique cultural characteristics of the countries they are visiting.
So with the Atlas Mission, your little explorer can experience first hand the wonders of the real world!
BASED ON PATH-BREAKING RESEARCH AT LEADING UNIVERSITIES
The Atlas Mission is based on path-breaking research conducted at the Carnegie Mellon University and the University of California, Berkeley over a period of 10 years.
THE ONLY PRE-SCHOOL GAME THAT:
* Has eye-exercises that help your child's eyesight
* Has a parent controlled timeout feature that lets you determine how long your child can play with the game every day (in order to prevent screen addiction)
* Gives real-life context to what your child is reading, which improves reading skills
DESIGNED FOR PARENTS' PEACE OF MIND
* Can be played offline (so you can keep your child busy during road-trips and on flights)
* No ads, popups, or links to other sites
* Up to 4 children can play on the same account
MEMBERSHIP OPTIONS:
* You can download a free trial version of the Atlas Mission. If you later decide to upgrade to the premium version with a monthly, semi-annual or yearly subscription, the payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before end of current period
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before end of current period
* You can manage subscriptions & turn off auto-renew by going to Account Settings after purchase
* No cancellation of current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
"What sets the Atlas Mission apart from other apps is that it's got so many different elements - it's got travel, stories, games, education, teaching hundreds of different words, and it's got a big storyline from start to finish. Something [else] I love about the Atlas Mission is that it exposes kids very early on to different countries and cultures, and it does that in a fun and educational way."
- Dr. Robin Bahrdt
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
PRIVACY POLICY
AtlasMission.com/privacy-policy
TERMS OF USE
AtlasMission.com/terms-of-use
PRODUCT SUPPORT
Email help@AtlasMission.com

Mini Sudoku 6x6 – Quick Logic Puzzle Fun!
Challenge your brain with fast and fun Sudoku!
Mini Sudoku 6x6 is the perfect puzzle game for players who want a quick mental workout anytime, anywhere. With a smaller 6x6 grid, each game is faster than traditional 9x9 Sudoku—ideal for short breaks, commutes, or daily brain training.

- Classic Sudoku Rules – Fill every row, column, and 2x3 box with numbers 1–6 without repeating.
- Multiple Difficulty Levels – From beginner-friendly to brain-bending challenges.
- Hints & Undo Options – Stuck? Get help without penalty.
- Quick Rounds – Play a complete game in just a few minutes.
- Offline Mode – Enjoy the game anytime, no internet needed.
Whether you're a Sudoku beginner or a seasoned pro, Mini Sudoku 6x6 is the perfect pick-up-and-play puzzle to keep your mind sharp!
Download now and sharpen your logic in minutes!

English is the world's most widely spoken language. Of the approximately 1.5 billion people who speak English, less than 400 million use it as a first language. 
NEW: 5 LANGUAGES IN ONE APP
Learn English — or switch to French, Spanish, German or Japanese at any time in Profile.

This English learning app is very useful for beginners and those who need to improve English vocabulary, listening and speaking skills. You will be able to learn English with hundreds of words with eye-catching pictures and American standard pronunciation. It's very easy to use with simple, intuitive and powerful UI.

bluejetty:00162432:ios.description:
Hear ye, hear ye, fellow Traveler!
From the creators of Shakes & Fidget, join us in a new epic fantasy RPG adventure. Get ready to accept our new quest and embark on the wackiest dungeon crawler!
The bards of the realm already sing their songs of a new fun game!
And their ballads go like this:
"Welcome to Mobile Dungeon, a merry RPG show,
Where dungeons are playgrounds and laughter does flow.
In a world so absurd, where the champions are wacky,
Embark on a journey that's utterly tacky.
In dungeons bizarre, where the strange materializes,
An epic crawl awaits, full of comical surprises.
Goblins with whoopee cushions and disco-dancing trolls,
Every step is a giggle, every challenge, pure gold.
In arenas of madness, where the PvP is a delight,
Craft strategies that boggle, in the absurdity of the fight.
Real-time showdowns with champions so funny,
Outwit your foes with humor, emerge as the bunny.
Summon your team, a carnival absurdity,
From pranking goblins to chickens of sincerity.
Craft a crew with synergy both potent and mad,
In the land of wizards, it's a team-building fad.
Mobile Dungeon, where laughter takes flight,
In a RPG world that's whimsically bright.
A celebration of mirth, a fantastical cheer,
Join us in the Dungeon, where the funny is near!"
GAME FEATURES:
- HEROES & FOES -
Collect tons of different units, good and evil characters, monsters and animals. Hunt or recruit them to shape your party and defeat any threat that stands in your way.
- STRATEGIC BATTLES - 
Form your party and strategize unbeatable lineups to overcome your enemies in battle. From very nasty seagulls to bulky orcs, each formation will grant specific skills and unique buffs.
- DISCOVER -
Immerse yourself in a fantastical world where the legends are as diverse as they are ludicrous. From the legendary feats of a tea-sipping sorcerer to the epic tales of a hero who communicates solely in limericks, the whimsy never ends. Explore, laugh, and uncover the legends that define this one-of-a-kind RPG
So let the fun run free, by this here royal decree!

Privacy Policy: https://cdn.mobiledungeon.com/res/md/legal/html/privacy_en.html

bluejetty:00182517:ios.name: Google Authenticator
bluejetty:00182517:ios.summary: Google Authenticator adds an extra layer of security to your online accounts by adding a second step of verification when you sign in. This means that in addition to your password, you'll also need to enter a code that is generated by the G
bluejetty:00182517:ios.description:
Google Authenticator adds an extra layer of security to your online accounts by adding a second step of verification when you sign in. This means that in addition to your password, you'll also need to enter a code that is generated by the Google Authenticator app on your phone.
The verification code can be generated by the Google Authenticator app on your phone, even if you don't have a network or cellular connection.
• Sync your Authenticator codes to your Google Account and across your devices. This way, you can always access them even if you lose your phone.
• Set up your Authenticator accounts automatically with a QR code. This is quick and easy, and it helps to ensure that your codes are set up correctly.
• Support for multiple accounts. You can use the Authenticator app to manage multiple accounts, so you don't have to switch between apps every time you need to sign in.
• Support for time-based and counter-based code generation. You can choose the type of code generation that best suits your needs.
• Transfer accounts between devices with a QR code. This is a convenient way to move your accounts to a new device.
To use Google Authenticator with Google, you need to enable 2-Step Verification on your Google Account. To get started visit http://www.google.com/2step

bluejetty:00041179:ios.description:
TimeCalc is a powerful yet simple time calculator for everyday use — 
add and subtract hours, track work durations, calculate future dates, and find exact age in seconds.
TIME CALCULATOR
Add, subtract multiple time values in sequence. 
Instant results, calculation history saved.
Examples:
2h 35m + 3h 45m = 6h 20m
12h 20m − 4.5h = 7h 50m
4h 52m × 3 = 14h 36m
1h ÷ 20m = 3
Convert between time units:
456m = 7h 36m = 7.6h
TIME BETWEEN (DURATION)
Enter any start and end time to calculate the exact duration. 
Organize into separate categories. 
Export PDF reports (Premium).
Examples:
11:20 AM → 12:40 PM = 1h 20m
01:30 AM → 02:30 PM = 13h
Today 02:00 → Tomorrow 02:30 = 24h 30m
DATE CALCULATOR (ADD & SUBTRACT)
From any starting date, add or subtract years/months/weeks/days/hours/minutes to get the resulting date. 
Calendar-accurate arithmetic — adding 1 month to Jan 31 gives the correct last day of February.
Example:
Today 17:32 + (1d 2h) = Tomorrow 19:32
AGE CALCULATOR
Calculate exact age in years, months, and days from a birth date. 
Save multiple birthdays to track.
---

• Supports both 12h and 24h formats
• Multi-language support

bluejetty:00024045:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Embark on an emotional first-person adventure where you control the story — and affect the outcome — with your real-life blinks. 
Dive into a world of memories and experience a soul’s journey into the afterlife as your whole life flashes before your eyes.
It all begins after you die. You're aboard the ship of a mysterious man tasked with shepherding souls to the afterlife. To help you pass on, he must learn the story of your life. Then he sends you back to relive your most important moments.
The game uses your device's camera to fully immerse you in the story. Control the flow of the narrative with your real-life eyes – blinking through precious memories of family, first love and the birth of an artistic career. Dare to look deeper and delve into your most repressed memories, where a heartbreaking truth awaits.
Combining an innovative blink-interaction mechanic with a charming world and fully voice-acted story, Before Your Eyes is a deeply emotional and relatable journey — one that explores the impossible expectations we place on ourselves and the regrets we carry with us.

bluejetty:00183223:ios.description:
Big Brands. Amazing Products. Great Value..
The Sultan app makes grocery shopping easier, faster, and more convenient than ever. Browse thousands of products, discover exclusive offers, and get everything delivered directly to your door anywhere . With a simple and user-friendly experience, you can shop fresh groceries, household essentials, and your favorite brands all in one place.
Explore a wide selection of products including fresh fruits and vegetables, meat, poultry and seafood, dairy and bakery products, frozen foods, snacks and beverages, household products, personal care items, and imported or specialty groceries. Browse more than 20,000 products across multiple categories and enjoy convenient delivery from Sultan stores directly to your home anywhere , with the option to choose your preferred delivery time.
Shop more and save more with the Kanzee loyalty program, where you can earn cashback on your purchases, track your rewards easily, enjoy exclusive loyalty offers, and redeem rewards on future orders. The app also offers smart product search, secure and easy checkout with multiple payment options, and a seamless shopping experience from a trusted supermarket brand . Download the Sultan app today and enjoy a smarter way to shop for groceries and everyday essentials.
علامات تجارية كبرى. منتجات مذهلة. قيمة رائعة.
يجعل تطبيق سلطان تجربة تسوق البقالة أسهل وأسرع وأكثر راحة من أي وقت مضى. تصفّح آلاف المنتجات، اكتشف العروض الحصرية، واحصل على كل ما تحتاجه موصلاً مباشرة إلى باب منزلك أينما كنت. من خلال تجربة بسيطة وسهلة الاستخدام، يمكنك شراء المنتجات الطازجة، والاحتياجات المنزلية، وأشهر العلامات التجارية في مكان واحد.
استكشف مجموعة واسعة من المنتجات تشمل الفواكه والخضروات الطازجة، اللحوم والدواجن والمأكولات البحرية، منتجات الألبان والمخبوزات، الأطعمة المجمدة، الوجبات الخفيفة والمشروبات، المنتجات المنزلية، مستلزمات العناية الشخصية، بالإضافة إلى المنتجات المستوردة والمتخصصة. تصفّح أكثر من 20,000 منتج عبر فئات متعددة واستمتع بخدمة توصيل مريحة من متاجر سلطان مباشرة إلى منزلك، مع إمكانية اختيار الوقت المناسب للتوصيل.
تسوّق أكثر ووفّر أكثر مع برنامج الولاء "كنزي"، حيث يمكنك كسب كاش باك على مشترياتك، متابعة مكافآتك بسهولة، الاستفادة من العروض الحصرية، واستبدال المكافآت في طلباتك المستقبلية. كما يوفر التطبيق خاصية البحث الذكي عن المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات الدفع بسهولة وأمان عبر خيارات دفع متعددة، وتجربة تسوق سلسة من علامة تجارية موثوقة في عالم السوبرماركت.
حمّل تطبيق سلطان اليوم واستمتع بطريقة أذكى لتسوق البقالة والاحتياجات اليومية.

bluejetty:00043141:ios.description:
Colmédica Medicina Prepagada 
Gracias a nuestra App Colmédica para teléfonos inteligentes y tabletas, usted tiene la posibilidad de acceder a aquella información de nuestros servicios que con mayor frecuencia y urgencia suele requerir, de manera concreta e inmediata. 
Funcionalidades de video para Autorizaciones médicas y Servicio de Orientación Médica - SOM por video llamada. 
A la hora que usted nos necesite, en la funcionalidad SOM por video llamada, un profesional de la salud estará atento y le brindará información sobre:
•Manejo de la situación de salud en su casa u oficina. 
•Institución hospitalaria más cercana de acuerdo con su ubicación geográfica. 
•Envío de médico domiciliario o ambulancia en caso de requerirse. 
Además, usted cuenta con la posibilidad de ingresar desde su dispositivo móvil y/o tableta y acceder a las siguientes funcionalidades:
•Directorio médico, a través de la cual puede consultar nuestra amplia red de profesionales médicos e instituciones tanto clínicas como diagnósticas y los Centros Médicos Colmédica. Esta funcionalidad le permite realizar de manera ágil, oportuna y detallada búsquedas por tipo de plan, ciudad, Centros Médicos Colmédica, especialidad y profesionales médicos adscritos a la red.
•Oficina virtual, en esta sección puede encontrar información sobre certificaciones, última factura, oficinas así como de los Autoservicios Colmédica.
•Favoritos, la cual permite que el usuario personalice su directorio médico haciendo un listado de los médicos y Centros Médicos Colmédica que frecuenta, ahorrándole tiempo a la hora de programar sus citas y la organización de sus fórmulas médicas, pues se tienen los datos de su preferencia, agrupados en un solo lugar.
•Solicitar citas en los Centros Médicos Colmédica y Centros Odontológicos Colmédica de forma electrónica, además de poder realizar el pago de las UPD´s en línea. Además, tiene la posibilidad de consultar la ubicación y horario de las Ópticas Colmédica. 
•Acceso rápido a las líneas de atención telefónica de Asistencia Colmédica y el SOM (Servicio de Orientación Médica). 
•Autorizaciones Médicas, por medio de la cual puede solicitar sus autorizaciones médicas y además consultar el estado de las mismas. 
•Convenios, allí puede encontrar toda la información sobre beneficios y descuentos de nuestros aliados.
•Revista Vivir Bien, donde puede consultar las últimas 9 ediciones y así disfrutar en cualquier momento la lectura de artículos desarrollados para su bienestar.
•Profesionales de salud, donde puede encontrar las funcionalidades de consultar información, consultar pagos, asistencia colmédica, solicitar papelería, autorizaciones médicas, y simulador pila.
Porque en Colmédica Medicina Prepagada continuamos innovando para su bienestar.

bluejetty:00131676:ios.summary:

Privault (i.e.Private Vault) is a popular and high-ranking app on app stores of many cou
bluejetty:00131676:ios.description:
Thanks for your adoption of our Privault app as the final solution to secure your valuable personal photos, videos, audio memos and precious memories.
Privault (i.e.Private Vault) is a popular and high-ranking app on app stores of many countries. By far, we have ~4 million organic users worldwide and have reached a high 4.7/5 overall rating globally, and we are still committed to providing you continuous update and support.
Privault allows you to hide and lock your private photos, videos and files behind the locker keypad interface. The encrypted storage can be accessed only when you enter your particular digit-passcode.
This app has the best in class user experience compared with other similar ones, if you’ve already tried some.
Some major features you might use under certain circumstances:
Security:
-Primary Passcode: opens your primary secret space
-secondary Passcode: can be used as a secondary account, and opens a secondary folder. if you are threatened to disclose a passcode, disclose this one.
-Erase-all Passcode: used only when you are threatened and decide to erase all secret files
Photos:
-support a unique 3D Photo browser with amazing visual effects. Support image format: bmp, jpg, png,heic,heif,tiff,etc.
Videos:
-The media player can decode up to 150 media formats, such as mov, mp4, m0v, m1v, m2v, m3v, m4v, rm, rmvb, avi, wmv, 3gp, asf, mkv, flv, f4v, divx, mpeg1-mpeg4, vob, vcd/svcd, dat, mts, ts, gif, etc. You can import and play almost any media file.
Voice Recorder:
-This app embeds a voice recorder and provides a simple shortcut to quickly make audio notes/memos on the locker keyboard. In the settings tab, you can configure audio channel/quality/bitrate. It also supports lossless recording.
File Import/Export:
-You can import/export via iPhone camera roll or via an embedded WiFi server.
If you have any problem with the app, please contact: support@binspir.com
PRO Subscription
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Length of subscriptions: monthly or annually
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy
https://binspir.github.io/prvt/pp.html
Term of Use
https://binspir.github.io/prvt/tos.html

bluejetty:00073131:ios.name: Enhance it - AI Photo Editor
bluejetty:00073131:ios.summary: "Enhance it" is a powerful photo editor that goes far beyond conventional editors to fix and improve your pictures as much as possible. Apart from conventional image retouching tools, this app uses artificial intelligence to automatically f
bluejetty:00073131:ios.description:
"Enhance it" is a powerful photo editor that goes far beyond conventional editors to fix and improve your pictures as much as possible. Apart from conventional image retouching tools, this app uses artificial intelligence to automatically fix defects in photos, restore them and boost their quality. A great variety of AI-based tools is available for any specific problem that you may need to fix.
• Did you take a snap but it didn’t come out as you expected? We have the perfect AI tools to help with any problem:
- AUTO-ENHANCE: This tool will restore low-quality images by removing the noise, enhancing the illumination and colors and better defining the picture, especially people. Your images will be clear, sharp and beautiful.
- MOTION DEBLUR: Did the snap you took in that special moment come out blurred? Usually, blurry images are totally useless. But with our app, motion blur is not a problem anymore. Our app will deblur your picture and make it look clear and sharp.
- DENOISE: Often clearing the noise in pictures means losing details or definition. But our artificial intelligence will clear them and erase all the noise and grain from them without blurring any details. Our denoise tool is the perfect balance between sharpness and clarity.
- LIGHT: Some pics are just taken in the wrong light conditions. With our advanced technology, you can enlighten any too dark photo in a natural way. No one will notice it was that dark. 
- COLOR ENHANCEMENT: Improve the quality of your images to its best, making them look absolutely spectacular. Sometimes a picture comes out pale, and sometimes you want more vibrant, intense cool colors. Boost its colors and make them look stunning.
• Did you found that old family album and realized that the pictures are damaged, low quality and feel too distant? Our app can help with its intelligent restoration tools:
- RESTORE: Old photographs are usually low-quality and lacking definition, even more so if time has spoiled them. Our AI can restore them to increase a lot their quality and definition and make them look like taken with a modern expensive camera. 
- COLORIZE: Do you have old family portraits in black and white? This tool can guess the colors of the original scene and apply them to the image, turning them into color photos. Make your memories more alive and closer to you than ever.
• Are you feeling creative about your photos? 
- PICTURIZE: You can transfer the artistic style of a bunch of artworks, materials, drawing styles, and much more into your pics, making them absolutely original, unique, and creative.
• Apart from that, “Enhance it” is also a very complete photographic editor. You can set the brightness, contrast, saturation, vibrance, exposure, sharpness, etc. of your pictures. And also, apply a great variety of filters and post them on your social networks.
• It doesn’t even end here. You can save your images in up to 4K resolution! Our artificial intelligence can increase your picture’s resolution to its whole potential, with no detail loss and maximum quality. 
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
----------
Enchance it terms of service
1 week Enchance + from 4.99$ per week (prices may vary slightly depending on the region).
1 month Enchance + from 19.99$ per month (prices may vary slightly depending on the region)
You can find all in-app purchases on this app store page below under “In-app purchases”.
Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless they have been switched off at least 24 hours before the subscription period expires. Your account will be charged within 24 hours of payment. You can manage your subscriptions in the iOS settings and switch the automatic renewal on or off. A subscription that is already running cannot be canceled within the term that has already started.
Privacy Policy:https://zipoapps.com/enhanceitios/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://zipoapps.com/enhanceitios/terms/

bluejetty:00027074:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00027074:ios.description:
Keep control of your news reading with Reeder Classic, RSS reader and read later client in one app, now with support for iCloud syncing.
FEEDS
Sync all your feeds and articles with iCloud. Reeder Classic comes with a built-in RSS/Feeds service which will keep everything in sync on all your devices. Of course, this is optional. You can still just use one of the many third-party services supported by Reeder or just RSS (without sync).
READ LATER
This is Reeder's built-in read later service which stores all your data securely in iCloud. A sharing extension allows you to add links from outside of Reeder.
BIONIC READING
A higher dimension of reading. With Bionic Reading you read texts with more focus, awareness, and sustainability. Read more about Bionic Reading at bionic-reading.com.
WIDGETS
View most recent articles, configurable to only show items from feeds, folders, searches (for services that support searches) or tags (for read later services).
MARK AS READ ON SCROLL
With version 5, Reeder finally supports marking items as read while scrolling. Off by default, this can be enabled on a per-account basis.
READER VIEW
Enter Reader View (for feed items and read later links that support this) for a clutter-free reading experience directly in Reeder's article viewer. You can enable "Automatic Reader View" on a per-feed basis to always load items of a feed with Reader View.
SUPPORTED THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
Feedbin, Feedly, FeedHQ, NewsBlur, The Old Reader, Inoreader, BazQux Reader, FreshRSS, Instapaper and Pocket.

Live Stock Market Tracker

Analyze historical trends to make smarter trading decisions.

bluejetty:00073679:ios.description:
Magnifi: Invest with AI
AI Portfolio Tracker & Planner
Stop guessing and start tracking toward your actual financial milestones. Whether you’re saving for a home, planning for retirement, or just trying to grow your wealth, Magnifi acts as your personal AI investing assistant—unifying your scattered accounts into one clear, actionable dashboard.
When your investments are scattered across multiple apps, you can't optimize what you cannot see. Magnifi connects popular brokerages like Fidelity, Robinhood, and Schwab to give you total visibility, institutional-grade analytics, and data-driven AI guidance.
NEW: Goal-Based Planning
Turn your dreams into data-driven timelines.
• Create custom goals for retirement, buying a home, education, and more.
• Track your daily progress with your dynamic Goal Readiness Score.
• Get personalized AI guidance highlighting exactly what is helping or slowing your progress.
• Manage multiple goals simultaneously alongside your linked retirement and brokerage accounts.
Core Features to Optimize Your Wealth:
• Unified Account Dashboard: Securely link all your brokerages to track your total net worth and asset allocation in one place.
• Portfolio Health Score: Generate an instant diagnostic of your overall strategy. Uncover concentration risks and see exactly where your portfolio needs attention.
• Conversational AI Research: Ask plain-English questions to analyze stocks and ETFs. Test how a new asset fits your strategy before you execute a trade.
• Hidden Overlap Analysis: Automatically scan scattered mutual funds and ETFs to catch duplicate stock holdings and eliminate hidden risks.
• Fee Drag Auditor: Instantly spot high-expense funds quietly eating away at your compounding returns and compare them against low-cost alternatives.
• Real-Time Catalyst Tracking: Cut through daily market noise. Track the breaking news, earnings dates, and analyst upgrades that directly impact your specific holdings.
Pricing:
Start for free. Connect your investment accounts, see your full portfolio, and get clear insights with no hidden charges. To take your strategy further, upgrade to Magnifi Premium for $8.25/month (billed annually) or $14/month (billed monthly). Premium unlocks unlimited access to portfolio forecasting, scenario testing, and advanced research.
Disclosures:
Magnifi LLC does not charge advisory fees or transaction fees for non-managed accounts. Please see Magnifi's Form ADV for additional information about fees and charges that may apply. Mutual funds or ETFs may have additional fees or expenses. You should review the fund's prospectus before investing. While Magnifi does not charge commissions or fees on stocks, ETFs or mutual funds, the custodian of your account may charge separately for certain services. Any custodial fees or charges are contained in your customer account agreement.
Opinions expressed herein are solely those of Magnifi LLC and our editorial staff. The information contained in this material has been derived from sources believed to be reliable but is not guaranteed as to accuracy and completeness and does not purport to be a complete analysis of the materials discussed. All information and ideas should be discussed in detail with your individual adviser prior to implementation.
For terms and conditions, please visit: https://tifin.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00115911:ios.name: War Inc: Rising
bluejetty:00115911:ios.summary: War Inc: Rising thrusts you into a world under siege by monstrous hordes and ruthless enemy armies. As a commander of the last bastion, your mission is clear – rally heroes, build your defenses, and fight alongside allies to save your world
bluejetty:00115911:ios.description:
War Inc: Rising thrusts you into a world under siege by monstrous hordes and ruthless enemy armies. As a commander of the last bastion, your mission is clear – rally heroes, build your defenses, and fight alongside allies to save your world from destruction. The war is on, and only strategic teamwork and courage will turn the tide. Are you ready to rise to the challenge and become the hero this cartoon war-torn world needs?
Team Up for Epic Co-Op Defense
Grab your friends and fight side by side in thrilling cooperative battles! Coordinate strategies in real-time and jointly defend your base against endless waves of monsters and enemy troops. Each battle is a test of teamwork – deploy turrets, fortify your walls, and unleash special skills together to hold the line against the onslaught. In War Inc: Rising, co-op play isn’t just an option, it’s the heart of the game – survive together or fall alone.
Clash in Global PvP Arenas
When you’re not fending off creatures, take the fight to the world stage. Compete against players worldwide in intense PvP arena duels and clan wars. Climb the ranks as you outsmart rivals from across the globe with your superior tactics. Whether you prefer one-on-one showdowns or massive clan clashes, the global arena awaits your legend. Prove your might, dominate the leaderboards, and become the ultimate warlord in competitive play.
Unlock and Upgrade Heroes & Skills
Build an army to be feared! Recruit dozens of unique heroes, each with their own quirky personalities, powerful abilities, and cartoon-style flair. From stalwart defenders to explosive damage-dealers, choose the right heroes to bolster your strategy. Level up your champions and unlock game-changing skills to turn the tide of battle. Mix and match different heroes and abilities to create an unbeatable team – your strategy, your style. The more you play, the stronger your arsenal grows as you upgrade defenses, troops, and special weapons for maximum impact.
Strategy Meets Cartoon Fun
Experience a vibrant cartoon art style filled with whimsical animations and eye-popping effects, making every battle as fun to watch as it is to play. War Inc: Rising offers deep strategy and planning just like your favorite Clash and tower defense games, but with a lighthearted twist. Easy to pick up, yet challenging to master, it’s a strategy game that caters to casual tacticians and hardcore planners alike. Plan your tactics, adjust on the fly, and enjoy the charming visuals as you crush creeps and opponents in style.
Ever-Evolving Challenges and Updates
The war never stops, and neither does the fun! We’re committed to keeping fresh content rolling in so there’s always something new to conquer. Look forward to regular updates with new heroes, enemies, defense towers, and game modes. Take on seasonal events, special co-op missions, and daily challenges that test your skills and reward your triumphs. With each update, expect new strategic puzzles and tougher boss fights to keep you on your toes. The world of War Inc: Rising is constantly growing – stay sharp and ready for the next challenge.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
- Privacy Policy: https://www.89trillion.com/privacy.html
- Terms of Service: https://www.89trillion.com/service.html

Your allies await – unite now and rise to become the ultimate defender in this epic strategy adventure. Victory won't wait – download now and join the battle!

bluejetty:00144996:ios.description:
Keep a personal notebook for your thoughts, diary entries, ideas and everyday lists. Lock Notes gives your writing its own space, with a passcode and supported biometric unlock to control access.
WRITE THE WAY YOU THINK
Give long notes structure with headings, bold and italic text, lists and checklists. Add photos directly into your writing, keep a simple journal, or capture an idea before it slips away.
FIND WHAT MATTERS
Search your notes and find text inside an open note. Automatic saving keeps your edits as you write and when you leave the editor. A clean layout keeps the focus on your text.
TAKE YOUR WRITING WITH YOU
Export notes as TXT or formatted PDF, share the notes you choose, and print a copy. Use exports for a personal archive, a draft to continue elsewhere, or a list to share.
RECOVER AN ACCIDENTAL DELETION
Recently Deleted keeps removed notes for up to 30 days, so you can restore one before it is permanently deleted.
CHOOSE HOW YOU WORK
Write with local storage, adjust the appearance, and use a light or dark interface. Optional cloud synchronization is available with Premium and a compatible cloud account.
From a short memo to a longer personal journal, keep your writing easy to find and comfortable to read.
- Privacy Policy: https://lykovstudio.io/privacy

bluejetty:00068592:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00068592:ios.description:
Catalog up to 25 items free: scan a barcode and Nest Egg fills in the name, photo and details for you. No account, no subscription, your data stays on your device.
Featured in the New York Times, Denver Post, Boston Globe, ABC and CNBC. More than 7 million unique items scanned and counting.
WHICH NEST EGG IS RIGHT FOR YOU?
• Nest Egg Home Inventory Lite (this app): free, up to 25 items, one device.
• Nest Egg Home Inventory: unlimited items, copy your inventory to another iPhone or iPad, plus optional extras. One-time purchase, no subscription.
• Nest Egg Cloud: automatic sync across all your devices and sharing with others. Subscription.
HOW PEOPLE USE NEST EGG
• Home insurance: document belongings and serial numbers before you ever need to file a claim
• Estate planning: keep records of assets across homes, rental properties, RVs and boats
• Moving: list what goes where and check your mover's coverage
• Collections: catalog books, music, Lego, wine and more
• Pantry: track food, perishables and medicine with expiry alerts
• Hobbies: keep parts and supplies organized
• Wardrobe: catalog clothing, shoes and accessories
INCLUDED IN LITE
• BARCODE SCANNING
Scan a barcode and we fill in the name, description, photo and more from millions of products.
• CATEGORIES AND LOCATIONS
Organize by category and sub-category, or by room, location and sub-location. Move many items at once with batch edit.
• PHOTOS AND DETAILED RECORDS
Take photos of each item and record purchase details, manufacturer, model and serial numbers, cost and notes.
• WARRANTY AND EXPIRY ALERTS
Get reminded before warranties expire, and cut pantry waste with expiration alerts.
• ONLINE PRICE CHECK
See current prices online with links to merchants.
• LENDING AND BORROWING
Track what you've lent and borrowed, and get alerted when it's due back.
• SHARE, PRINT AND EXPORT
Print with AirPrint, share by email or AirDrop, and export to CSV for Excel or Numbers, or to HTML with photos.
• ICLOUD BACKUP
Keep a backup of your inventory in iCloud.
• 32 LANGUAGES
Including Chinese, French, German and Spanish.
• FAST, FRIENDLY SUPPORT
Reach us from inside the app with questions or feedback. We reply quickly.
UPGRADE TO NEST EGG HOME INVENTORY FOR
• Unlimited items
• Copy your inventory to another iPhone or iPad
• QR labels for boxes, shelves and containers
• Receipts, manuals and video attachments
• CSV import from spreadsheets
• Passcode lock and data wiping
• Advanced search, filter and sort
• Color tags and tag groups
• Dropbox backup and transfer
(Extras are optional in-app purchases in Nest Egg Home Inventory.)

bluejetty:00127937:ios.summary:
Hello Boss! Are you ready to become a manager of an airport?
Airport Inc. is an idle airport tycoon game where you will:
• HANDLE various aircrafts

• BECOME A MANAGER and control passengers boarding proces
bluejetty:00127937:ios.description:
Hello Boss! Are you ready to become a manager of an airport?
Airport Inc. is an idle airport tycoon game where you will:
• HANDLE various aircrafts
• UPGRADE vehicles and facilities
• BECOME A MANAGER and control passengers boarding process
• HIRE employees and provide the best service
• EARN money and increase prestige
• BUILD your dream airport
• NO INTERNET CONNECTION NEEDED - just play wherever you are
• AIRPORT MANAGER GAME - handle aircrafts and fly!
• REAL IDLE GAME - incremental mechanics will give you constant progress
DISCOVER YOUR INNER MANAGER!
Build and manage your own airport! Handle aircrafts, control boarding processes, earn money and upgrade your stuff. Become a billionaire and reach 5 prestige stars! That is your own venture with idle progress!
HANDLE AIRCRAFTS IN TIME!
Create the best organized airport with a perfect flow. Control work of the air control tower, apron, vehicles and handle aircrafts on time! Create the world's most punctual airport!
KEEP PASSENGERS HAPPY!
Manage the boarding process to satisfy passengers and provide perfect service! Balance the work of taxis, check-in, security control and boarding sections to keep people moving smoothly through the terminal. 
BECOME AN INVENTOR!
Develop technologies, upgrade boosters and make your handling facilities working more efficient. Increase capabilities of fuel tankers, baggage carts, air control tower and parking! All upgrades are based on incremental mechanics so you will keep constant progress.
GAME FEATURES:
• Intuitive gameplay with idle game mechanics - very challenging!
• 5 different aircrafts classes: local, business, domestic, international & intercontinental!
• 10 different aircrafts to handle - two for each prestige level!
• Tens of technologies to develop and upgrade!
• Many exciting quests to complete!
• Offline idle game - no internet connection needed!
• Become a manager - take full control of your business!
Unique incremental mechanics let you play with your own style and grow. Manage and invest in your business like never before! Be a pioneer venture into little-known waters!
If you like idle tycoon games with incremental progress, Airport Inc. - Idle Tycoon Game is for you! This is possibly the best airport manager game in the world!

bluejetty:00132292:ios.name: LastQuake
bluejetty:00132292:ios.summary: LastQuake is a free, mobile application dedicated to alerting populations and gathering testimonies in real-time when an earthquake occurs. Designed by seismologists, LastQuake is the official app of the Euro-Mediterranean Seismological Ce
bluejetty:00132292:ios.description:
LastQuake is a free, mobile application dedicated to alerting populations and gathering testimonies in real-time when an earthquake occurs. Designed by seismologists, LastQuake is the official app of the Euro-Mediterranean Seismological Center (EMSC). Thanks to the participative action of its users, only a few minutes are needed for the EMSC to estimate earthquake effects and notify the population.
[LastQuake is an ad-free app!]
** AN INNOVATIVE EARTHQUAKE DETECTION METHOD **
EMSC detects earthquakes using:
∘ Earthquake witnesses, who are the first to feel an earthquake, hence the first informed that an event is happening.
∘ Internet and mobile technologies, which allow rapid information collection of the effects observed by witnesses, who are asked to fill in a questionnaire and share photos and videos.
Want to learn more about our detection system? Watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sNCaHFxhZ5E
** COMMITMENT TO POPULATIONS AFFECTED BY EARTHQUAKES **
Information and communication are cornerstones in preventing risky behaviors. EMSC contributes to the reduction of seismic risk by providing you with:
∘ real-time information
∘ post-earthquake safety tips
∘ SMS service that allows victims to notify their loved ones.
** YOUR INVOLVEMENT MATTERS **
LastQuake is a citizen science project. Your contribution helps refine our understanding of earthquake effects while fostering our support in disaster preparation and response.
** KEY FEATURES **
∘ Real-time information and data
∘ Customizable notifications (destructive earthquakes, earthquakes near you)
∘ Access to comments, photos, and videos by eyewitnesses
∘ Information-sharing via social media
∘ SMS service to notify loved ones when in the area impacted by an earthquake
∘ Post-earthquake safety tips
** WHAT'S NEW ** 
∘ Interactive felt map
∘ Customizable notification test
∘ Earthquake notification through voice synthesizer 
∘ Copy-paste available for comments
∘ Minor bugs fixed
∘ New languages available: Croatian, Czech, Bosnian, Montenegrin, Hebrew
** WHAT IS EMSC? **
EMSC is an international non-profit scientific NGO founded in 1975. Based in France, EMSC federates data from the seismological observatories of 86 institutes from 57 countries. While operating a real-time earthquake information service, EMSC advocates for public participation in scientific research. Its core product, LastQuake, paves the way for innovative approaches to building more disaster-resilient communities, making EMSC among the pioneers of disaster apps dedicated to earthquakes and tsunamis.

bluejetty:00126108:ios.name: Bus Roma
bluejetty:00126108:ios.summary:
Get around Rome with all the information you need about buses, trams, and public transport in one app.
Bus Roma lets you quickly find nearby stops, check upcoming arrivals, browse routes and lines, and plan your journey to your destination
bluejetty:00126108:ios.description:
Get around Rome with all the information you need about buses, trams, and public transport in one app.
Bus Roma lets you quickly find nearby stops, check upcoming arrivals, browse routes and lines, and plan your journey to your destination. Real-time arrivals are clearly distinguished from scheduled times.
All the information remains easy to access, with no full-screen ads interrupting your navigation.
KEY FEATURES
• Find the stops closest to your location
• Search for a stop by name, number, or address
• Check upcoming arrivals and route timetables
• Distinguish real-time arrivals from scheduled times
• Check departures for a specific date and time
• Save, reorder, and manage your favorite stops
• View service alerts for routes serving a stop
• Quickly search for buses, trams, and other public transport routes in Rome 
ROUTES, STOPS, AND VEHICLES ON THE MAP
Select a route to view all its stops, direction, and operating days. Follow the entire journey on the map and see vehicle locations whenever this information is available.
While traveling, you can activate “Announce Stops.” Bus Roma follows your progress along the route and announces the next stop aloud, even while you are using other apps.
The next stop is also displayed through Live Activities and, on compatible devices, in the Dynamic Island.
PLAN YOUR JOURNEY
Enter your starting point and destination, or use your current location. Bus Roma calculates the available travel options and shows:
• Routes to take
• Boarding and exit stops
• Any required transfers
• Walking sections
• Estimated journey time
• The complete journey on the map
• Options to leave now, depart at a specific time, or arrive by a selected time 
SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Ask Siri for upcoming arrivals at a stop or create shortcuts to quickly access the information you check most often.
Bus Roma is designed to make everyday travel on Rome’s public transport network easier, whether you regularly use the same stops or need to reach a new destination.
LOCATION INFORMATION
Location access while using the app allows Bus Roma to find nearby stops and sort them by distance. To track your journey, announce stops in the background, and automatically update the next stop, you must allow location access even when the app is not in use.
The availability of real-time arrivals, service alerts, and vehicle locations depends on the data provided by public transport services.

bluejetty:00071451:ios.description:
Check on your dog while you’re at work - know when it’s barking, talk to your dog remotely and see live video.
This is the first dog monitor app in the App Store with unlimited reach. It is a must-have for any dog owner.
EASY TO USE
With the Dog Monitor app, you can easily turn any two iOS devices into a full-featured dog monitor in a matter of seconds. No registration or connection adjustments required.
KNOW WHEN YOUR DOG BARKS
Now you can immediately find out when your dog barks. Wide sensitivity settings assure that you won’t miss any noise.
TALK TO YOUR DOG
Is your dog barking or chewing up your new shoes? Do you want to talk to him even if you’re not home? No problem. The Dog Monitor app lets you talk to your dog remotely from anywhere.
COMMANDS
"Sit", "Stay", "Lay down" record commands in your own voice and keep your dog entertained and well behaved remotely.
LIVE VIDEO STREAM
Ever wondered what your dog does when you’re away? Watch video of your pet and see what they are up to. Thanks to our adjustable light feature, you can check-in on your dog even when it is dark. Video stream requires iOS 6 or greater.
UNLIMITED REACH
You’ll always know what your dog is up to because the app works on both WiFi and cellular networks.
OTHER FEATURES
- Every Noise - sensitizes the sound for you to hear even the tiniest noises.
- Vibrate - be alerted discreetly when your dog is barking
- Reliability - app let’s you know in case the connection is lost or something goes wrong
- Security - entire connection is encrypted by SSL
NOTE: The app needs to be purchased separately for each platform. Unfortunately, there are no such tools that would allow us to transfer licenses for paid apps between the individual application stores.
See more information at www.dogmonitorapp.com
Please send your feedback to support@tappytaps.com. We love to implement new features based on your ideas!

bluejetty:00159361:ios.description:
Lava is the financial platform for bitcoin. Spend globally with Lava Card while earning bitcoin back, borrow dollars without selling your bitcoin, earn on USD, and buy or sell bitcoin in one app.
Lava Card
Spend wherever Visa is accepted, with no annual or foreign exchange fees. Fund your card with dollars or stablecoins and earn bitcoin back on every purchase, including up to 5% back with select merchants.
Bitcoin Line of Credit (BLOC)
Use your bitcoin as collateral and get instant access to dollars without selling. Lava’s BLOC offers fixed rates starting at 6.5%, no monthly payments, and open-ended terms. There are no credit checks or traditional loan paperwork.
Earn Yield on USD
Earn yield on your USD balance without locking up your money. Your dollars fund over-collateralized bitcoin-backed loans.
Buy and Sell BTC
Buy and sell bitcoin with zero fees. When you want dollars, off-ramp directly to your bank account.
Move Money Globally
Deposit and withdraw stablecoins, keep a unified USD balance, and off-ramp to bank accounts around the world.
Built for Security
Lava holds bitcoin collateral in segregated cold-storage addresses and never rehypothecates it. USD reserves are backed 1:1.
Lava has been audited by independent security experts and is backed by Khosla Ventures, Founders Fund, and Susquehanna. 
Download Lava to get started in seconds.

bluejetty:00170299:ios.description:
Elevate Your Tournament Experience with Volleyball Hub
Stop wasting time refreshing browser tabs and squinting at tiny text on complex websites. Whether you are a parent, player, coach, or referee, your tournament weekends just got a lot smoother.
Volleyball Hub is the ultimate companion for the club volleyball season, designed to put everything you need right at your fingertips. If your life revolves around the gym from Friday night to Sunday afternoon, this is the tool you’ve been waiting for.
Why Choose Volleyball Hub?
We know the drill: hunting through multiple platforms just to find a court number or a start time is frustrating. Volleyball Hub bridges the gap by pulling data from the industry's major providers—Advanced Event Systems (AES) and SportWrench—into one clean, lightning-fast interface.
Key Features to Keep You Game-Ready:
- One Dashboard, Total Control: No more jumping between different URLs. Access all your tournaments in a single, unified app.
- Favorite Your Teams: Follow your specific club teams or your favorite players. Once favorited, their schedules and results are always just one tap away.
- Live Schedules & Brackets: Get real-time updates on play schedules, court assignments, and match results. Know exactly where you need to be and when.
- Effortless Navigation: Designed for the fast-paced environment of a loud gym. Our "Couple of Taps" philosophy means you spend less time on your phone and more time cheering.
- Historical Results: Quickly look back at previous match scores and finishes to track your team's progress throughout the weekend.
Save Time. Reduce Stress.
Tournament weekends are exhausting enough. Why deal with the headache of clunky websites that aren't optimized for your phone?
Volleyball Hub is built by people who understand the sport. We’ve stripped away the clutter to give you a high-performance experience that mirrors the intensity on the court. From the first whistle of pool play to the final point of the gold medal match, stay informed and ahead of the game.
Download Volleyball Hub today and change the way you track the game!
Currently supporting all tournaments hosted via Advanced Event Systems (AES) and SportWrench.
Term of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00069768:ios.summary:
Email Me is designed to be the fastest way to record your ideas, thoughts, tasks, and follow-ups when you're on the go.
It is the easiest and fastest way to email something to yourself so you will never forget things again. Ever.
CORE FEA
bluejetty:00069768:ios.description:
Email Me is designed to be the fastest way to record your ideas, thoughts, tasks, and follow-ups when you're on the go.
It is the easiest and fastest way to email something to yourself so you will never forget things again. Ever.
CORE FEATURES AND BENEFITS
– Send notes to your email in one tap
– Send audio notes with transcriptions
– Send images from your Camera or Library in one tap
– Send your clipboard content in one tap
– Supports multiple recipients with multiple email addresses
– Supports Widgets
– Supports iOS App Extensions
– Universal App for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro
– Multiple custom App icons and themes
– Siri and Shortcuts support
– Option to use your own SMTP Configuration
AI TOOLS
– Summarize any note in one tap
– Turn a note into a task list automatically
– Translate a note into another language
– Edit any AI result with a prompt before regenerating over your changes
TRANSCRIPTION
– Transcribe your own audio notes automatically
– Transcribe WhatsApp voice notes by sharing them into the app
– Transcribe Apple Voice Memos by sharing them into the app
– On-device transcription support
SHARE EXTENSION / ACTION EXTENSION
– Share a voice note to transcribe it in one tap
– Share a link from Safari in one tap
– Share text from a website in one tap
– Share an image in one tap from the Action Extension
– Share extension supports major App Store apps
APPLE WATCH
– Standalone Watch App
– Watch App Complications for every Complication type
– Send text notes in one tap
– Send audio notes in one tap
– Send audio recordings in one tap
– Notes sent from your Watch appear in My Notes on your iPhone
MAC APP
– Standalone macOS App
– Integrates as a macOS menu bar icon
– Supports macOS Widgets
– Supports macOS Share Extension
EASY TO CONFIGURE
– Set predefined email addresses
– Set a predefined subject prefix if desired
– Set a predefined email signature if desired
– Set an email alias
– Set the reply-to email address
ACCESSIBILITY
– Accessibility labels app-wide for VoiceOver
– Supports dynamic text sizing

Dive into the world of draw puzzle games, where every swipe brings you excitement as you solve the draw and guess puzzle challenge! This isn’t just a puzzle game it's a mind-bending experience that will test your creativity. Are you ready to take on the draw one puzzle game something challenge?

In guess the drawing games, your task is simple yet thrilling: pull the right part of the picture to reveal hidden secrets! So, whether you're into draw something or prefer a drawing puzzle game, this draw the missing part game experience is sure to captivate your mind and keep you guessing. Dive into puzzle game draw it missing part, challenge yourself in guess & drawing, and immerse yourself in a unique draw the story experience!

bluejetty:00138615:ios.name: Screen Mirroring to iPad
bluejetty:00138615:ios.summary: Screen Mirroring to iPad (formerly VlogMonitor) is trusted by thousands of users around the globe, with a 4.8-star rating from 100+ ratings in the US alone. All because I’ve worked extremely hard to achieve the best quality with minimal lat
bluejetty:00138615:ios.description:
Screen Mirroring to iPad (formerly VlogMonitor) is trusted by thousands of users around the globe, with a 4.8-star rating from 100+ ratings in the US alone. All because I’ve worked extremely hard to achieve the best quality with minimal latency — leveraging my 10+ years of experience in mobile app development, with a specialization in video apps.
---
Do you love taking stunning selfies, photos, or videos? Maybe you want to make them all (just a bit) envious. :-)
VIDEO
Gain confidence shooting high-quality videos with your iPhone’s main camera — while seeing yourself live on your iPad. VlogMonitor makes it easy.
PHOTO
Take your best selfies ever using the iPhone’s main camera. Forget endless retakes — now you can see yourself in real time on your iPad.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
1. Open the app on your iPhone and tap the red button to start streaming.
2. Make sure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network. Then, on your iPad, open the app and tap the blue button to receive the stream.
3. That’s it. It just works.
SCREEN MIRRORING
Your whole iPhone screen shows up on your iPad — apps, photos, the browser, a presentation. The camera monitoring above is one thing people use it for, not the only thing.
A FEW REASONS NOT TO BUY
If you record 4K@60. Your phone cannot encode 4K at 60 FPS and mirror at the same time. 4K@30 works well, and that's what experts recommend for talking-head videos.
Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, and similar video streaming services will show a black screen. That's DRM, and no mirroring app can get past it.
BONUS
You can also connect using the iPhone’s Personal Hotspot — or a USB-C cable (if both devices support it). This makes VlogMonitor perfect for filming outdoors.
---
From creators to creators, give it a try and see the difference!

The phrase guessing party game your group will actually fight over.

Phrase Party is the fastest way to get a room laughing -- classic buzzer-style gameplay with 160+ categories, hand-picked phrases, and zero ads cluttering the fun. New in 2026: A new phrase category drops Every. Single. Week!

14-DAY ALL ACCESS PASS INCLUDED
Your purchase includes a 14-day All Access Pass -- every category, every mode, everything unlocked from day one.

160+ CATEGORIES
Movies, Pop Culture, Kids Only, Comics, Pickleball, Bitcoin, Adult themes, Holidays, and way more. Mix and match or go full chaos and pick "Everything".

MULTIPLE GAME MODES
- Classic: race the buzzer with your team.
- Party Heads: phone on your forehead, friends give hints, tilt to pass or guess -- total chaos, guaranteed.
- Hint Sprint: built for Zoom, FaceTime, or any video call.
- AI Solo: AI-generated fill-in-the-blank hints keep you guessing. Nail a phrase, add time to the clock. How long can you go?

AI-POWERED, but HUMAN FOCUSED
Don't like our phrases? Use the built-in AI to generate entirely new categories on demand. Endless content, personalized to your crowd. 
Built in phrases are human curated for human fun.

VIDEO RECAP
Watch a highlight reel of your game after you play. Cringe. Share. Repeat.

MAKE IT YOURS
Add your own phrases and categories. Share custom packs with friends. Use AI to generate new ones. Tweak settings to fit your crowd.

NO ADS. NO REPEATS. NO SPELLING ERRORS.
This version includes 35 unrestricted categories with the full app experience and zero ads. The remaining bonus content is unlocked via subscription.

17+ YEARS OF UPDATES
New phrases and improvements every single month since day one. No other app in this category comes close.

---
Phrase Party gameplay is inspired by Catch Phrase by Hasbro Inc. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Hasbro.

Microsoft To Do is the task m
bluejetty:00178885:ios.description:
Stay organized and manage your day-to-day with Microsoft To Do. Make shopping lists or task lists, take notes, record collections, set reminders and more to improve your productivity and focus on what matters.
Microsoft To Do is the task management app that makes it easy to stay organized and manage your life. Accomplish what’s important to you each day with My Day and Suggestions, personalized day planner tools. Intelligent suggestions recommend tasks from across your lists that may be relevant each day.
Quickly capture and retrieve your lists and tasks across devices by syncing reminders and tasks with Microsoft 365 to access them anywhere. For lists in personal accounts, you can collaborate with anyone with updated notifications for any changes to your to-do lists.
Capture tasks from different Microsoft apps and services and sync them with Microsoft To Do, from flagging emails as tasks in Outlook to lists from Cortana. Your tasks and lists are hosted securely on the Microsoft 365 service.
Make your lists unique with customizable features like emoji, colorful themes, dark mode and more. Stay connected and collaborate with friends and family by sharing lists that stay synced as changes are made.
Microsoft To Do Features:
Daily planner
• Stay focused with My Day, a personalized daily planner with suggested tasks
• Get your lists anywhere, on any device
• Share your list with anyone and work together 
• Add notes to any task
Task manager
• Share lists and tasks with your friends, family, colleagues, and classmates
• Get notified when others create, complete or remove tasks in shared lists
• Personalize your lists by choosing theme colors or backgrounds
• Set one-time or recurring due dates and reminders
• Break your tasks into manageable steps
• Attach up to 25MB of files to any task
To-do lists for any purpose
• Bill planner
• Shopping lists
• Set reminders
• Task management
• Business calendar
• Note taking
• And more
Microsoft 365 Integration
• Sync your tasks between Outlook and To Do
• Host lists and tasks with the reliability and security of Microsoft 365
• Compile tasks from across your Microsoft 365 apps and services
Whether it's for work, school, or home, To Do helps you organize and simplify your plans. To Do is free and available on all your devices.
Learn more: https://to-do.microsoft.com
Follow us on Twitter: @MicrosoftToDo
Have an idea or feature suggestion? https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2171952
Need support? https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2156547
By installing Microsoft To Do, you agree to the Microsoft Terms of Use: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=842575

bluejetty:00187612:ios.description:
Guestplan is a 360° restaurant reservation system with easy-to-navigate features that support online reservations, table management, floor plans, and more.
Discover the most complete and powerful app on the market for managing table reservations at your restaurant.
Beautiful, fast, and easy to use on every iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch.
Download Guestplan for free. Sign in to your Guestplan account and explore the world's greatest table reservation system on iOS.
• Exclusively for iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch
• Manage all your table reservations, guest information, call-ahead seating lists, and walk-ins
• At the restaurant entrance, in the kitchen, behind the bar, at the office, or anywhere in the world
• Automatically synchronized across all your iOS devices
• Even when offline, you can still access everything fully
• Drag 'n drop reservations and optimize your table plan
• Online availability will be managed automatically
• Manage manually to close, open, or adjust availability according to your rules
• Accept online reservations from your website and Google without commissions or booking fees
• Utilize our professional white-label reservation widget according to your rules and preferred look and feel
• Create your own reservation widget using our Open API
• Send customized emails and mobile messages with a personal touch to confirm reservations
• Messages can be sent automatically or manually.
Begin today and discover the world's greatest table reservation system for your restaurant.
About Us
We are your supplier.
We are not a booking site or agency. We believe that you do not want to use a reservation management system owned by a commercial booking site. And that makes a difference. eTender Guestplan was founded in 2006, two years before it was developed for a renowned restaurant in Amsterdam.
In a world of hyper-venture-capital-fueled startups, eTender Guestplan was built for the long term. We pay our bills and fund new developments with the revenue from our products, and we've been profitable since day one. Thanks to all our great users, we build exceptional reservation systems.
We are clear about what we believe in and how we act. We are grateful for your trust and are committed to meeting your wishes and needs.
Feedback
Review us. We value your feedback.
To enhance our app for your restaurant, please review us on the App Store.
Support
Do you need assistance?
Contact us at support@guestplan.com.
For urgent matters, prioritize sending your email with high priority.
Information
Contact us at hello@guestplan.com for general inquiries.
