Because you have—your amazing travel compani
bluejetty:00082229:ios.description:
You, the super cool person with an old wagon, always planned to hit the road—don’t know how to drive?! But this doesn’t affect your enthusiasm for unknown journeys and camping all over the world!
Because you have—your amazing travel companion, Muffin, who’s the best driver (and master of ‘accidentally’ causing trouble), the most unique (and laziest), and incredibly righteous (yet sharp-tongued) buddy from Midgard. Together, you’re about to embark on a relaxed, heartwarming, and fantastical journey through another world! 
——Hey, wait! He’s the one who insisted on tagging along to the end of the world (…?) ——
…Anyway...one person and one cat (?) embark on a journey to the world’s end! Of course, the relaxed journey will be filled with small challenges and fascinating adventures, but with comrades met along the way, you can engage in stress-free battles, experience the joy of growth, and watch the night stars by the campfire…
There’s no time to waste! Grab Muffin, jump into the wagon, and embark on this relaxed, cozy adventure through another world!"
[Connect With Puppies, Say Hi!] 
Maltese has come to the world of Muffin?! The popular IP "Maltese" has its first game collaboration coming~ Free limited themed outfits transform you into a puppy to cozy up your friends! The "Maltese" and the "Retriever" with join the adventure squad, the Paw Patrol is gathering!
[In a Party of Two, Anytime, Anywhere, ME&YOU] 
With you and me, the journey is never lonely! Duo team up to form an adventure squad; whether you’re a casual player or a game master, teaming up freely and effortlessly anytime and anywhere!
[Relax & Idle, Ride in a Wagon and enjoy the view] 
Enjoy afk earnings with idle gameplay. Growing stronger only requires some free time to unlock your phone, and check out new gear, and feed your adorable Melomons. But if you take a moment to immerse yourself in the journey, you’ll encounter a variety of stunning landscapes, with light and shadows shifting from dawn to dusk, across the vast world. The story notes from your travels will leave you deeply captivated.
[Camp & Social, Lit a bonfire, chat and chill] 
Hey adventurer, it must have been a tough day. Come by the campfire and enjoy a cup of hot cocoa! Travelers from all over the world are here—so why not share your latest experiences and stories with them?
[With your Pets, Grow Together, Guard Each Other] 
The unique pet "Melomon" is drawn by the adventurer's melody; they aren't just great companions for adventurers, but can also fight alongside you in battle —how cool is that, my partner!

Tired of guessing calories o
bluejetty:00152920:ios.description:
Panda Cal: Your AI food tracker simply. Take a photo of your meal and easily record the calorie intake. With a smart, fun, and super cute Panda to accompany you, fitness and weight loss will not become a burden.
Tired of guessing calories or juggling complicated food logs? Panda Cal makes it effortless:
■ AI Snap and Macro Tracking
Instant Food Recognition: Just snap a photo of your meal. Our smart AI instantly estimates your calories, protein, carbs, and fats. No endless manual typing required.
Seamless Food Diary: Log every meal, healthy snack, or cheat-day indulgence in seconds.
Goal-Driven Dashboard: Set your custom target—lose fat, build muscle, or stay balanced—and track your macro progress with crystal clarity.
■ Smart Intermittent Fasting
Popular Fasting Plans: Choose from 16:8, 5:2, Circadian Rhythm, or customize your own fasting window to boost your metabolism.
Intuitive Fasting Timer: Track your fasts effortlessly with clear visual reminders and milestone alerts.
Smart Insights: Learn how fasting affects your body and fat-burning phases throughout the day.
■ Personalized Meal Plans and Recipes
Tailored Diet Plans: Get a personalized meal plan based on your fitness goals, dietary preferences (Keto, Low-Carb, Vegan, etc.), and calorie budget.
Healthy and Easy Recipes: Explore hundreds of delicious, macro-friendly recipes. Perfect for meal prep, cutting, or clean eating.
Smart Shopping List: Turn your meal plans into an organized grocery list with a single tap.
■ Meet Your Adorably Hungry Panda Sidekick!
Who said getting fit has to be a chore? Your food butler is a super-cute, playful panda with a massive appetite, ready to cheer you on through every bite and fasting window—no judgment, just pure fun!
Your Ultimate "Foodie" Buddy: Browse mouth-watering recipes or log your meals together! When the AI recognizes a delicious dish, your panda will dance, celebrate, and act happy right along with you. It is always hyped for your next meal!
The Ultimate Fasting Hype-Man: Starting your Intermittent Fasting timer? Your panda jumps into "fasting mode" too! Instead of being sad or grumpy, it shows hilarious, high-energy animations—scratching its head, acting goofy, and doing cute tricks to help distract you from the cravings.
Friendly Check-In Reminders: Missed a couple of days? No harsh scolding or guilt trips here! Your panda companion will just pop up with a playful, friendly nudge, reminding you that it is ready for the next food adventure whenever you are.
Track smarter, eat better, smile more, and hit your fitness goals with a panda cheering you on every step of the way.
DISCLAIMER:
Panda Cal provides insights into how different foods, fasting plans, and products may affect your body, but it is not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any medical conditions. Panda Cal is not a medical device or app. Always consult with a healthcare professional before starting any radical fasting or diet plan.
Privacy Policy: https://novopics-creator.com/calories/privacy
Terms of Service: https://novopics-creator.com/calories/terms
Contact Us: support@novopics-creator.com
Download Panda Cal today. Your goals (and your hungry panda) are waiting!

bluejetty:00133553:ios.description:
New free to play puzzles, brain teasers and mini-games of Halloween Chronicles: Cursed Family Collector's Edition where you need to solve mystery, seek and find hidden puzzle and win the scary games! This game has no plot differences with the original puzzle, and its main feature is that you can play the entire hidden objects quest for free!
It’s Halloween Eve, and you’re hurrying to your uncle’s fair to play games! But the family reunion with distant relatives the Sullivans ends in a disaster when you realize that an evil vampire named Walter started a hunt on them all, including you! The Lord of the Monsters, he wants to release his loyal servants from the basement of the Sullivan mansion. Can you disenchant your aunt, save your nephew and find the missing nieces to make sure they’re safe? Unite with you Uncle Pierre - an illusionist and secret magician – who will reveal the unknown mysteries and chilling details about your family!

Pass your GED exam and earn your high school diploma with confidence! The GED Practice Test app helps you study smarter with realistic questions, detailed explanations, and AI-powered learning assistance tailored to your needs. Designed for adult learners and students preparing for high school equivalency, this app covers every GED subject — Math, Science, Social Studies, and Reasoning Through Language Arts — helping you build the skills and confidence to pass. 
Our GED exam prep questions are categorized into various topics:
• Mathematical Reasoning
• Reasoning Through Language Arts
• Social Studies
• Science
**Why You’ll Love This App**
- Realistic GED Practice Tests: Take practice exams that mirror the official GED test. Cover all sections including Math, Reading, Writing, Science, and Social Studies with accurate question types and real test difficulty.
- Study by Subject: Focus on one subject at a time to strengthen weak areas. Each topic includes step-by-step explanations and references to reinforce key concepts.
- AI Mentor – Smart Study Assistant: Learn faster with Mentora, your AI tutor. Get instant explanations, personalized feedback, and practical study tips designed to boost your understanding and retention.
- Custom & Diagnostic Tests: Start with a diagnostic test to identify your current level, then create custom tests to target specific subjects or skills that need improvement.
- Detailed Explanations & References: Understand why each answer is correct or incorrect with in-depth rationales that help you master every concept before test day.
- Progress Tracking & Analytics: Monitor your performance and passing probability for each subject. See how your skills improve over time with easy-to-read charts and progress indicators.
**Designed for GED Success: Whether you’re preparing for your first attempt or retaking the exam, this app helps you study efficiently and pass with confidence.
Start Your GED Journey Today! Download the GED Practice Test app now and take your first step toward achieving your high school diploma.

bluejetty:00077965:ios.summary:
ZKB TWINT, the Swiss payment app.

One app, many advantages:
- Fast: Send, receive and request
bluejetty:00077965:ios.description:
ZKB TWINT, the Swiss payment app.
With ZKB TWINT, Zürcher Kantonalbank’s free payment app, you can pay conveniently and securely at the checkout, in online shops or among friends.
One app, many advantages:
- Fast: Send, receive and request money around the clock in real time – from smartphone to smartphone.
- Convenient Easy payment in online shops, at supermarket checkouts, in canteens and at vending machines.
- Straightforward: Register in just a few steps using the ZKB Mobile Banking app or ZKB Visa Debit Card.
- Free of charge: Using ZKB TWINT is free of charge; no transaction fees are incurred.
- Secure: Access the app using a six-digit numerical code (PIN), fingerprint (Touch ID) or face recognition (Face ID). ZKB TWINT also fully meets the security standards of Swiss banks.
- Simple: Debits are charged directly to your bank account. The app does not have to be topped up with money first.
- Widely accepted: Whether among friends, at tills, in restaurants or online shops – you have everything you need with Switzerland's leading payment app.
- Flexible: The ZKB TWINT app shows you the current limits and the amount still available. You can adjust your limits yourself with just a few taps, with immediate effect.
- Transparent: Thanks to the full-text search, you can quickly find your ZKB TWINT transactions in the history section – you can search by contact, merchant name, telephone number or message.
One app, many functions:
- Send and request money: ZKB TWINT allows you to transfer money in real time – simply from smartphone to smartphone. And you can request and receive amounts from friends or family members. Adding a photo and a few nice words allows you to make your message personal and friendly.
- Pay simply and conveniently: ZKB TWINT lets you pay in online shops, at supermarket tills, in canteens and at vending machines.
- Twint parking fees: Start the parking process directly from the app or scan the QR code on the parking meter and select the desired parking time. Practical: If you return earlier than planned, simply cancel the parking time and the outstanding amount will be refunded to you.
- Donate: With ZKB TWINT, you can pay for your donation to numerous organisations directly from the app.
- Withdraw cash: Using your ZKB TWINT app, you can withdraw cash in over 2,300 shops such as K Kiosks, Volg, pharmacies, fuel stations or restaurants.
- Digital vouchers and credits: Buy digital vouchers and credits for your favourite shops quickly and at any time. Display the code directly or access it at any time via ZKB TWINT. You can also pass on the voucher code directly via email.
- Buy public transport tickets: Simply save ZKB TWINT in your public transport app as your preferred payment method or pay via QR code at vending machines or in online shops.
- Super deals: Every week, you can find especially attractive deals that are only available in the TWINT app.
Easy registration:
1. Install ZKB TWINT on your smartphone
2. Register using the ZKB Mobile Banking app or ZKB Visa Debit Card
3. Twint and benefit from the many advantages
Requirements:
- Possession of a cell phone number with the country code Switzerland (+41), Germany (+49), France (+33), Liechtenstein (+423), Italy (+39) or Austria (+43) and a Swiss residential address
- A smartphone with the following minimum operating system versions: iOS 15.0 or newer
- Own transaction account with Zürcher Kantonalbank in Swiss francs, such as a ZKB Private Account or ZKB Private Account Young. Linking with a ZKB corporate account is not possible.
- Active ZKB Mobile Banking on the same device or a ZKB Visa Debit Card issued in your name
- Internet access
- Minimum age: 10 years
Further information:
www.zkb.ch/twint
Zürcher Kantonalbank eBanking: www.zkb.ch/ebanking

The Louisiana Lottery Official App gives YOU the Power to Play Your Way! Here’s how:
It’s a Ticket Checker!
Scan the barcode on the front of your draw-style and scratch-off game tickets with your device's camera to determine whether it is a winner and the amount of the win! Results are saved as a reminder to cash in and are updated as future drawings occur on multidraw tickets. 
It’s a Virtual Mobile Playslip!
Prepare your own digital playslips – any time, any place – and save them for when you are ready to purchase. Because your play selections and the ticket cost are available before you reach checkout, your purchase experience is transparent and effortless when your ticket is created at retail.
Fun, New Ways to Choose Numbers!
Personalize your play with fun, unique ways to select your draw-style game numbers, including quick-pick, self-selection, using saved favorite numbers, rolling the dice, shaking your phone, or using statistics of winning number frequency over the last year. 
Features:
– Scan your own tickets with your device’s camera to see if they are winners and the amount of the win. (Note: Original tickets are still needed to claim a prize.)
– Save time by creating and saving your own digital playslips that can be scanned on your device to create actual tickets for purchase at licensed Louisiana Lottery retailers.
– Add, edit and save plays to digital playslips using app-exclusive ways like saved favorite numbers and winning number frequency outcomes.
– Locate the closest Louisiana Lottery retailer to purchase your tickets or redeem winning tickets.

bluejetty:00144000:ios.name: maxim: order a taxi & delivery
bluejetty:00144000:ios.summary: The best way to appreciate the convenience of our app is to download it and start using it to order a taxi and other transport. Rates vary. Ride to the railway station, airport, or another city. Pay by cash or card. Enjoy discounts and prom
bluejetty:00144000:ios.description:
The best way to appreciate the convenience of our app is to download it and start using it to order a taxi and other transport. Rates vary. Ride to the railway station, airport, or another city. Pay by cash or card. Enjoy discounts and promo codes.
Since 2003, we’ve been developing innovative taxi ordering technologies, making our service more modern, affordable, and safe. Our service is helping millions of people save money as they commute and travel.
Price
If you need a cheap taxi every day, choose our Economy rate. If you value comfort, opt for the Comfort rate. We also have minivans, buses, and trucks. You can order a delivery of food, household cleaning products and other goods or medicine from shops and drugstores.
You can see your ride price before tapping the Order button, which is useful for planning your budget. Don’t worry about traffic – you only pay extra for additional services that were not specified in the order.
Enjoy the convenience of paying for rides with cash and a credit card. You can use a personal account that you refill whenever necessary for corporate or family rides.
It’s easy to get discounted rides if you use a promo code or you are one of our regular clients.
Order
You can order a ride by filling in the From and To address fields or using a city map. You can also use your smartphone’s or tablet’s location services.
A scheduled order helps you plan your rides for a convenient time.
You can provide special requests for your ride to arrange any necessary additional services: specify information about children, pets, or luggage; or add another phone number to order a taxi for someone else from your phone.
A driver can buy goods, medicine or groceries, and deliver them to your place.
Launch our app on Wear OS smart watch to track your ride status.
View a map to see available cars and your driver’s movement as he or she approaches your location.
You can share your location while you are en route. This is an important feature for parents who want to know their children are safe.
Leaving a ride rating affects the driver’s rating and helps us improve our service.
Countries
Argentina, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Brazil, Cambodia, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Laos, Malaysia, Peru, Philippines, Russia, South Africa, Tajikistan, Tanzania, Thailand, Uzbekistan, Vanuatu, Vietnam

bluejetty:00180646:ios.name: eBird
bluejetty:00180646:ios.summary: eBird Mobile makes it easy to record the birds you see in the field, and seamlessly link these observations with eBird--a global online database of bird records used by hundreds of thousands of birders around the world. This free resource m
bluejetty:00180646:ios.description:
eBird Mobile makes it easy to record the birds you see in the field, and seamlessly link these observations with eBird--a global online database of bird records used by hundreds of thousands of birders around the world. This free resource makes it easy to keep track of what you see, while making your data openly available for scientific research, education, and conservation. eBird Mobile is the only app that passes information directly from the iOS device to your eBird account on the web.
Features
- Enter bird observations from any location around the world.
- Full global taxonomy based on The Clements Checklist of Birds of the World.
- Common names available in local languages (e.g., Portuguese names in Brazil or in Portugal).
- Checklists customized for your location and time of year, showing most likely species based on eBird data. 
- Rare species flagged during data entry and on the checklist. 
- "Record as you go" functionality for incremental list keeping and counting while birding.
- GPS enabled location plotting to ensure accuracy.
- Map tools that enable selecting from hundreds of thousands of eBird "Hotspots."
- Full offline functionality, enabling use in places with limited or no Internet connection.
- Trip and Day list functionality that makes it easy to keep track of your species list on a particular outing.
- Support for iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch.
- Entire app translated to German, Mandarin, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish, and Dutch.

bluejetty:00034845:ios.description:
HOW TO USE NUTRINAUT:
Nutrinaut works best when connected to a wearable (Apple Watch, Garmin, smart rings, and more) - but you can also use it without one
- Answer a few quick lifestyle questions to personalize your baseline
- Check your daily Strain, Recovery, and Sleep insights *
- Follow simple guidance on whether to push today or take it easier *
- Log optional Tags (life events like coffee, late meal, fatigue, stress, good mood) to unlock deeper insights over time *
Nutrinaut helps you understand how your body is responding to training and life - so you can make better decisions each day. Built for active people who want clarity, Nutrinaut turns your health signals into simple, actionable guidance: when to push, when to recover, and how to improve sleep and stress.
DAILY STRAIN AND RECOVERY GUIDANCE
Know when your body is ready to perform - and when it’s not. Nutrinaut analyzes your recent load and recovery signals to provide a clear daily read on intensity. You’ll get simple guidance like whether today is best for a hard session, a moderate workout, or an easy recovery day.
DEEP SLEEP INSIGHTS
Sleep is your biggest performance lever. Nutrinaut breaks down your sleep in a way that’s easy to understand, highlighting what matters most and how it impacts your next day. Track trends, spot issues early, and build better sleep habits with practical guidance.
STRESS AND READINESS SIGNALS
Training isn’t the only stress your body deals with. Nutrinaut helps you see how overall stress patterns may affect readiness, recovery, and sleep quality - and points you toward adjustments that can reduce burnout risk over time.
FOOD PHOTO LOGGING (OPTIONAL)
Nutrition supports performance and recovery. If you want it, Nutrinaut also lets you snap a photo of your meal to get a quick nutritional breakdown, making it easier to stay consistent without turning your day into spreadsheets.
* Premium features require a paid subscription. This includes (where available) strain/recovery/sleep guidance, deeper analysis and advice, and premium logging features such as taking photos of food for nutritional breakdown, recording workouts, tracking sports supplements, and getting calories from voice recording.
Key Features:
- Strain and Recovery: Daily signals and guidance for training intensity.
- Sleep Analysis: Clear breakdowns and practical sleep improvement insights.
- Stress Insights: Understand patterns that may impact readiness and recovery.
- Food Photo Tracking: Optional meal snapshots with nutritional breakdown.
- Voice Logging: Log meals and workouts with natural language.
- Clean, Fast UI: Designed for quick check-ins, not endless manual entry.
NOTE: We do not provide medical advice. All recommendations should be considered suggestions. Be sure to consult a professional and do your own research before making decisions related to your health.
Terms of Service: https://nutrinaut.app/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://nutrinaut.app/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00146226:ios.description:
Hot speed, cold security.
NGRAVE LIQUID is the companion app of NGRAVE ZERO, The Coldest Wallet.
Your private keys stay offline on your ZERO, while LIQUID connects you to the blockchain in real time. 
You need a ZERO to sync your wallets and sign transactions.
ANTI-TAMPERING FRAMEWORK
The ZERO and the LIQUID only communicate via secured one-way verifiable QR codes that contain no secret information. From your ZERO, LIQUID only receives public information, such as your addresses. Your private keys remain secret in ZERO.
WITH LIQUID YOU CAN
• Track your crypto in real time, with price charts in your preferred currency
• Send and receive crypto: prepare in LIQUID, review and sign offline on your ZERO
• Sync multiple ZEROs and Passphrase wallets, name them and move funds between them
• View and send your Ethereum NFTs, or use one as a wallet avatar
NGRAVE ZERO: THE COLDEST WALLET
• Air-gapped: signs transactions without USB, Bluetooth, NFC, Wi-Fi or mobile data, only via QR codes
• EAL7: its secure operating system achieved EAL7, the highest level of Common Criteria security certification
• Tamper-proof: four layers of tamper protection, plus fingerprint and 8-digit PIN
• Made in Belgium
SUPPORTED ASSETS
Bitcoin (BTC), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Ethereum (ETH), Dash (DASH), Zcash (ZEC), Litecoin (LTC), BNB Smart Chain (BNB), XRP (XRP), Dogecoin (DOGE), Tezos (XTZ), MultiversX (EGLD), Solana (SOL), Polygon (POL), Avalanche (AVAX) and Stellar (XLM), plus all ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum and all ESDT tokens on MultiversX.
Learn more at www.ngrave.io or contact support@ngrave.io.

bluejetty:00122395:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00122395:ios.description:
400 Arba3meyeh (four hundred) is an Arabic trick-taking multiplayer card game played in two partnerships, with trumps and bidding. Played in Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan, and Iraq. Also known as forty-one (41).
The first team to accumulate 41 points or more wins; points are acquired by winning at least the number of tricks bid in each hand, where each trick bid is worth one point. Cards rank: A K Q J 10 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2.
Each player decides how much to bid (minimum is 2), and no player may pass. Hearts are always trump. The total sum of all 4 bids needs to be at least 11, if not, cards will be dealt again. If a player’s score is 30-39 his minimum bid becomes 3, and the total will be 12; if the score is 40-49 his minimum bid becomes 4, the total number of bids must equal 13, and so on. Each bid is independent of the partner’s bid in a hand.
Each hand consists of several tricks, 13 per player. Once the first card is played, players must follow suit, if possible. The trick is won by the player who plays the highest trump, or, if no triumph was played, by the player who played the highest card in the suit led. The player that wins the trick leads next. This continues until there are no cards left.
The player scores 1 point for each trick won. If a player doesn't win the number of tricks they bid, they will lose that amount of points. Bidding for a higher amount of tricks results in a higher value of points, as follows: 2-4 tricks results in 1 point per trick, 5-8 tricks double the number of points per trick, 9-10 tricks triple the number of points per trick and 11-12 tricks equals 4 times the number of points per trick. With 13 tricks you win big or lose 52 points.
Play on your mobile phone or tablet with your friends live from home or wherever you are with the online 400 Arba3meyeh app from ConectaGames! 
You can find more information on our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/playfourhundred
Terms and conditions of use: https://conectagames.com/terms_policies/?type=TC&lang=en

bluejetty:00074230:ios.summary: Tempo, the premier metronome app for iOS is now available as this free Lite version. Tempo was featured as "New and Noteworthy" and "Staff Favorite" by Apple on the main iTunes landing page. Now you can enjoy Tempo's core features before up
bluejetty:00074230:ios.description:
Tempo, the premier metronome app for iOS is now available as this free Lite version. Tempo was featured as "New and Noteworthy" and "Staff Favorite" by Apple on the main iTunes landing page. Now you can enjoy Tempo's core features before upgrading to its full suite of features. 
Tempo Lite's engine is written from the ground up for high accuracy and stability. It keeps going even in device lock mode, making it a useful aid for live drumming. 
As a special treat, we've included the Tracker Module which helps in your practices by tracking the number of bars or time played. 
As opposed to purchasing Tempo, upgrading Tempo Lite nets you a dark colour scheme for the flipside views (instead of light). 
Visit www.frozenape.com for demo videos. 
Features Summary 
Configuration 
• 8 different time signatures: 1-4/4, 3/8, 6/8, 9/8, 12/8 
• 6 rhythm patterns for simple meters and 3 for compound meters 
• Customize accents or turn beats off to create more complex rhythms 
• Tap tempo function 
• Tempo ranges from 10 to 800 
Display 
• Visual feedback in the form of pulsating LEDs 
• Two pendulum types, each with two animation types 
• Flash whole screen 
Tracker and Automator Module
• Track number of bars played or time your practice
• Coach Mode alternates between unmuted and muted bars.
• Stop playback automatically when limit reached
• Automatic adjustment of tempo every n number of bars or n amount of time
Sound 
• Choose from 4 sound sets: Digital, Analog, Blip and Wooden 
• Volume control and Mute button
Miscellaneous 
• Classical metronome and Italian tempo markings 
• Multi-tasking support: plays in background with audio from other apps 
• Two interface themes: Light and Dark

bluejetty:00094421:ios.description:
FANS is the world's safest on-device Instagram unfollow tracker for iPhone and iPad. Import your official Instagram ZIP to see who doesn’t follow you back—without entering your password or connecting your account. Your follower and following lists are analyzed on your device.
Designed for account safety, FANS works only from official data exports you download. No Instagram logins, passwords, cookies, scraping, account connections, or automation.
FANS has successfully helped with more than 1,000,000 Instagram unfollows and counting.
Why FANS is Different
Most unfollower trackers ask you to log into Instagram, putting your account at risk of bans or restrictions. FANS uses your official export to keep the process private and secure.
How It Works (A Guided Import Experience)
1. Export your Instagram data as JSON or HTML from Instagram's official Accounts Center. Unlike JSON-only trackers, FANS supports both.
• Only FANS preselects Format and Date Range to prevent common export errors, with a picture-in-picture video guiding every step.
2. Import your ZIP to see your results in FANS.
• Shows import progress through a Live Activity, even while the import continues in the background.
• Processes large exports with memory-optimized, native iOS performance.
Features
• Who Doesn't Follow You Back: Shows who isn't following you back in a few taps.
• No Instagram Login: FANS never asks for your Instagram login.
• Supports public and private accounts of any follower size.
• No Ads, No Spam: A clean, fast, secure experience.
What FANS Can Track
• Actual Unfollowers: Shows who stopped following you since your previous export.
• They Don't Follow Back: Shows accounts you follow that don't follow you back.
Accurate Results Across Exports
• Only FANS detects likely deactivated accounts, separating inactive accounts from actual unfollows.
• Compares new exports with a local baseline to detect actual unfollowers and new non-followers.
• Detects username changes to reduce false unfollow results.
• Identifies new unfollows, new non-followers, likely deactivations, and username changes with colored tags.
• Supports multiple Instagram accounts.
• Shows usernames, Instagram display names, verification status, and rich profile pictures.
Why Trust FANS?
• Your Data Stays on Your Device: FANS stores comparison data locally and never uploads your follower or following lists to our servers.
• No third-party logins, unofficial Instagram APIs, or exposed credentials.
• Designed for Compliance: Official Instagram exports, no scraping or automation.
What is the safest Instagram unfollow tracker on iPhone?
FANS is a privacy-first tracker using Instagram's official Download Your Information export. No password sharing, scraping, or risky automation.
How can I check who doesn't follow me back without logging in?
Export your Instagram data → open FANS → import the JSON or HTML ZIP → see who doesn't follow you back.
Does FANS break Instagram's Terms of Use?
No. FANS uses your official export without logging in, requesting passwords, using cookies, scraping, or automating actions. FANS is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.
Is my data uploaded to a server?
No. Your follower and following data is processed and preserved locally for accurate comparisons.
Does it work for private accounts?
Yes. FANS supports public and private accounts using your own export.
Can FANS track unfollows over time?
Yes. Import a new export to compare it with data stored on your device and identify unfollowers and new non-followers.
FANS is the best Instagram unfollow tracker (no login) for users searching terms like "who unfollowed me on Instagram iPhone," "Instagram unfollow checker no password," "see who doesn't follow back safely," and "IG unfollower app iOS."
*To reveal all unfollowers, a Pro subscription is required.
*By using FANS, you agree to the Terms (https://fans.walter-labs.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://fans.walter-labs.com/policy)

bluejetty:00171774:ios.name: Stardew Valley Tracker & Guide
bluejetty:00171774:ios.summary: Tired of missing birthdays, forgetting bundle items, or chasing villagers around Stardew Valley? The Stardew Valley Tracker is your ultimate companion guide, helping you maximize your farm life with intelligent planning and essential tools.
bluejetty:00171774:ios.description:
Tired of missing birthdays, forgetting bundle items, or chasing villagers around Stardew Valley? The Stardew Valley Tracker is your ultimate companion guide, helping you maximize your farm life with intelligent planning and essential tools. Never miss a festival, forget a gift, or struggle to find a crucial item again.
KEY FEATURES
• SMART CALENDAR & SEASON PLANNER — Plan your entire season at a glance with the smart calendar. Get daily reminders for birthdays, festivals, the Traveling Cart, Queen of Sauce recipes, and crop harvest deadlines. Add custom notes and build your personal to-do list for efficient farm management.
• VILLAGER SCHEDULES & GIFT GUIDE — Stop chasing villagers! Check their exact location at any time. View detailed profiles including relationships, preferred gifts, and daily routines, making friendship a breeze. This villager tracker ensures you always know where to find who you need.
• COMMUNITY CENTER CHECKLIST — Effortlessly track every bundle with an easy checklist. See exactly which items you're missing and where to find them. Full support for Remixed Bundles means you're always prepared.
• COMPLETE COLLECTIONS DATABASE — Dive into a comprehensive database for all your collections. Track fish (seasons, locations, weather), crops (growing info, profit calculations), artifacts & minerals (locations, drop rates), cooking recipes (ingredients, buffs), and shipping for 100% completion.
• GINGER ISLAND & STARDROPS TRACKER — Find and track all 130 Golden Walnuts with detailed guides for each location on Ginger Island. Keep tabs on all 7 precious Stardrops and how to obtain them. This progress tracker covers every corner of your Stardew Valley adventure.
• OFFLINE ACCESS & MULTIPLE FARMS — Works completely offline, so your companion is always with you, no matter where you are in the valley. Support for multiple farm saves means you can track different game files separately. Enjoy dark mode and support for 12 languages.
Stardew Valley Tracker stands out as the most complete and user-friendly companion app available. With a solid rating from multiple reviews, our app is already helping countless farmers streamline their gameplay and achieve their Stardew Valley goals. Its clean, simple design makes managing your farm a delightful experience.

Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AlfiEsf1nSxgnNmlk5nrqnUVBBN3gD8IM5kqWPc18AU/preview?tab=t.0

bluejetty:00099672:ios.summary:

独居京都的tsuki：擅长日系风格的小猫，爱独处，不喜欢吵闹，目前在京都独居，空闲时喜欢坐在鸭川边看着流水梳理思绪，会在深夜看着天花板思考宇宙的意义
建筑系在读小狗拉尔夫：擅长严谨的北欧风格，理性冷静，崇尚简洁，生活里最介意的事，是电视机没有和墙面平行对齐，生活像拉尔夫的设计风格一样极简且充满秩序

bluejetty:00099672:ios.description:
排版事务所，目前有8位小动物，他们是：
独居京都的tsuki：擅长日系风格的小猫，爱独处，不喜欢吵闹，目前在京都独居，空闲时喜欢坐在鸭川边看着流水梳理思绪，会在深夜看着天花板思考宇宙的意义
建筑系在读小狗拉尔夫：擅长严谨的北欧风格，理性冷静，崇尚简洁，生活里最介意的事，是电视机没有和墙面平行对齐，生活像拉尔夫的设计风格一样极简且充满秩序
环球旅行家路易：收集了各地的明信片，总是在路上的小信鸽，每到新的地方都会收藏当地的明信片，热衷于分享新鲜见闻，世界对路易来说是个蕴含无限可能的快乐星球
编辑部里的老师傅：擅长老风格的乌龟师傅，是在编辑部里干了一辈子的老学究，喜欢一切足够老的东西，用古老的钢笔写字，用陈旧的钟表掌握时间，年代久远的文集翻了一遍又一遍
重大时刻才出现的教导主任：一只北极熊主任，说话简短，走路时喜欢双手背在身后，虽然只在重要时刻出现，但内心似乎不像外表一样严厉，重要的事可以交给主任来公布，比如奖状和通知
活在童年的小象亮亮：活在千禧年世界里，亮亮的房间像时光机摆满了小时候的回忆，喜欢把珍藏的糖纸折成小花，可以的话，愿意一辈子活在童年的世界
爱长跑的杂志社主编：热爱长跑的小羊迈尔斯，喜欢所有长期的事物，比起速度，更在乎马拉松式的重复和坚持
酷酷的小学生kaka：擅长在本上乱涂乱画，「鱼为什么要生活在水里呢？」爱在课上思考些无关紧要的问题，美术老师教 kaka 用画笔记录，于是作业本上满是奇思妙想
通过小动物，你可以把你的心情、生活、书摘、随感记录下来，排版成为不同风格的卡片，保存或转发给朋友
你还可以把不同动物的卡片，收集在不同动物的纸箱，留作个人记录和归档希望这些动物朋友，与你相遇相处愉快！
更多小伙伴，还在路上：）
使用反馈，欢迎随时发给hi@tinytypezoo.com

bluejetty:00073442:ios.description:
Plan, pay and travel around London with TfL Go, Transport for London's official app.
Built specifically for London, TfL Go combines live travel information with detailed knowledge of the TfL network to help you get around the city.
Plan journeys, check live arrivals and disruptions, track buses, find accessible routes, explore by bike or on foot, and manage your Oyster and contactless travel — all in one app.
Find the Best Route
We'll suggest multiple ways to get to your destination, whether by Tube, London Overground, Elizabeth line, DLR, Tram, National Rail, London Cable Car, or even cycling and walking. You choose the route that suits you best.
Check Before You Travel
Get live arrival times for Buses, Tube, London Overground, Elizabeth Line, DLR, Tram, and National Rail. Check the live status of all TfL lines and stations directly on the map, or view a summary of current disruptions in the "Status" section.
Freedom to Explore
Find travel options tailored to your needs, including step-free journeys and routes avoiding stairs or escalators. Journey plans automatically adapt to the accessibility status of stations, helping you avoid disruptions. TfL Go also supports VoiceOver and Dynamic Type, making it more accessible for everyone.
Manage Your Payments
Create an account or log in to manage your payments for travel across London. Top up pay as you go credit or purchase Travelcards for your Oyster card, and view your journey history for both Oyster and contactless cards registered to your account.
Note: Oyster and contactless accounts can only be accessed within UK/Europe.
Understand Station Facilities
Check how busy a station is right now, or see if it has toilets or Wi-Fi access. Find detailed information about step-free access and interchanges including platform gap width, step height and boarding methods available.
Get in Touch
Any questions, feedback or something we've missed? Email us at tflappfeedback@tfl.gov.uk

Avaz AAC is an assistive communication app that empowers children & adults with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Down Syndrome, Aphasia, Apraxia, and individuals with speech difficulties to communicate freely and build meaningful relationsh
bluejetty:00015008:ios.description:
Overview
Avaz AAC is an assistive communication app that empowers children & adults with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Down Syndrome, Aphasia, Apraxia, and individuals with speech difficulties to communicate freely and build meaningful relationships.
Why Families Trust Avaz
“My daughter has nearly mastered navigation, so much so that one day she brought it to me to show me she wanted Taco Bell for lunch. This made me cry. My child had a voice for the first time. Thank you for being the one to give my daughter that "voice". - Amy Kinderman
Designed to aid language development, by presenting core words, which make up 80% of everyday speech, in a research-based order. This enables users to progress from using 1-2 word phrases to forming complete sentences.
Core AAC Features
Avaz, a fully AAC text-to-speech app with over 40,000 pictures(Symbolstix) and a range of high-quality voices, enables users to form sentences and express themselves with ease quickly. Avaz is a customizable AAC app that empowers users to express themselves authentically and build meaningful connections!
Secure Backup & Restore
Enjoy the convenience of auto backup for worry-free vocabulary progress. Simply choose how often you want your vocabulary progress backed up with our auto-backup interval selection option. Never lose your progress again!
Personalization with Themes
We understand our users have different preferences for cloud storage, so we made it easy to back up your vocabulary to your preferred platform, including popular ones like Google Drive.
Explore our visual themes - Classic Light, Classic Dark (with high contrast), and Outer Space (a dark mode). Our default dark mode has been beneficial for adult users and those using Avaz with eye-tracking devices.
Free Trial – No Credit Card Required
Try Avaz AAC's free 14-day trial without adding credit card details! Make in-app purchases and choose from our affordable monthly, yearly, and lifetime subscription plans to keep benefiting from the amazing features.
Available in Major Languages
Now available in English US, English UK, Français, Dansk, Svenska, Magyar, Føroyskt is fully compatible with iPads and iPhones.
Responsive Support
If you’re new to AAC, don’t worry! Visit www.avazapp.com for beginner-friendly articles to help you get started. Connect with our passionate Avaz community on Facebook and other social media platforms.
We are always happy to hear from you. For any assistance, please write to us at support@avazapp.com
Note for Schools: Avaz AAC - Lifetime Edition is available for a one-time purchase and offers a 50% discount with VPP for 20+ licenses.
Terms of Use - https://www.avazapp.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy - https://www.avazapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00061604:ios.description:
Remote Mouse™ transforms your mobile phone or tablet into an easy-to-use remote control for your computer, complete with a cross-device clipboard that enables seamless text and image transfer across platforms. It mimics the functions of a wireless mouse, keyboard, and touchpad, and also offers various specialized control panels that enhance your control over specific operations. The small features, designed for one-handed use or intuitive operations, will delight you.
Featured on CNET, Mashable, and Product Hunt, Remote Mouse is recognized as one of the most sophisticated and user-friendly computer remote apps. With over 20 million users worldwide, it's a trusted choice for effortless computer control.
Whether you're watching a movie online, giving a presentation, or shutting down your computer with one click, nothing can be more convenient than having a mobile phone remote at your fingertips.
Mouse
• Fully simulated mouse function
• Gyro mouse is a feature that allows you to move the mouse cursor with a gyro sensor
• Left-handed mode
Keyboard
• Integrated with system and third-party keyboards, supports typing in various languages
• Remotely typing by voice if the soft keyboard supports speech recognition
• Supports sending various shortcuts
• Displays different keypads for Mac or PC
Touchpad
• Simulates the Apple Magic Trackpad and supports multi-touch gestures
Specialty Control Panels
• Media Remote: Control videos, music, and presentations across apps and sites like YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV+, VLC, Spotify, and more, automatically adapting to what’s playing.
• Web Remote: Supports Chrome, Firefox, and Opera
• Application Switcher: quickly launch and switch between programs
• Power Options: Supports remotely shutting down, sleeping, restarting, and logging off
• Cross-device Clipboard: Allows for the transfer of text and images between your computer and mobile device
Other Features
• Use the physical volume buttons on the mobile device for remote control
• Set a password for the connection
• Customizable wallpaper
Connection Method
• Connect via IP address or QR code
• Connect via history
Operating Environment
• Compatible with Windows, Mac OSX, and Linux
• Works under Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
To Get Started
1. Visit https://www.remotemouse.net on your computer and download the Remote Mouse computer server software.
2. Install and run the computer server software.
3. Connect your mobile device to the same Wi-Fi network or use Bluetooth to pair with your computer.

bluejetty:00186204:ios.summary:

SketchParty TV is the fun Pictionary-style drawing and guessing party game to play on your iPad and Apple TV! As seen i
bluejetty:00186204:ios.description:
"If you like Pictionary but hate cleaning up all those scraps of paper, SketchParty TV is the game for you." - Macworld
SketchParty TV is the fun Pictionary-style drawing and guessing party game to play on your iPad and Apple TV! As seen in a WWDC keynote!
A MUST-HAVE PARTY GAME
You could buy an easel, a huge pad of paper, and some markers, then write down a really long list of words and make up some rules and try and keep track of points and get marker smudges all over your furniture. But who wants to do that?
OR!
You could play a fun drawing game using items you already have around the house, like your iPad, high-definition television, and Apple TV. Just enable AirPlay Mirroring, choose sides, and start a SketchParty. It's so simple!
A TRULY SOCIAL GAME
SketchParty TV is a team game like Pictionary or "Win, Lose or Draw", and up to 8 players per team can join in on the fun. That's a pretty big party! And it's fun for ages 8 and up.
Gather up your family, call your friends, and play SketchParty today!
GAMEPLAY REQUIREMENTS
Note: SketchParty TV requires an AirPlay Mirroring-capable device and either SketchParty TV running on the 4th generation Apple TV or an Apple TV 2 or later to play. SketchParty TV can also be played using Apple's AV adapter or a Mac/PC app like Reflector. (See http://SketchPartyTV.com for device compatibility.)
AS SEEN ON
Engadget/TUAW and Mac|Format Magazine Editor's Choice app. As seen on ABC, Macworld, Fortune, Mashable, Techcrunch, Gotta Be Mobile, MacStories, iMore, Touch Arcade, 148Apps, The Loop, and more.

"SketchParty TV is an extremely fun app, built to entertain friends and family members for hours on end." - CNET
"It's ingenious, executed to perfection and a huge amount of fun for groups." - Engadget
"If you own an Apple TV, you need to own SketchParty TV." - GottaBeMobile

"If you like Pictionary but hate cleaning up all those scraps of paper, SketchParty TV is the game for you." - Macworld
"There are some games, like SketchParty TV, that really sing on the Apple TV." - Mashable
"SketchParty TV really shines. Huge family fun." - Sixcolors
"SketchParty TV is a great way to get the whole family involved together in a fun game." - TWiT

bluejetty:00090798:ios.description:
CABCY Taxi App operates in Nicosia, Limassol and Larnaca, Cyprus. We offer instant and pre-booked trips, honest prices and comfortable cars.
LATE MODEL CARS
CABCY Taxi App Cyprus carefully selects cars, and passengers can be sure to get only presentable and comfortable cabs.
RIDE NOW OR LATER
With CABCY App you can confirm the booking now or schedule it for a certain date and time – super convenient for airport rides & transfers to have the peace of mind that your taxi will be there at the time you need it! CABCY Taxi App operates transfers to Larnca airport.
OFFICIAL RATES
Our prices correspond to official taximeters and taxi prices set by the Cyprus state. Passengers can see estimated price of the trip prior to booking the ride.
LICENSED DRIVERS
We personally meet taxi drivers in Nicosia, Limassol and Larnaca to see their cars and get documents confirming that they are a licensed taxi driver before activating them in the app. When you book a taxi through CABCY app in Cyprus you get a professional licensed cab driver.
WHERE WE OPERATE
CABCY Taxi App operates in Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca and does Larnaca airport transfers. We plan expand to the rest of Cyprus shortly.
ACCURATE TRACKING
We use modern navigation system. Passengers can see on the map the driver’s route to pick up location and track their trip to the destination to make sure the driver is taking them in the right direction.

bluejetty:00184753:ios.description:
Do you remember the ORIGINAL Spider Solitaire card game you played on Windows™? It’s now available to play on your iPad and iPhone. 
Download the best Windows™ Spider Solitaire style game in the app store, and relive the familiar card game you know and love.
Also known as Spiderette or Spiderwort, Spider Solitaire is an extremely popular variant of Solitaire that will puzzle your brain for hours of endless fun! The goal is to place all the cards in each suit in stacks of descending suit sequence. First try as a beginner through 1 and 2 suit games and move up challenged as you attempt to tackle 4 suit games and become a true Spider Solitaire master!
== Spider Solitaire Features ==
• Custom pictures for card decks and backgrounds
• Adjust difficulty with 1-4 suit games
• Unlimited undo and hint option
• Track your Spider Solitaire statistics
• Daily challenges
• Tons of graphics and stunning victory animations
• Flawless and classic interface
• Right hand or left hand play-option
• Tap to move for quick gameplay
• Landscape or portrait view
• Additional game mode: Spiderette
Play the popular CLASSIC Spider Solitaire card game on iOS now!

bluejetty:00166114:ios.summary:
From your morning commute to late-night deep dives, Google Gemini is your personal, proactive and powerful AI assistant.
WHY USERS LOVE GEMINI
• Our latest models, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini Omni, unlock a new world of productivity and crea
bluejetty:00166114:ios.description:
From your morning commute to late-night deep dives, Google Gemini is your personal, proactive and powerful AI assistant.
WHY USERS LOVE GEMINI
• Our latest models, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini Omni, unlock a new world of productivity and creativity.
• Solve complex workflows, write advanced code, and analyze data easily with Google’s newest frontier model.
• Daily Brief agent gives you a personalized morning brief and organizes exactly what you need to know to start your day.
• Talk things out with Gemini Live: Brainstorm in real time or share your screen/camera to discuss exactly what you see.
• Instead of a wall of text, you get carefully crafted responses with interleaved images, timelines, and interactive visuals.
• Get more personalized help by connecting your favorite Google apps like Gmail, Calendar, Google Photos, YouTube, and Search.
• Upload documents, spreadsheets, photos, videos, and more to get answers, summaries, and insights about your content.
BRING YOUR CREATIVE IDEAS TO LIFE
• Generate and edit photos with Nano Banana 2: Apply camera and lighting controls, create mockups by blending multiple images, design posters with sharp text, and effortlessly build diagrams. Then, resize as needed.
• Turn your ideas into cinematic videos with Gemini Omni for Google AI Plus, Pro, Ultra, and Workspace users.
• Create custom soundtracks for any moment with Lyria 3.
BOOST YOUR PRODUCTIVITY
• Research with NotebookLM: Get deeper, more relevant responses that are grounded in the sources in your notebook
• Study help and exam prep made easy: Upload your class notes to generate custom practice quizzes and interactive visuals.
• Turn a simple prompt into a prototype: Build web pages, games, or dashboards. You can even convert your files into a podcast-style overview to listen to while you're on the move.
UNLOCK MORE WHEN YOU UPGRADE
Level up your Gemini app experience by upgrading to the Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra plans, helping you tackle more complex tasks and projects.
Review the Gemini Apps Privacy Notice: g.co/gemini/privacynotice.
Note: While Gemini is a powerful productivity partner, it does not currently support iOS device actions like setting alarms or sending SMS directly. Gemini for Business is available via qualifying Google Workspace plans.

*Over 55,000 brands, from Gap to Gucci.
*Up to 90% off est. retail for brands like Lululemon, Zara, J. Crew, Ann Taylor LOFT & more.

2. Fill a bag with gently-used women's or kids' clothes from brands like Lululemon, Zara, J. Crew & Ann Taylor LOFT, and send it back.
3. Keep your feet up. We inspect, photograph, list, and ship items for you.

There are enough amazing clothes on the planet, let's wear them. We've upcycled 200M+ items so far and we're just getting started. Join our community of fashion lovers who are committed to a more sustainable future by giving clothes a second life through thrifting and resale.

bluejetty:00092056:ios.name: ASP Access
bluejetty:00092056:ios.summary:
"CREDENTIAL-DRIVEN" CONTENT AND FEATURES
As the name suggests, the ASP Access App provides instant access to a wide variety of product, training and other ASP information and resources. App features are "credential-driven," with specific t
bluejetty:00092056:ios.description:
"CREDENTIAL-DRIVEN" CONTENT AND FEATURES
As the name suggests, the ASP Access App provides instant access to a wide variety of product, training and other ASP information and resources. App features are "credential-driven," with specific tools and content custom-delivered and organized based on your role and relationship with the company. ASP employees, distributors and dealers, trainers and instructors can use the app to tap into the company's massive repository of product data, specs, sales tools, training materials and more.
YOU DON'T HAVE TO BE AN "INSIDER" TO USE THE APP
The Access App isn't just for ASP employees; law enforcement officers and civilian consumers can create their own logins and use the app to quickly find content and tools that relate to them, or to geolocate the nearest ASP dealer.
"QUICKLY" IS THE OPERATIVE WORD
Instead of going to the ASP website for product information, YouTube for videos, the company's online file system for documents, or contacting someone at the office to find information, the app aggregates an enormous amount of data and puts it at your fingertips.
MOST CONTENT IS NO MORE THAN 3 OR 4 TAPS AWAY
Easy browse and filter tools get you where you're going fast, and tools like the built-in barcode scanner make it even quicker and easier. In fact, using the scanner, you can get from looking at a product package on a dealer display to downloading a detailed sell sheet for that product in ONE tap.
BE THE FIRST TO KNOW
All users also benefit from the notification feature of the app—based on your logged-in role, you'll be the first to get messaged on things like product availability, new training classes, company events and more.
Product tools:
• In-app barcode scanner lets you instantly access product information by scanning the UPC code on any ASP product package
• Product information is also quickly accessible with either the category filter tool or text search
• Once you've reached desired product (depending on user role), you'll have descriptions, specs, photos, videos, sell sheets and more at your fingertips
• Specific product variations, where applicable, can be viewed using scroll wheels, and photos of the exact product and selected variation will change in real time
• Product images can be enlarged and moved for viewing details, and saved to phone image library for future reference and sharing
Training tools
• View up-to-date schedule of ASP law enforcement training classes; qualified candidates can apply online, directly from the app
• ASP Certified Trainers and Instructors can access training tools including class documents, checklists, exercises and drills, and more
• Direct access (role-dependent) to order training equipment and supplies
• Directory of key company contacts, tap to call or email
• Built-in photo sharing tool allows Trainers to quickly submit class pictures to the office 
Other tools and features
• All tools, menus and content are customized based on your role. App theme is color-coded based on credentials and personalized to user
• GPS-enabled map shows nearest ASP dealers based on your location, or can be searched by city or postal code
• Authorized ASP dealers and distributors can access full retail/MAP price list, sales tools and training materials, and key sales and office contacts
• Dealers, distributors, Trainers, Instructors and employees can access company file system to download high-resolution images and other product resources
• Allow notifications to be the first to get alerts that are relevant to your role—new products, new training classes, company events and news, and more

bluejetty:00040328:ios.name: Meditation Time 2.0
bluejetty:00040328:ios.summary: The ‘Meditation Time App’ provides you with a very useful tool to make your meditation even more mindful: Set the timer and let one of the many singing bowls and instruments remind you of the end of your meditation after the desired time.
bluejetty:00040328:ios.description:
The ‘Meditation Time App’ provides you with a very useful tool to make your meditation even more mindful: Set the timer and let one of the many singing bowls and instruments remind you of the end of your meditation after the desired time.
If you wish, you can also set a mindfulness chime at any interval to gently bring you back to meditation if your thoughts do wander.
Pleasant nature sounds as switchable background sounds help you meditate when your mind (or your environment) is particularly restless.
Our guided meditations by professional speakers provide you with additional guidance and motivation for your daily meditation practice.
The ‘teaching’ provides a brief and undogmatic overview of the most important aspects of meditation practice and offers you inspiration and motivation for your regular meditation.
Conclusion: This app is perfect for you if you want to bring more mindfulness into your life with meditation. It doesn't matter whether you've never meditated before or are an old hand at meditation. By the way: since version 4.0, we have even built in special modes for the masters of meditation: the Master Mode for up to 4 hours of meditation at a time and the Zen Mode, which sounds the end chime three times. 
With this in mind, I wish you: a peaceful mind and a calm disposition.
Why use a meditation app at all?
A meditation app offers a simple and accessible way to regularly integrate mindfulness and inner peace into your everyday life. It helps to reduce stress, promote concentration and increase general well-being. Especially in a hectic world where we are often overwhelmed by obligations and distractions, a meditation app helps to create moments of calm and to arrive in the here and now. 
There is an important connection between meditation apps and the concept of MBSR (Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction), a scientifically based method for reducing stress. MBSR uses mindfulness exercises such as meditation, breathing techniques and body scans to manage stress and chronic strain. Many meditation apps are based on similar principles and offer guided exercises that integrate the central elements of MBSR. This allows users to benefit from the proven techniques and integrate mindfulness into their everyday lives - whether to manage stress, improve sleep or promote serenity.
This app can write your completed meditation sessions to Apple Health (HealthKit), allowing you to track your mindfulness practice in the Health app. Data is only shared with your explicit permission and can be disabled at any time.

bluejetty:00122625:ios.description:
All the advantages of modern mobile banking with the security of a major German bank. Banking is quick and easy with the Commerzbank App, whenever you want and wherever you are. Your bank is always with you.
FUNCTIONS 
• Financial overview: all account balances and transactions at a glance 
• Quick login: by fingerprint or facial recognition (Touch ID/ Face ID)
• Card management: easily change your PIN or block your card in an emergency
• Faster transfer: speedy and safe with photoTAN and Instant Payment as well as photo transfers with QR Codes, remittance slips and invoice scan
• Standing orders: view, change, create or delete
• Account alarm: push notifications about account movements, in real time, to your mobile
• Finder: find nearby ATMs and Commerzbank branches
• Many more practical functions
SECURITY
• Biometric login: Login secure and in seconds with Touch ID or Face ID
• Security guarantee: financial losses not caused by negligence will be fully reimbursed
• photoTAN: innovative security method for secure transfers
• Apple Pay: encrypted transactions without sharing card details or PINs
FEEDBACK
Do you have a great idea for our banking app? Do you have a question? Simply use the feedback function in the app or send an e-mail to: directbanking@commerzbank.com
PREREQUISITES
• Camera: for photo transfers to read invoices, remittance slips or QR codes
• Microphone: to use call from-within-the-app function
• Location approval: to search for ATMs and branches
• Contacts: to send money to your contacts
• Network: the app requires an internet connection to the bank. To check the connection, we need the right to view the network status.
• Hard-/software checks of your device: At runtime, we check known, security-relevant attack vectors (e.g. rooted/jailbreak, malicious apps, etc.)
• faceID usage: to make easier login for the customers
NOTE
With iOS, rights are always assigned in groups. So, we need to request permissions for all topics, even if we only need one permission from the group. We use these rights only for the purposes mentioned here, within the app, and do not access your personal data. A detailed explanation can be found further down in the App Store, at the link "Privacy Policy".

bluejetty:00033894:ios.summary: Step into the ring and experience the adrenaline-pumping action of Boxing Ring: Clash of Warriors, a mobile boxing game that sets a new standard for engaging gameplay. Featuring high-quality animations and lifelike boxer models, this game o
bluejetty:00033894:ios.description:
Step into the ring and experience the adrenaline-pumping action of Boxing Ring: Clash of Warriors, a mobile boxing game that sets a new standard for engaging gameplay. Featuring high-quality animations and lifelike boxer models, this game offers a realistic and thrilling boxing experience right at your fingertips.
Become the worldwide champion, fighting in breathtaking arenas from San Francisco to Shanghai and more! Look your opponents in the eye and prepare yourself for the fight to remember. There can be only one victor - make sure it’s you!
Key Features:
- Diverse Opponents: Engage in over 100 intense fights with a wide array of opponents, each with their unique fighting style and strategy.
- League Progression: Climb the ranks through 6 challenging leagues, with each one culminating in an epic boss fight that will test your skills to the limit.
- Championship Glory: Strive to obtain 6 prestigious boxing belts, marking your conquest through various leagues and solidifying your status as a true boxing champion.
- Global Showdown: Immerse yourself in the world of boxing as you compete in famous locations around the globe, including vibrant cities like Shanghai, San Francisco, and more!
- Engaging character builder: Customize your boxer's abilities with 4 distinct stats to upgrade, allowing you to tailor your fighting style to match your strategic preferences.
- Awesome Mini-Games: Hone your skills with two unique mini-games - the punching bag for precision and the jumping rope for agility - providing a break from the ring with enjoyable challenges.
- Dynamic Combat: Unleash a variety of powerful punches, including jabs, hooks, and uppercuts, to crush your opponents and dominate the ring.
- Defensive Tactics to learn: Master the art of defense with dodge and block maneuvers to skillfully avoid incoming punches and counter with precision.
- Special Moves: Execute jaw-dropping special moves that can turn the tide of the match, providing you with the opportunity to finish off your opponent in style.
Boxing Ring: Clash of Warriors offers an unparalleled mobile boxing experience, combining awesome visuals, strategic gameplay, and a variety of features that will keep you hooked from the first bell to the final knockout. Enter the ring, rise through the ranks, and become the ultimate boxing champion!
IGRS rating: 13+

bluejetty:00089696:ios.description:
STOP SEARCHING. START SCANNING.
ElephantTrax is the #1 QR code home inventory app that tells you exactly what's in every box — in seconds, not hours.
Whether you're managing a garage full of boxes, organizing a storage unit, packing for a move, or just trying to find your holiday decorations — ElephantTrax makes it effortless.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a box or storage container in the app
2. Print and attach your unique QR code label
3. Add items with photos, descriptions, and notes
4. Scan the QR code anytime to see everything inside instantly
That's it. No more guessing. No more digging through 20 boxes to find 1 thing.
HOME INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
ElephantTrax is your complete home inventory solution:
• Track every item across every room, floor, or storage location
• Organize your entire home — bedroom, kitchen, attic, basement, garage
• Add photos to identify items at a glance
• Search your entire inventory instantly by keyword, room, or category
• Never lose track of anything again
BOX ORGANIZER APP
Stop writing on boxes with a marker. ElephantTrax turns every box into a smart, scannable container:
• Print or display QR code labels directly from your phone
• Scan any box to see its complete contents list
• Works with any size box, bin, tote, or container
• Perfect for storage bins, moving boxes, and garage shelves
• Add or remove items anytime — labels stay accurate forever
FOR PROFESSIONAL ORGANIZERS AND DECLUTTERERS
Build your client's complete inventory while you work — then hand it off the moment the job is done:
• Label every box and container with QR codes as you organize
• Document each item with photos and descriptions on the spot
• Share the full inventory with your client when the job is complete
• Your client gets a scannable, searchable system they can manage forever
• The perfect professional finish to every organizing project
MOVING AND PACKING
ElephantTrax is the packing app that makes every move easier:
• Pack smarter — know exactly what's in every moving box
• Unpack faster — scan to find what you need first
• Create a complete record of all your possessions before the move
• Share inventory access with your family or moving crew
• Never lose a box in your new home again
STORAGE UNIT ORGANIZER
Managing a storage unit is painful — until ElephantTrax:
• Map your entire storage unit with labeled containers
• Know exactly which box holds what — without visiting the unit
• Save trips with a fully searchable inventory from your couch
• Perfect for climate-controlled units, pods, and self-storage facilities
HOME INVENTORY FOR INSURANCE
Protect what you own with a complete home inventory:
• Document your valuables with photos and detailed descriptions
• Store serial numbers, purchase dates, and estimated values
• Export your full inventory report for insurance purposes
• Be prepared before disaster strikes — floods, fires, theft
Download ElephantTrax free and scan your first box in under 2 minutes.

bluejetty:00154767:ios.name: Decorando a Lei Seca
bluejetty:00154767:ios.summary: Através do aplicativo Decorando a Lei Seca, você conseguirá acessar de forma ilimitada o nosso Vade Mecum de Questões. Esse acesso contempla exclusivamente o banco de questões, não incluindo o Raio X ou os demais materiais. Tais materiais d
bluejetty:00154767:ios.description:
Através do aplicativo Decorando a Lei Seca, você conseguirá acessar de forma ilimitada o nosso Vade Mecum de Questões. Esse acesso contempla exclusivamente o banco de questões, não incluindo o Raio X ou os demais materiais. Tais materiais devem ser acessados através da área do aluno, disponível em nosso site. Sendo assim, será possível selecionar o diploma legal do seu interesse e realizar questões que tratam exatamente dos artigos que já caíram em concursos públicos. Com isso, você irá potencializar a memorização daquilo que efetivamente é cobrado em provas. 
Ao acessar a plataforma, você só precisa clicar em "Acessar Questões. Logo depois, basta que você filtre pelo Código ou Lei desejado, com o respectivo assunto ou subassunto. Caso a alternativa esteja correta, o comentário lhe indicará o artigo cobrado, com grifos coloridos em verde, indicando a razão da alternativa estar verdadeira. Estando incorreta, você verá o dispositivo cobrado com grifos em vermelho na parte alterada pela banca (as famosas pegadinhas).
Para as atualizações legislativas ainda não exigidas em concursos, nossa Equipe busca elaborar questões próprias, nos moldes da cobrança recente em assuntos similares. Seguindo essa linha, já temos questões inéditas sobre o Pacote Anticrime a a Nova Lei de Licitações.
Trata-se de uma ferramenta essencial para os concurseiros que buscam aprovação em provas objetivas. Através de um formato de que permite a rápida leitura dos dispositivos, você conseguirá potencializar seu desempenho em questões da lei seca.

bluejetty:00043722:ios.description:
Your Emotional & Spiritual Companion for Gen Z Life
Struggling with anxiety? Feeling overwhelmed? Need a daily dose of hope? Gen Z Bible transforms ancient wisdom into relatable guidance that speaks your language. This isn't your grandparent's scripture app. It's a mental wellness tool designed specifically for today's challenges.
Match Your Mood to Scripture That Gets You
Browse our vibrant mood collection featuring anxiety, depression, joy, love, doubt, and more—each with specially curated verses that actually make sense for what you're going through.
Daily Vibe Check: SOAP Method for Emotional Balance
Scripture: Start with truth that grounds you
Observation: Process what you're really feeling
Application: Get practical steps for your situation
Prayer: Connect spiritually in your own authentic way
Why Gen Z Bible Stands Out:
Mood-Based Scripture & Encouragement
Pick your vibe; anxiety, depression, joy, relationships, stress, anger, love, and more. Get Bible verses, reflections, and prayers tailored to exactly how you feel.
Bible Stories Reimagined
Explore iconic Bible stories with modern visuals and real-life lessons. From David’s courage to Ruth’s loyalty; faith has never looked this relatable.
Emotional & Mental Health Support
Struggling with anxiety, loneliness, or stress? Gen Z Bible offers spiritual tools to help you cope, heal, and grow stronger; without judgment.
Aesthetic & Intuitive Design
Custom artwork, calming UI, and smooth navigation. Designed for Gen Z, by Gen Z. Save your favs, set reminders, and share the Word.
Built-In Faith Community
Connect with others on the same journey. Share your reflections, join discussions, and grow your faith together.
Find Exactly What You Need:
Anxiety Relief: Calm your mind with verses that actually help
Daily Devotionals: Quick spiritual boosts for busy lives
Relationship Guidance: Navigate complex connections with wisdom
Identity & Purpose: Discover who you are beyond social expectations
Healing & Growth: Process grief, doubt and life transitions
Subscription pricing and terms:
Gen Z Bible offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $4.99/week and $39.99/ Year for unlimited access.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://genzbible.me/terms
Privacy policy: https://genzbible.me/privacy

bluejetty:00025637:ios.description:
Step into the captivating universe of 'Idle Kitchen: Food Truck', a game that blends the excitement of idle gaming with the allure of street food culture. Abandon the monotony of a desk job and embrace your inner chef and idler, as you navigate Oliver's journey from an ordinary clerk to a celebrated street food entrepreneur.
In this idle game, your adventure begins with a simple food truck. Utilize the principles of idle miner games to tap and earn, gradually building your culinary empire. Invest your earnings wisely to upgrade your truck, perfect your recipes, and enhance your customer service. Each upgrade unfolds new aspects of the game, similar to the progression seen in popular idle vlogger games.
Unlike typical idler games, 'Idle Kitchen: Food Truck' offers a rich storyline and dynamic gameplay. Travel to various locations, each presenting unique challenges and opportunities to expand your food truck business. Embrace the role of an idle vlogger, sharing Oliver's journey and enticing more customers with your culinary tales.
This game is perfect for fans of idle games and culinary adventures alike. With intuitive gameplay and engaging mechanics, 'Idle Kitchen: Food Truck' is an idle game that transcends the genre, offering a unique blend of cooking, managing, and storytelling. Join the ranks of successful idlers and transform your food truck into a gastronomic sensation!

bluejetty:00091085:ios.description:
A EXACTO tem como diferencial a qualidade da prestação de contas, que é apresentada de forma objetiva e adaptada à necessidade de cada cliente! 
Através da constante evolução da equipe e dos processos, a Exacto oferece as melhores e mais inovadoras soluções voltadas à gestão condominial, sempre comprometidos com nossos valores, para que sejamos referência de qualidade e de excelência no atendimento ao cliente.
Na EXACTO, a solidez é fruto de uma prestação de serviços voltada exclusivamente ao cliente: atenção às suas necessidades, com especialização, transparência e respeito.
Com rotinas automatizadas pelo aplicativo (boletos, prestação de contas, solicitações, comunicação, etc) sobra mais tempo para o corpo diretivo do condomínio atuar junto com a assessoria EXACTO em questões maiores como redução de custos, melhor aproveitamento dos espaços, melhoria dos procedimentos, aumento da segurança, manutenção predial, etc.
Tanto pelo site da EXACTO quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a EXACTO, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para exacto@winker.com.br
INOVE o seu condomínio com o Aplicativo EXACTO Condomínios.

bluejetty:00040173:ios.description:
Brand new design and easy to use interface
Purchase tickets with few clicks for yourself and for other passengers
View special offers and purchase history.
Create and configure templates for fast purchases.
View information about stops, agents and time of arrival.
Edit and update your profile.
Connect the company and receive system notifications, OS notifications, and marketing messages.
Use the app as a signed-in loyalty member or as an anonymous user.
Join the world of the most comfortable bus journeys with our updated app from Ecolines. Discover instant access to the best routes, bus tickets, services, long-distance travel, and various destinations that will make your next trip unforgettable.
Why ECOLINES?
EXPERIENCE AND RELIABILITY
Ecolines is one of Europe's largest and most experienced bus operators, with 20 years of experience in the market. We know the roads we travel and always aim to meet our passengers' expectations.
CONVENIENT AND INTUITIVE INTERFACE
Instant bus ticket search, seat selection, and online booking in just a few clicks, whether it's for yourself, your loved ones, or friends. Save your purchase history, create templates for even faster booking, and get access to special offers and discounts.
TRIP DETAILS IN YOUR SMARTPHONE
View all the necessary information about your journey, including tickets, routes, and the bus stop timetable.
BUS SCHEDULE
Convenient trip planning with instant access to the current bus schedule in the app. Choose a stop in the city of your choice and view arrival and departure details for routes on the current day.
EXTENSIVE VARIETY OF ROUTES
We offer comfortable travel to 20 countries and approximately 205 cities every day. Our buses travel through the territories of the Baltic countries, Poland, Germany, the Netherlands, the Czech Republic, Ukraine, and more.
COMFORTABLE BUSES AND ON-BOARD SERVICES
Bus cabins are equipped with free Wi-Fi, multimedia systems, and onboard staff to assist with any questions, along with the option to enjoy tea or coffee.
With the Ecolines app, your journey becomes easy and enjoyable. Download the app now and plan your next trip! Join the thousands of satisfied passengers who trust their bus travels to the Ecolines.
Share your impressions and feedback, and please don’t hesitate to contact us at info@ecolines.lv if you have any questions.
More about Ecolines
Website: www.ecolines.net 
Facebook: www.facebook.com/ECOLINES 
Instagram: www.instagram.com/ecolinesbus
