bluejetty:00157569:ios.name: Beyond Type 1 Diabetes
bluejetty:00157569:ios.summary:
A fun and supportive community for those impacted by type 1 diabetes. Featuring the largest collection of practical ideas, stories and resources to not only live with T1D, but thrive with it—available in English and Spanish.
Use the Beyond
bluejetty:00157569:ios.description:
A fun and supportive community for those impacted by type 1 diabetes. Featuring the largest collection of practical ideas, stories and resources to not only live with T1D, but thrive with it—available in English and Spanish.
Use the Beyond Type 1 community app to:
+ Chat, message and build relationships with others impacted by type 1 diabetes
+ Share your story and find inspiration from community members like you
+ Navigate topics surrounding T1D that don’t have easy or obvious answers
+ Get involved with Beyond Type 1 programs
Members of Beyond Type 1 are connecting around:
+ Being Newly Diagnosed
+ Troubleshooting Together
+ Burnout
+ Devices and T1D Tech
+ Managing Stress + Support
+ Being Parents of Young Kids with T1D
The Beyond Type 1 community app is supported by resources that can be found at BeyondType1.org (and in Spanish at es.BeyondType1.org). 
_________
Did you know we have an app to support our friends with type 2 diabetes, too? Check out the Beyond Type 2 app!
_________
Una comunidad divertida y de apoyo para personas que viven con diabetes tipo 1. Con la mayor colección de ideas prácticas, historias y recursos para no sólo vivir con DT1, sino prosperar con ella, disponible en inglés y español.
Usa la aplicación de la comunidad Beyond Type 1 para:
+ Chatear, enviar mensajes y entablar pláticas con otras personas que viven con diabetes tipo 1
+ Compartir tu historia y encontrar inspiración de miembros de la comunidad como tú
+ Navegar por temas relacionados con la DT1 que no tienen respuestas fáciles u obvias
+Involúcrate en los programas de Beyond Type 1 
Los miembros de Beyond Type 1 se conectan en torno a temas como:
+ Diagnóstico reciente 
+ Solucionar problemas juntos
+ Burnout (o cansancio emocional)
+ Dispositivos y tecnología para la DT1
+ Manejo del estrés + Apoyo
+ Ser padres de niños pequeños con DT1
La aplicación de comunidad Beyond Type 1 está respaldada por recursos que se pueden encontrar en BeyondType1.org (y en español en es.BeyondType1.org).
_________
¿Sabías que tenemos una aplicación para apoyar a nuestros amigos con diabetes tipo 2? Échale un vistazo a la aplicación de Beyond Type 2.

Join PhoneClub community and save money. Whether you need reliable international calling to any country, a fast mobile top-up for a loved one, or high-speed data for your travels, PhoneClub brings the globe to your fingertips in one convenient app.

• Pay per minute with no hidden fees
• Use with WiFi or Mobile Data
Download for free and get:
• Cheap rates for international phone calls
• No Hidden or Extra Fees

• Minute rounding
• 100% Call Quality
• Access from all iOS smartphones and tablets
• Direct access to your phone contacts
• 24/7 Customer Service
Very easy to use:
1. Create an account or login.
2. Buy Voice Credit, Mobile Recharge, or Travel eSIM.
3. Start calling and stay connected with the world!
Extra options:
• Instantly check the rate/min for the destination you want to call
• Check out the answers to frequently asked questions in our Help Center
• Set My Caller ID - Let your friends and family know it’s you calling by setting your Caller ID directly in the app.
• Rate Our App - We value your feedback. Let us know how we’re doing!
Features:
• Integrated Contacts: Use your existing phone list for 1-tap calls
• Easy Onboarding: Create a new account directly from the app in seconds
• Speed Dial: Call your favorite international numbers faster than ever
Tip: We recommend turning off "International Calling" with your current mobile provider to avoid accidental high charges on their network. Always use PhoneClub app for great rates!
Backup calling method:
Use our Toll Free or Local Access numbers from any mobile or landline.
Mobile Recharge
Help your family stay connected globally. Send mobile recharges to over 160 countries instantly. Our secure platform ensures your mobile credit reaches those who matter, fast and without hassle.
Travel eSIM
Travel smart with our eSIM data plans. Stay online abroad without the headache of expensive carrier roaming fees. Activate your Travel eSIM in seconds and enjoy high-speed internet.
Questions or Feedback?
We value your opinion! Reach out to us at customerservice@phoneclub.com or check our Help Center directly in the app.
Frequently asked questions
1. Can I use my phone contacts?
Yes, but you have to make sure that all phone numbers are saved in international format: country code + phone number.
2. How much data does the app use for an online call?
On average, the app uses approximately 1MB/min for making a voice call. In order to benefit from the highest quality available, we advise you to use the application with a WiFi network. Any costs resulting from using the application with mobile data networks when you call internationally are not covered by us.
3. Which countries & operators support mobile top-ups?
You can send top-ups to 160+ countries and mobile operators around the world. Simply browse through the list of available destinations; once you select your desired country, the available operators will be displayed.
4. What is a travel eSIM and how does it work?
A travel eSIM is a digital SIM card that allows you to access mobile data in other countries without needing a physical SIM. Instead of inserting a plastic card, you download a profile to your phone. It works by connecting your device to local mobile networks in your destination country, providing you with affordable data at more cost-effective rates than traditional international roaming.

bluejetty:00146928:ios.description:
JellyJelly is the social app built for real human moments. Capture raw clips, post them as is, and find people being actually themselves online.
POST A JELLY
Hit record and your front and back cameras both roll, a real-time look at you and what you're seeing. No setup, no staging, no second takes.
SKIP THE EDIT
Every jelly gets auto-captioned, auto-titled, and auto-summarized the moment you stop recording. No filters, no cuts, no polish. Post and move on.
TAKE IT ANYWHERE
Export your jellies to TikTok and Instagram with one tap. Or drop them on the JellyJelly feed and let our community find you.
JOIN THE FEED
Skip the over-produced, over-edited, over-everything content. The JellyJelly feed is candid POVs from real people. Spontaneous thoughts, behind-the-scenes moments, the stuff that usually never makes it online.
AVOID THE SLOP
The internet is drowning in AI-generated content and posts engineered to keep you scrolling. JellyJelly is built on the opposite bet: that raw, unfiltered, human moments are what people actually want to see.
You're in early. Send all feedback to support@jellyjelly.com.

bluejetty:00137935:ios.description:
Experience powerful business journalism that connects the dots with The Ken, India’s pioneering media publication. Read deeply reported, original stories, immersive podcasts, rich infographics, and sharp newsletters from some of the best reporters and writers in the region, to understand not just the news, but why it’s happening and what comes next. 
Go ahead and subscribe to our top-rate app. You’ll love it because it lets you: 
Read our stories and newsletters on the go: Browse, search, and save stories and newsletters you want to read while you’re travelling, commuting, or on that flight, even without an active internet connection. 
Never encounter a paywall once you have a subscription: Paywalled publications need you to be signed in all the time on your browser. On our mobile app, just login once, and it’s there all the time. We deep-link to our mobile app in all the emails we send, so this gives you a seamless experience. 
Flip through stunning visual stories about businesses: Our infographics are as rich as the stories we write. If you are short on time, you can simply flip through our infographics and get the story. It’s perfect for those occasions when you want to visually understand businesses, without having to read longform articles. 
Browse and read transcripts of our widely loved podcasts: A collection of original podcasts that cover the most interesting workplaces, careers, and business trends, along with candid conversations with founders and business leaders. Charting consistently on all major podcast platforms. 
Interact with other subscribers: Our community comprises some of the sharpest and most ambitious CXOs, leaders, executives, and students. Read their comments, reply to them, and join the debate. All from your phone.
In addition, subscribers can gift and unlock stories for non-subscribers, and personalise their reading experience with features such as dark mode, adjustable font sizes, and much more. 
Haven’t made up your mind?
No problem. You can still sign up and enjoy the free experience.
Subscription:
Access to The Ken requires a subscription. You can purchase a subscription to The Ken via our app. You can also sign up for free to experience our journalism and products.
What you get when you subscribe via our app:
 - Complete access to all our products—stories, newsletters, visual stories, and podcasts
 - Unlimited archive access
 - Gift 10 premium stories per month and 5 subscriptions to your loved ones.
 - Upto 3 devices allowed per subscription
 - Device access— Mobile + iPad
 - Priority access to new product offerings, community features, and events
 - Daily morning emails and weekly recap emails
 - Get alerts and notifications to stay updated
Payment and auto renewal terms:
If you subscribe to The Ken via this app, payment will be charged by Apple to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
Your subscription will get automatically renewed unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To cancel, please turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
Terms of Use:
Privacy Policy - The Ken : https://the-ken.com/privacy-policy/
Terms and Conditions - The Ken : https://the-ken.com/terms-and-conditions/ 
Apple Terms and Conditions : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/
If you have any questions or feedback, just email support@the-ken.com.

bluejetty:00170152:ios.description:
Whether you’re a Pilates trainer looking for new ideas to keep your classes creative and exciting, or if you simply want to take regular Pilates classes with us; we have tons of exciting, results driven online classes up our sleeves, to motivate and help you step outside the ‘Pilates box’ and take your training to the next level.
OUR MEMBERSHIPS
Gain FULL access to ALL our Pilates videos, from full length classes to short express flows.
Each week you will receive access to TWO new classes in your inbox to expand your catalogue of classes!
WHAT IS DYNAMIC REFORMER PILATES (DRP)?
Dynamic Reformer Pilates is a blend of classical reformer exercises and more athletic moves to create a high energy, creative, results driven class.
A DRP class will typically move at quite a fast pace, meaning the transition between exercises is quick, but without compromising on the fundamental basics of Pilates.
WHAT TO EXPECT
We like to think outside of the Pilates box and get creative! We are forever experimenting with new moves and ideas, which we hope in turn will inspire you to also get more creative with your workouts and classes.
As a member you will have access to weekly updated full classes ranging from 30 mins to one hour, as well as shorter ‘flows’ if you have less time on your hands or prefer to put together your own workout with a series of our flows. 
Whether you’re a Pilates trainer or a student, if you’re tired of your same old Pilates routines and want to freshen things up, then you’ve come to the right place!
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Dynamic Pilates TV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.

Privacy Policy: https://app.dynamicpilatestv.com/privacy

bluejetty:00091350:ios.description:
Precision Angle Measurement in Your Pocket: Protractor Measuring Angle
Struggling with precise angle measurements for your DIY projects, construction work, or home renovations? Tired of carrying bulky tools when you need to measure angles on the go? Whether you're a carpenter, architect, engineer, or passionate DIY enthusiast, Protractor Measuring Angle transforms your iOS device into an accurate, versatile angle measurement tool that delivers professional-grade results.
With cutting-edge sensor technology and an intuitive interface, our app provides instant, reliable angle measurements in multiple formats. Simply place your device against any surface, and watch as Protractor Measuring Angle delivers real-time readings with remarkable precision—making every project perfectly aligned and professionally executed.
Key Features
Versatile Measurement Capabilities
Measure angles in both vertical and horizontal orientations with exceptional accuracy. Perfect for roof pitch calculations, furniture assembly, construction alignment, and countless other applications where precision matters.
(Only basic radians measurement is available in free version. Premium subscription required for all features.)
Multiple Measurement Units
Switch seamlessly between degrees, radians, and gradians to suit your specific project requirements. Our conversion system ensures you always have the right measurement format at your fingertips.
(Only radians available in free version. Premium subscription required for degrees and gradians.)
Target Angle Alerts
Set your desired angle and receive instant notifications when you reach it. Our customizable audio and vibration alerts allow you to focus on positioning rather than watching the screen.
(Premium subscription required.)
Real-Time Precision Readings
Our dynamic display provides instant feedback as you adjust your device, ensuring you capture the exact angle you need with professional-grade accuracy.
(Premium subscription required for advanced readings.)
Apple Watch Support
Measure angles from your wrist with haptic feedback—ideal for hands-free work.
(Premium subscription required.)
Why Choose Protractor Measuring Angle?
Unmatched Accuracy
Our advanced calibration system and sensitive accelerometer deliver measurements you can trust. Stop guessing and start working with confidence on any angled surface.
Intuitive User Experience
Designed for professionals and beginners alike, our clean interface and visual indicators make angle measurement straightforward and effortless. Clear, real-time feedback guides you through every measurement.
Enhanced Project Efficiency
Save time and avoid costly mistakes with instant, accurate angle readings. Whether you're installing crown molding, checking roof pitch, or aligning furniture, our app helps you get it right the first time.
Premium Subscription Benefits
To access the full power of Protractor Measuring Angle—including degree and gradian measurements, target angle alerts, and vertical/horizontal measurements—a premium subscription is required. Choose a subscription plan that fits your needs, whether you're an occasional user or a daily professional.
Start Measuring with Precision Today!
Don't let inaccurate angles compromise your projects. With Protractor Measuring Angle, you have the power to measure and align with confidence. Transform your iOS device into an essential measurement tool for perfectly executed projects and professional results.
Download Protractor Measuring Angle now and experience the future of digital angle measurement—backed by premium features that elevate your work from amateur to expert.
Privacy Policy: https://protractorapp.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://protractorapp.com/terms/
Contact Support: support@appcellent.co
Take the guesswork out of angle measurement—get Protractor Measuring Angle today and achieve perfect alignment every time!

bluejetty:00134316:ios.summary:

Save space o
bluejetty:00134316:ios.description:
Flacbox is a Hi-Res music player for people who love great sound. Play almost any audio file on your iPhone or iPad in full lossless quality. Stream music from your NAS or cloud, and adjust the sound with a built-in equalizer.
Save space on your device by moving your music to a NAS or cloud. Stream it back, or save songs for offline listening. Your music library updates by itself and sorts songs by album, artist, genre, and composer. Make playlists, change the song order, and manage your files with the built-in file manager. Find any song fast with smart search.
The equalizer has genre presets, manual controls, and a tool to make the sound louder. You can save your own presets and share them.
SUPPORTED AUDIO FORMATS
- Lossless and Hi-Res: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, DSF (DSD), PCM.
- Lossy: MP3, AAC, OGG, OPUS, AC3, WMA.
- Containers: M4A, M4V, MP4, MKV, MOV, MPEG.
- Tracker and MOD music: MOD, XM, IT, S3M.
- And more.
AUDIO EFFECTS
- Shape your sound in real time with reverb, delay, echo, chorus, flanger, phaser, and auto-wah.
- Add character with distortion, and control dynamics with a compressor.
- Crossfeed makes headphone listening more natural and less tiring.
DSP CHAIN
- Build your own signal chain from professional filters and tools.
- Filters: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and notch to shape or clean up the sound.
- EQ: peaking, low-shelf, and high-shelf for precise tone control.
- Level and drive: gain, soft-clip saturation, and a bit crusher for a lo-fi edge.
- Creative processors: tremolo, delay, ring modulator, and stereo width.
MUSIC VISUALIZER
- Watch full-screen animated visuals that react live to your music.
- Choose from a large library of presets, or let them cycle.
CLOUD AND PRIVATE STORAGE
- iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, MEGA, Yandex Disk, pCloud, HiDrive, OpenDrive, MediaFire, MyDrive, Put.io, InfiniCLOUD, WD MyCloud Home, Cloud Mail.ru, and Baidu Cloud.
- Private cloud services like MEGA, Internxt, and Proton Drive are also supported.
MEDIA SERVERS
- Connect Plex, Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby to open your full music library.
COMPUTER AND NAS CONNECTIONS
- Connect with SMB, WebDAV, DLNA, FTP, SFTP, and NFS.
- Connects directly to QNAP, WD My Cloud Home, Nextcloud, and Synology Drive.
- Smart buffering helps music play without breaks on slow networks.
- Add files from your computer with iTunes File Sharing or Wi-Fi transfer.
OFFLINE LISTENING
- Save songs, albums, or full artists to listen without internet.
- Turn on the audio cache to save recent songs without doing it by hand.
LYRICS AND COMMENTS
- See timed lyrics and song notes inside each track.
- Add the Lyrics widget to your Home Screen for quick access.
AIRPLAY AND CHROMECAST
- Send music to Apple TV, HomePod, smart speakers, and other devices with AirPlay, AirPlay 2, or Chromecast.
APPLE CARPLAY
- A simple CarPlay screen lets you choose music while you drive.
WIDGETS
- Home Screen widgets show your playback queue and let you start where you stopped.
PLAYBACK CONTROLS
- Adjust playback speed without changing the pitch.
- Save and restore your play queue and last position.
- Sleep timer and skip time controls.
- Shuffle and repeat modes, including stop after the current track.
- Plays in the background while you use other apps.
FILE MANAGER AND LIBRARY
- Sort your music by title, album, artist, album artist, genre, composer, rating, year, BPM, play count, bitrate, or length.
- Edit song tags with the built-in ID3 editor.
- Open files from external memory cards.
- Save playlists in M3U, M3U8, and CUE formats.
QUICK ACCESS
- Find your music in Recently Played, Favorites, and Bookmarks.
AUDIO QUALITY
- Sample rates from 8 kHz to 384 kHz.
- Audio output in default or mixed mode.
- Support for 1 to 7 audio channels.
Get Flacbox now and turn your iPhone into a real Hi-Res player.
Privacy Policy: https://www.everappz.com/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.everappz.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00021399:ios.name: miCal - The missing Calendar
bluejetty:00021399:ios.summary:
miCal is THE calendar that you’ve always wished your iPhone or iPad had! miCal makes scheduling easier, clearer—and better looking—than ever before.
Quick Overview
The dashboard displays your current appointments and events, tasks and birt
bluejetty:00021399:ios.description:
miCal is THE calendar that you’ve always wished your iPhone or iPad had! miCal makes scheduling easier, clearer—and better looking—than ever before.
Quick Overview
The dashboard displays your current appointments and events, tasks and birthdays. You can also see the current weather and an overview of the current month at a glance.
Intuitive Controls 
Intuitively navigate through your calendars and quickly, easily add events and tasks thanks to predefined settings and simple controls. Standard settings like repeating events and reminders/alarms are just a tap away. And powerful special settings are also available, without sacrificing comfort or control. Swipe through views and open events or days with just a tap.
miCal Understands You
Quickly create events with the new natural language input feature. Natural language input allows you to create events just by describing them. And if you have Siri enabled on your device, you can even dictate your event details instead of typing.
The Total Package
miCal provides complete, well-organized day, week and month views and displays the calendar week in all the important views.
Relax
You don’t need to contort yourself with miCal. miCal supports portrait as well as landscape formats in nearly every view. Use each view however it’s most comfortable for you.
Tasks/Reminders
miCal now supports iOS reminders. Create reminders for all the important tasks in your private and professional life right in the app.
Birthday Manager
Never again miss an important birthday. Get reminders at preset times featuring the music of your choice.
Nice Weather
Five-day weather forecasts plus the sunrise/sunset times, humidity and wind speed for the current day. The dashboard even features a quick summary of the current weather as well as a brief forecast of the coming days.
Comprehensive
miCal offers a unique range of features. Copy, move or send your events. Export your events in the date range of your choice as CSV (for Excel, etc.) or ICS (the calendar format). Set colors for your calendars and individual appointments or automatically add colors based on keywords in event titles.
Up to Date and Secure
miCal communicates with your device’s integrated calendar. miCal works with all the calendar services that your device currently supports (iCloud, Google Calendar, Outlook, Exchange, Facebook Events, subscriptions) without requiring additional configuration. That way, you can store your data locally or via the services you know and trust—it’s up to you. miCal itself does not transmit any data to external services or other servers. That allows us to ensure 100% data security.
Award-Winning
- 3rd place in the "Best German iPhone App" competition at the 2010 iPhone Developer conference.
- Featured as App of the Week in 13 countries.
- Recommendation from iPhoneWelt and a 5-star rating from iPhone&Co, two of the leading iPhone magazines
- Honored at the 2010 App Developer Conference

Think of SplashID as your personal
bluejetty:00171036:ios.description:
SplashID is the world's most trusted password storage system. For over 12 years, over one million users have kept their passwords safe with SplashID - and now it gets even better with an all-new version.
Think of SplashID as your personal vault or digital wallet on the iPhone or iPad. You can store and lock sensitive information - not just usernames and passwords but credit card data, account numbers, registration codes, prescriptions, and much more.
Keeping your usernames, passwords, and bank account numbers in your head, in a Word or Excel file, or written on a piece of paper is unsafe. Passwords can be forgotten; laptops can be lost. With SplashID, your data is easily and quickly accessible, reliably stored, and - most importantly - secure.
SplashID gives you the following features:
- Access: Free, native, secure apps for mobile, desktop, web, and browser
- Choice of sync and storage: You decide how to store and sync your records with convenient cloud sync, local network Wi-Fi sync, or on-device storage
- Touch ID login
- Customizable record types and categories to keep your information organized
- Photo capture feature to quickly and easily store credit card information
- You can upload photos, documents, and add notes to any record for reference
- Protection with 256-bit encryption and 2-factor authentication
- Secure sharing: Safely share your records with other SplashID users or even those who don’t use SplashID
- Automatic SplashID Backup service to ensure data never gets lost
- Security dashboard provides you with usage statistics and tools to monitor and fix weak, reused, and old passwords
- Web autofill saves typing in usernames, passwords, and delivers the correct address from the secure data vault every time to prevent phishing
- SplashID extension is available for autofill in Safari
Lock your personal information up in a state-of-the-art data saver and feel comfortable knowing that at any time you can access private information safely.
No other password app delivers SplashID's combination of features, reliability, and security. Compare SplashID to others: https://www.splashid.com/best-password-manager
The app is free to use with basic record storage functionality. A one-year subscription to SplashID Pro gives you many additional features like sync across devices, security dashboard and automated backup for just $19.99. You can purchase the subscription from the app store and it will be charged to your iTunes account. It will auto-renew at the end of the year. Use your iTunes account to cancel the subscription anytime up to 24 hours before the renewal.
You can read about our privacy policy at http://www.splashdata.com/about/privacy.htm
You can read about our terms of service at https://www.splashid.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00027031:ios.name: Acadia National Park GPS Guide
bluejetty:00027031:ios.summary:
Experience Acadia National Park in Bar Harbor, Maine through a narrated self-guided driving tour. Discover stunning vistas, scenic lookouts, and the park's vibrant foliage at your own pace.
Experience the most beautiful sights Maine has to
bluejetty:00027031:ios.description:
Experience Acadia National Park in Bar Harbor, Maine through a narrated self-guided driving tour. Discover stunning vistas, scenic lookouts, and the park's vibrant foliage at your own pace.
Experience the most beautiful sights Maine has to offer! This tour guides you through Acadia’s picturesque wilderness, and introduces you to the vibrant history of both the park and Bar Harbor itself.
Learn about the Native American tribes who once called this place home, and the legends they passed down over the centuries. Hear tales of great celestial bears, hunts that change the seasons, and more!
Dive deep into the flora and fauna of Acadia as we show you the very best hiking trails and overlooks. Get the inside scoop on the Rockefellers’ connection to the park. And, of course, reach the summit of the majestic Cadillac Mountain.
Featuring riveting stories, a phenomenal narrator, and easy automatic audio, this app puts exploration in the palm of your hand!
Explore the rich natural wonders of Acadia National Park:
■ Bar Island
■ La Rochelle & The Gilded Age
■ Foliage & Fire
■ Hulls Cove Visitor Center
■ Cadillac Mountain Overlook
■ Park Loop & Kebo Golf
■ Great Meadow
■ Sieur de Monts Spring
■ Beaver Pond
■ Jackson Labs
■ Egg Rock Overlook
■ Precipice Trail & Peregrine Falcon
■ Schooner Head Overlook
■ Ocean Path Trailhead
■ Sand Beach
■ Sand Beach Overlook
■ Old Soaker
■ Thunder Hole
■ Monument Cove
■ Gorham Mountain Trailhead
■ Boulder Beach
■ Otter Cliff & Cove
■ Hunters Beach Overlook
■ Jordan Pond & House Restaurant
■ Bubbles Divide Trail
■ Bubble Pond
■ Eagle Lake
■ Bald Porcupine Island
■ Cadillac Mountain Summit
HOW IT WORKS:
As you drive/walk, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour & begin following the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest. 
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you’d like.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots — the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Lifetime purchase
No monthly subscription. No time limits. No usage limits. Enjoy this tour as many times as you like.
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history, culture, and secrets of this famous site with the help of a top-tier narrator and fascinating stories written by experts.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this easy-to-use app won the Laurel Award for Technology from the Newport Mansions, who use the app for over a million tours per year. 
MORE TOURS
▶ Cades Cove:-
Get an unforgettable Smoky Mountain experience in a bite-sized package, where lush wilderness and rich Civil War history combine to form a destination like no other.
▶ Maine Tours Bundle
Discover the best of Maine with this incredible bundle. Explore Portland's urban delights & the scenic wonders of Acadia National Park. Visit the charming seaside town of Bar Harbor, your gateway to rocky shores, mountain trails, & wildlife. At your own pace.
FREE DEMO vs FULL ACCESS:
Check out the totally free demo to get an idea of what this tour is all about. If you like it, purchase the tour to get full access to all of the stories.
QUICK TIPS:
■ Download ahead of time, over data or WiFi.
■ Be sure the phone battery is fully charged or take an external battery pack.
NOTE: 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. This app uses your location service and GPS tracking feature to allow real-time tracking of your route.

bluejetty:00022370:ios.name: Piano Motifs
bluejetty:00022370:ios.summary:
• Let the musical muses of Piano Motifs inspire your device to generate some original and beautiful motifs (short melodies).
• Selected as the Favorite MIDI Generator App two years in a row by the iOS Music Production community!
• Please
bluejetty:00022370:ios.description:
• Let the musical muses of Piano Motifs inspire your device to generate some original and beautiful motifs (short melodies).
• Selected as the Favorite MIDI Generator App two years in a row by the iOS Music Production community!
• Please note that Piano Motifs is not an AI app. All motifs are algorithmically generated using music theory.
• Check out the music that Piano Motifs can generate at: https://soundcloud.com/azul-3d
• For Piano Motifs demos and tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/@azul3dapps
• Create original, catchy and inspiring MIDI loops at the touch of a button.
• No musical knowledge or skill is necessary to create completely new and original music. Piano Motifs is the simplest way to generate your own music.
• There are no preset melodies. Melodies are generated algorithmically. The melodic possibilities are endless.
• Set the music tempo or select the key, scale, time signature, octave range, number of bars, melody constraints, melody note frequency and accompaniment style for your motif.
• Option to generate Swing rhythm for the melody, either Shuffle or Hard Swing.
• Program your own chord progressions and let Piano Motifs generate an accompaniment and melody for them.
• Generation of a 3rd track with the option of it being a sustained chord per bar, sustained chord per multiple bars or a drone tone. Ideal for strings, choirs or pads.
• Arrange your motifs to create longer musical pieces.
• Choose from 28 different kinds of accompaniment styles.
• Define your arpeggio accompaniments.
• Choose from 13 different kinds of melody constraints.
• Major, Minor, Lydian, Mixolydian, Dorian, Phrygian, Harmonic Minor and Phrygian Dominant scales supported.
• Loop your motifs
• Save your motifs as MIDI files so you can edit them or add more instrumentation to them on your favorite Digital Audio Workstation (DAW).
• When exporting a MIDI file, export with a third MIDI track with a sustained chord per bar, sustained chord per multiple bars or a drone tone (Ideal for synth pads, strings or chorus).
• Share audio or MIDI through iMessages, e-mail, Whatsapp or AirDrop. Save audio, MIDI or .motif file to your device's file system.
• AUv3 MIDI Plug-In In-App Purchase: 
Incorporate Piano Motifs seemlessly in your workflow by instantiating it once or multiple times in an app that can host AUv3 MIDI Plug-Ins, for example: AUM, AudioBus 3, ApeMatrix, Drambo or EG Nodes. Please note that Piano Motifs as an AUv3 MIDI Plug-In will not play any sound by itself, it generates MIDI that can be routed to other apps and effects instantiated in a host. IMPORTANT: GarageBand does not support MIDI only Plug-ins, so the AUv3 will not work in GarageBand.
• AUv3 MIDI Plug-In features include:
- Ability to play Piano Motifs in sync and out of sync with the host.
- State saving functionality.
- Independent programmable MIDI channels for melody, accompaniment, optional third track, and optional melody harmony track.
- Interactive octave shifting for melody and accompaniment.
- Controllable Melody and Accompaniment Velocity parameters.
- Start Delay and BPM multiple with respect to the Host in Sync mode.
• MIDI Out In-App Purchase: 
Play the music generated by Piano Motifs on your favorite synthesizer, DAW, a connect/route/mix app like AUM, or any app that has Virtual MIDI Destination (MIDI In) capabilities. IMPORTANT: Before purchasing please be aware that Piano Motifs DOES NOT OFFER Ableton Link functionality.
• MIDI Out In-App Purchase features include: 
- Programmable delay for the start of a motif
- Independent programmable MIDI channels for melody, accompaniment and an optional third track
• Piano Motifs chooses a music key from many different scales and an accompaniment from a varied set of accompaniments. Piano Motifs then uses its musical theory algorithms to overlay a melody in the chosen key and accompaniment. Piano Motifs are short, they go from around 16 seconds to around 30 seconds.

Life & Savings Insurance

Three languages to learn through play: English, Spanish and Russian. Busy Kids teaches children aged 2 to 7 to read by syllable chunks, from the very first letters to whole fairy tales, with Uni the unicorn as their guide.
A beautiful new
bluejetty:00022121:ios.description:
Three languages to learn through play: English, Spanish and Russian. Busy Kids teaches children aged 2 to 7 to read by syllable chunks, from the very first letters to whole fairy tales, with Uni the unicorn as their guide.
A beautiful new kids' interface: the whole menu is one rotating ball of clouds, and every cloud opens a story, a game or a tune.
THREE LANGUAGES, ONE APP
• Pick the language each child learns: games, stories and voice follow along
• A gentle start for beginners: letters, sounds, phonics chunks and first sight words
• Fairy tales in each language, every word voiced
• Perfect for bilingual families: keep Russian alive at home, add English or Spanish
WORD WORKSHOP - THE HEART OF THE APP
A talking keyboard: your child types any word and every letter speaks. The word splits into chunks (with syllable rainbows above in Russian), then Uni, Kitty or Robby hops across them and reads each one aloud. Type English, Spanish or Russian, even two alphabets in one phrase (МАМА CAT), pick the look of the letters, and record the reading as a video to send to grandma.
READ AND WRITE
• Word Workshop - type, listen, split words into chunks
• Fairy Tales - illustrated tales in each language, every word voiced; tap a chunk to hear it
• Build a Word - a crane game that stacks words and builds an island town
• Find a Letter - a letter-catching adventure across a big map
• Tracing - lines, Latin and Cyrillic letters, then whole words
WORLD AROUND
• Discovery World - tap objects in lively panoramas and hear their names
• I Spy - spoken riddles
• Room - unlock objects by spelling their names
PUZZLE GAMES
• Memory: Letters, Memory: Chunks
• Picture Puzzles
• Boxes - box-pushing logic puzzles
• Containers - more brain teasers
DRAW AND PLAY MUSIC
• Coloring - pages in many themes, plus free Drawing
• Piano, Drums, Melodies - ready-made songs to play and your own tunes to compose
REWARDS AND FRIENDS
• Earn stars and fill a sticker album, shareable to WhatsApp and Telegram
• Pick a friend: Uni the unicorn, Kitty the kitten or Robby the robot
FOR PARENTS
• No ads
• A profile for every child: own progress, language, play timer and drawings
• Daily play-time limit and progress stats
• Parental gate on purchases, the parents' area and sharing
• Games work offline
SUBSCRIPTION & PURCHASES

bluejetty:00041277:ios.description:
Here in the forest, a red door appears at night.
For some time now, it has been called the Hall of the Inquirers.
It is easy to get in, but not so easy to get out.
When you emerge from the hall, you will be in possession of magical powers
Will you be able to leave?
The long and short night is about to begin.
■◇■------- Features -------■◇■
This escape games is a large scale puzzle solving world consisting of 3 stages.
All controls are simple, just tap the screen.
You can start the game from the middle of the stage because the game automatically saves your progress.
If you get stuck on how to proceed, "hints" and "answers" are provided so that you can proceed smoothly to the end.
You can enjoy the game for free until the end.
This Escape room contains a rich levels packed with escape puzzles.
This game is an adventure escape mystery.
Now, enjoy the escape game.
■◇■------- How to play -------■◇■
Tap the place you are interested in and check it out!
　You may be able to solve a puzzle or find an item.
Tap the item box to zoom in on the item you have obtained.
Items can be combined with other items or used in the field.
Hints for solving puzzles are hidden in various places. Tap in various places to find clues.
If you are not sure how to proceed or how to solve a puzzle, you can use the "Hint" button.
　If you are not sure how to proceed or how to solve a puzzle, you can use the "Hint" button.
　If you still can't solve the puzzle after looking at the "Hints," there is an "Answer" button to help you solve the puzzle.
If you want to start from the middle of the puzzle, click the "CONTINUE" button on the title screen to continue.
■◇■------- Provided by -------■◇■
We used sound effects from the following sites.
Pocket Sound http://pocket-se.info/
Sound Effect Lab https://soundeffect-lab.info/

bluejetty:00119379:ios.description:

- Tab "Mortgage" displays a result in an early payoff duration with many options:
+ Support various kind of payment frequency: weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly.
+ Support extra payment on each payment; from a particular payment to last payment or extra payment on some specific payments (number of extra at specific payments is limited to 60 per loan).
+ Support input of tax or insurance in both percentage or value.
+ Support loading saved mortgages
- Tab "Affordable Loan" helps to estimate the loan you can afford based on your monthly budget or annual income.
- Tab "Payoff" focuses on many payoff options.
- Tab "Saved" helps you record a mortgage so that you do not need to input all loan info from times to times.
- Tab "Setting" supports selecting display mode (Light mode / Dark Mode).
It is easy to use and simple to use.

bluejetty:00088388:ios.description:
1. Profession functions refer to OE level functions, such as read/clear code, data flow diagram, read ECU, drive test, bidirectional special functions, etc.
2. Support full-function OBD II diagnosis, read data flow, freeze frame read IM/real-time data, read/clear fault code, vehicle on-board monitoring/computer system control operation and read vehicle information.

4. Select any vehicle diagnostic software, covering up to 39 major automobile manufacturers. 
5. Support automatic VIN reading and one-key diagnosis. 
6. Clear interpretation of fault codes and generate professional diagnostic reports. 
7. Be able to communicate with other users within the ThinkDiag community (share/help/support).
Not only for "ThinkDiag" and "ThinkDiag 2" device, but also works for "ThinkDiag Mini", "ThinkDirver", and "Thinkcar Pro" devices. 
ThinkDiag, an innovative vehicle diagnostic tool, is specially designed for repair technicians, small and medium-sized repair shops, and DIYers, to achieve the original manufacturer level diagnostic performance. It supports more than 100 vehicle brands of diagnostic services, including 15 special maintenance reset functions. ThinkDiag is as good as those comprehensive diagnostic equipment costed thousands of dollars. 
ThinkDiag is also an intelligent diagnostic device. Connecting with smartphone via Bluetooth, it is controlled to work by app. In the app, there is a diagnostic software store, and users can subscribe for diagnostic software according to their needs.

bluejetty:00043303:ios.summary: يعد تطبيق سبيتار ترجمةً لرؤية المؤسسة بضرورة توفير رعاية صحّية عالية الجودة لجميع من يحتاجها وأينما كان، حيث يمثّل التطبيق نموذجًا رائدًا في التوظيف الأمثل للتكنولوجيا لتقديم مستوى عالٍ من الرعاية الصحّية، موفّرًا العديد من المزايا ولاغيًا
bluejetty:00043303:ios.description:
يعد تطبيق سبيتار ترجمةً لرؤية المؤسسة بضرورة توفير رعاية صحّية عالية الجودة لجميع من يحتاجها وأينما كان، حيث يمثّل التطبيق نموذجًا رائدًا في التوظيف الأمثل للتكنولوجيا لتقديم مستوى عالٍ من الرعاية الصحّية، موفّرًا العديد من المزايا ولاغيًا حواجز الزمان والمكان، لتصبح الرعاية الصحّية ذات الجودة حقيقةً يمكن للجميع معايشتها بصرف النظر عن ظروفهم وأماكن عيشهم وقدرتهم على الوصول لخدمات الرعاية الصحّية المتخصّصة.
خدمات التطبيق
حجز استشارة عبر الإنترنت -
يمكنك عبر تطبيق سبيتار حجز استشارة عبر الإنترنت من منزلك، حيث يوفّر لك التطبيق إمكانية الاختيار بين أكثر من 35 تخصص طبّي مختلف، بالإضافة لأكثر من 1000 طبيب من داخل ليبيا وخارجها.
يمكنك التحدّث مع الطبيب المختص من خلال مكالمة صوتية، مكالمة فيديو أو من خلال الرسائل القصيرة.
يمكنك رؤية الملف الشخصي للطبيب وتقييماته السابقة من قبل مستخدمين سبق لهم الحجز عنده لمساعدتك في الاختيار.
سيطلب منك التطبيق إدخال بعض الأعراض التي تعاني منها لمساعدة الطبيب المختصّ في تكوين صورة مبدئيّة عن حالتك.
سيتم إرسال إشعار لك لتذكيرك بموعد الاستشارة الخاصّة بك.
خدمة الرعاية المنزليّة - ليبيا -
يوفّر التطبيق إمكانيّة طلب خدمة الرعاية الصحّية داخل ليبيا، حيث أنّه بمجرّد تعبئتك للنموذج المرفق سيقوم فريق سبيتار بربطك بأنسب مزوّد رعاية صحيّة لتلبية طلبك في أسرع وقت.
تشمل خدمات الرعاية المنزليّة:
تركيب المحاليل الوريديّة، إعطاء الأدوية عبر الوريد والعضل.
الغيار على الجروح وفك الغرز.
فحص الضغط والسكّر.
متابعة العلامات الحيويّة.
العلاج الطبيعي:
التأهيل بعد العمليّات.
حالات الشلل الدماغي.
حالات آلام الظهر والرقبة.
حالات الجلطة الدماغيّة.
الكسور وأمراض العظام والعضلات.
العناية بتقرّحات الفراش.
أخذ مسحات كورونا لفحص ال PCR
أخذ عينات تحاليل دم.
تركيب القسطرة البوليّة.
حجز استشارة في المصحّة - ليبيا -
يوفّر لك التطبيق أيضًا إمكانيّة حجز موعد لدى أحد الأطبّاء في إحدى المصحّات الموجودة في ليبيا، حيث سيوفّر عليك ذلك عناء الوقوف في طوابير الانتظار الطويلة ومخالطة أعداد كبيرة من الناس، مما سيقلل من احتمالية انتقال مختلف أنواع العدوى لك لا قدّر الله.
يمكنك حجز استشارة من خلال البحث عن اسم الطبيب الذي ترغب في الحجز عنده، أو من خلال اختيار أحد الأطبّاء المصنّفين وفق تخصّصاتهم وأماكن تواجدهم في مصحّات ليبيا ومراكزها الطبّية المختلفة.
إنشاء ملف صحّي إلكتروني
هل عانيت مسبقًا من تكرار ضياع نتائج تحاليلك ووثائقك الصحّية؟
يمكنك عبر تطبيق سبيتار إنشاء ملف صحّي إلكتروني خاص بك يمكنك من خلاله استقبال وإرسال الوصفات الطبّية، نتائج التحاليل، صور الأشعّة وغيرها من الوثائق الطبّية التي يمكنك الاحتفاظ بها بسهولة وأمان داخل ملفك الشخصي على التطبيق.
مميزات تطبيق سبيتار
سهولة الاستخدام.
توفير درجة عالية من الخصوصية.
فريق دعم متوفّر على مدار الساعة لاستقبال الملاحظات.
مرونة وتعدّد طرق الدفع.
أكثر من 35 تخصص طبّي.
أكثر من 1000 طبيب من داخل ليبيا وخارجها.
ملائم للهواتف بمختلف أنواعها.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/speetarhealthi
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/speetarhealth
Email: info@speetar.com

تشمل خدمات الرعاية المنزليّة:
تركيب المحاليل الوريديّة، إعطاء الأدوية عبر الوريد والعضل.

حالات الجلطة الدماغيّة.

حجز استشارة في المصحّة - ليبيا  -

يمكنك حجز استشارة من خلال البحث عن اسم الطبيب الذي ترغب في الحجز عنده، أو من خلال اختيار أحد الأطبّاء المصنّفين وفق تخصّصاتهم وأماكن تواجدهم في مصحّات ليبيا ومراكزها الطبّية المختلفة.

- Curious about your male or female version? Masculine or feminine? See what you'd look like as a different gender.

bluejetty:00026806:ios.description:
This App offers access to Marine Charts for USA,Canada,UK/Ireland,Germany,Netherlands/Holland &
Europe Rivers (Danube,Drava,Rhein etc). Coverage includes NOAA marine vector
charts,freshwater lake maps,USACE inland river maps (HD/1ft/3ft bathymetry
included where available),charts derived from UKHO & CHS data. First marine GPS app to have route assistance with Voice Prompts for marine navigation. You can create new boating routes or import existing GPX/KML routes. It supports Nautical Charts course up orientation. Includes Tide & Currents prediction.
►FEATURES
√ Beautiful & detailed Hardware/GPU accelerated vector charts (text stays upright on rotation)
√ Long press to query the details of Marine object (Buoy,Lights,Obstruction etc).
√ Customizable depth(Ft/Fathom/Meter) & distance units(km/mi/NM)
√ Customizable Shallow Depth.
√ Record tracks,Autofollow with real-time track overlay & predicted path vector.
√ Voice Prompts for marine navigation (requires GPS )
√ 1ft / 3ft depth contour maps for anglers for selected lake maps.
√ Supports GPX/KML for boating route editing/import.
√ Tide & Currents prediction.
√ Seamless chart quilting of marine charts
√ Enter or import Waypoints.
► MAPS
It includes unlimited updates for 1 year. 
√USA: The maps include coverage of all NOAA marine vector charts (ENC),USACE inland river maps,freshwater lake maps for more than 7K lakes. The charts include HD/1ft/3ft bathymetry where available.Incl. NOAA raster where ENC not available. 
√Canada:Incl. CHS data(incl. major Lakes).
√UK/Ireland: Derived from UKHO charts.
√Australia
√Germany: derived from BSH data
√Europe Inland Rivers:Donau/Dunaja,Rhine,Garonne,Moselle,Drava,Sava,etc
√Norway
√Finland
√Sweden
√Croatia
√Ukraine(Black Sea)
√Caribbean
√New Zealand
√Spain
√Brazil
√Argentina
√Cyprus
√Falklands
√Seychelles& Mauritius
√Denmark
√Malta,Cyprus & S. Mediterranean
√S. China&Malaysia
√South Africa

√ Create New Route/Edit Existing Routes
√ Move Points
√ Add points to an existing route leg
√ Delete / Rename points
√ Import GPX,KML & KMZ files
√ Plot/Edit Routes 
√ Enter Waypoints
√ Share/Export Routes,Tracks&Markers
√ Reverse Routes
►SLIP TO SLIP AUTO ROUTING 
►GPS FEATURES
√ Auto Follow
 * Real Time Track Overlay
 * Predicted Path Vector
 * Course Up(Text stays upright)
 * Speed & Heading
√ Route Assistance With Voice Prompts
 * Prompts when approaching a boating route marker
 * Continous distance & ETA updates
 * Alerts when sailing/boating off route
 * Alerts when boating in wrong direction
√ Record Tracks
►TIDE & CURRENTS
 * For US,Canada,UK,Germany & New Zealand
 * High/Low Tides
 * Tidal Current Prediction
 * Active Current Stations
►Instrumentation
√ Marine AIS & (NMEA AIS and GPS over TCP/UDP)
√ Wind direction & Speed,Marine Sonar depth,Water temperature
√ Auto Pilot
► SHARING
 * Share tracks/routes/markers on Facebook & Twitter

bluejetty:00186910:ios.description:
ASL Sign Language Dictionary. Over 5,200 Signed words in ASL. The most complete ASL American Sign Language Video Dictionary.
Translate English into ASL, from A-Z, plus the entire numerical system, common English phrases, symbols and much more. A must have educational iPhone, and iPad app.
**One time fee, no ad's and nothing else to pay for.
FEATURES
• Over 5,200 signs from A-Z
• 765 Multiple meaning words signed
• Multiple word signs such as “don’t want” & “hard of hearing”
• 473 Idioms translated 
• Time
• Money
• Dates, Months, Years
• General numbers
• Finger Spelled Alphabet
• Symbols
• Common Phrases like “You’re too late”
• Dark Mode (Found under device Settings, Display and Brightness)

Learn Sign Language, by watching our professional Sign Language interpreter and instructor sign over 5,200 individual and multiple word signs. ASL is the first language for people who are deaf.
OVER 5,200 SIGNED WORDS
**No Internet required. (All 5200 videos are included in the ASL Dictionary)
**Note: If you are a hearing person, there is no sound with this application.
**Comments, questions or support, please contact us at appsavers@gmail.com 
***Guaranteed to work perfectly. If you have an issue please email us for help at appsavers@gmail.com Thank You***

bluejetty:00037883:ios.description:
Rhythm with Tabla & Tanpura is your all-in-one app to practice, compose, or perform Indian classical music. Singers, dancers and composers get realistic tabla, tanpura, manjeera and swarmandal at their fingertips.
* Easy to use
* Beautiful tone of manual tabla and tanpura
Key Features:
* 10 tabla taals free, 60+ with the Full Pack.
* Tabla fillers and a closing tihai.
* Manjeera for accompaniment with tabla (Full Pack).
* 1 tanpura pattern free, all 18 with the Full Pack.
* 2 tanpura voices, and 2 tanpuras at a time.
* Swarmandal with 115+ raags.
* C# scale free, all 12 scales with the Full Pack.
* Individual instrument's pitch fine tuner, volume and tempo control.
* Left and right pan for each instrument, best heard on headphones.
* Beat counter with progress, useful at very low tempo.
* Vibrate on Beat (can be turned off from settings).
* Karaoke style tabla bol highlighter.
* Session Manager to save and load your practice setups.
* No time limit, keeps playing with the screen off.
* Settings for vibration, screen awake, taal sorting and more.
* Tabla loop count and duration to track your practice.
Tabla:
- Control tempo between 10 - 720.
- Sam marked by a bell, with its own volume in settings.
- Control scale of bayan as per your needs.
- Fillers add variations between cycles, as often and busy as you like.
- End button plays a closing tihai landing on sam.
Tanpura:
- Control tempo between 40 - 150.
- Choose between three playing styles: 5 beat (North Indian), 6 beat (Carnatic) or 4 beat (Even).
- Choose between two voices, a deeper original and a brighter, higher one.
- Add a second tanpura, with its own note, voice, tempo and volume.
Swarmandal:
- Play Aroha and Avaroha.
- Control tempo between 60 - 720.
- Choose repeat interval.
Full Pack (one-time purchase):
- 60+ taals and more variations of each taal.
- All 18 tanpura patterns.
- All 12 scales.
- Manjeera.
- No ads.
- Restore on any device with your Apple ID.

bluejetty:00094140:ios.description:
نظام المرقاب الالكتروني
هو نظام تم إنتاجه من قبل مركز الكفيل لتقنية المعلومات لغرض تسهيل العملية التربوية وتطويرها من خلال استغلال التكنولوجيا الحديثة لتوفير وسيلة تواصل بين إدارة المدرسة وأولياء الأمور وتمكينهم من الاطلاع على مستوى الطالب العلمي وسلوكه لحظة بلحظة دون تكبد عناء الذهاب إلى المدرسة.
مميزات التطبيق:
- يتم استعمال التطبيق من خلال إدخال رمز سري خاص بحساب الطالب أو الكادر التدريسي توفره لهم إدارة المدرسة للدخول إلى التطبيق والاستفادة من الخدمات التي يقدمها وفق صلاحيات مخصصة لكل حساب.
- يحتوي التطبيق على معلومات كاملة عن الطالب مثل: الصف والمرشد وكافة المعلومات الأساسية للطالب، بالإضافة إلى تقييمات السلوك والتقييمات العلمية والدرجات والرسائل وغيرها.
- يوفر التطبيق إمكانية إرسال تبليغات إدارية أو علمية من قبل الأستاذ مع إمكانية إرفاق صور مع التبليغ وظهور إشعار صوتي لحظة وصوله.
- يوفر التطبيق خاصية المراسلة بين ولي الأمر والكادر التدريسي أو الإداري، وحسب نظام الصلاحيات الذي تحدده الإدارة.
- يمكن من خلال التطبيق الاطلاع على التقويم المدرسي الذي يحتوي على أهم الأحداث السنوية للمدرسة، كبداية الدوام ومواعيد العطل والسفرات المدرسية وغيرها.
- يدعم التطبيق خاصية تعدد الحسابات، بحيث يمكن فتح أكثر من حساب لطالب أو لكادر تدريسي في التطبيق، واستلام التبليغات والرسائل وكافة الإشعارات المهمة من كل الحسابات في نفس الوقت.
- يوفر التطبيق خاصية القفل بكلمة مرور لمنع التطفل والتلاعب.

bluejetty:00150594:ios.summary:

This is the app that makes home delivery even more convenient.
Change your standing order, add or remove items from your next
bluejetty:00150594:ios.description:
Longmont Dairy delivers fresh milk, in glass bottles, to subscribed customers throughout the Denver metro area.
This is the app that makes home delivery even more convenient.
Change your standing order, add or remove items from your next order, or skip a delivery if you will be out of town, all from the convenience of your phone.
Now you can set a reminder to update your order before your delivery.
Edit your account information including email, phone numbers and payment information.
Longmont Dairy delivers farm fresh milk to your front porch, that tastes great, and saves time and trips to the store.
Milk is our specialty. Our cows are locally raised. Our chocolate milk is outrageous as are LDF eggnog, Pro-to-Go protein milk, strawberry, root beer, and orange cream milks.
Enjoy our must-have food products including coffee, juices, eggs, sausages, bread, and yogurts.
We also deliver meal kits, cheeses, cottage cheese, butter and sour cream, cold brewed coffee and tea. Most of our products are locally produced.
You haven’t really tasted milk unless it comes overnight-fresh in a glass bottle.
For Prospective Customers:
Our delivery area is from Castle Pines to Loveland, Colorado. We cannot deliver to apartments and some neighborhoods. Call our office for new deliveries, or visit our website at www.longmontdairy.com to sign-up.

bluejetty:00140038:ios.description:
Remote Controller for TV gives you all the controls of a standard Roku Smart TV remote. Use Remote Controller for TV to manage & change channels, fast forward, rewind, skip back, adjust volume and much more. You can also navigate menus using the built-in trackpad or make text searches right with your phone’s keyboard.
Connecting the app to your device is simple. Just ensure your iOS device and Roku TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network and you’re good to go! 
Key Features:
---------------------------------
• Connect automatically to Roku TVs on your Wi-Fi network
• Access all Smart TV buttons for seamless control
• Spacious Trackpad for easy menu and content navigation
• Effortlessly manage & change TV channels
• Launch popular platforms like Youtube, Netflix, Tubi, HBO, Prime Video, and more with a single tap
• Make fast searches with text entry using your device's keyboard for channels such as Netflix or Youtube, or for searching on your Smart TV
• Compatible with all TV models running Smart TV OS
NEVER LOSE YOUR REMOTE AGAIN
Constantly misplacing your TV remote? Remote Controller for TV acts as the original remote control, granting access to all your device's functionalities straight from your smartphone!
SEAMLESS CONTROL
With its straightforward design and intuitive interface, there's no clutter of buttons or intricate configurations. Use Remote Controller for TV just like you would a regular TV remote!
CONNECT IN SECONDS
With TCL Roku, setup is a breeze. Remote Controller for TV automatically detects and lets you connect to every Smart TV on your network with a tap!
Note: Some apps like YouTube and Hulu+ utilize their own on-screen keyboards instead of the iOS keyboard.
Remote Controller for TV is compatible with all Roku models including Roku 1, Roku 2, Roku 3, Streaming Stick, Express, Express+, Premiere, Premiere+, Ultra, Roku TV, TCL Roku TV, Sharp Roku TV, Hisense, Philips, Onn Roku TV & more.
* Please note that Remote Controller for TV is not an official Roku product, and we are not affiliated with the Roku company.
Privacy Policy https://loopmobile.io/privacy.html
Terms of use https://loopmobile.io/tos.html

Staying on top of award-winning Philadelphia news is now faster and easier than ever with The Philadelphia Inquirer’s iPhone and iPad app — the official iOS news app for The Philadelphia Inquirer and Philadelphia Daily News.

Discover the latest breaking news and important updates with our intuitive news feed and uncluttered reading experience.

Custom Text Size — Read more comfortably with the ability to increase/decrease article font sizes.
Split Screen Support — Multitask with The Inquirer App and other apps at the same time on compatible iPads.
Today Widget — Quickly access the latest headlines by adding our custom widget to your homescreen or Today screen.
Dark Mode — Activate from the Settings tab and the app will switch to dark mode when activated on your device for easier nighttime reading.

bluejetty:00163784:ios.name: Canadian Migraine Tracker
bluejetty:00163784:ios.summary:
Migraine is invisible on an MRI but very visible on a diary. 
According to headache specialists, the most useful tool for the treatment of migraines is a migraine diary. Start a diary today and be empowered!
The Canadian Migraine Tracker
bluejetty:00163784:ios.description:
Migraine is invisible on an MRI but very visible on a diary. 
According to headache specialists, the most useful tool for the treatment of migraines is a migraine diary. Start a diary today and be empowered!
The Canadian Migraine Tracker helps you to keep a simple and focused Migraine Diary directly from your smart phone or tablet. Available in English and French.
Here are five good reasons to keep a diary:
• Get a clear idea of your headache frequency and patterns
• Use the data to work with your health care provider
• Monitor the response to treatments (acute, preventive, behavioral)
• Observe triggers 
• Watch medication overuse 
• Bonus: detect menstrual migraine! 
Less is more: simple, focused and designed to optimize your discussions with your health care provider.
You can monitor what is important for you: headache frequency but also triggers, symptoms and medication response.
We built this tool to make communication with your health care provider (family doctor, neurologist, nurse practitioner, pharmacist, etc.) easier. The App focuses on the information usually discussed with physicians. Our reports can be sent to your health care provider in convenient ways: PDF, email and fax.
We hope that you will find this application convenient and easy to use! Please share comments and rate the Canadian Migraine Tracker.
This APP is provided by Migraine Canada migrainecanada.org in collaboration with the Canadian Headache Society headachesociety.ca and Migraine Québec migrainequebec.org
This APP is produced by 3ALogic Inc. 3alogic.com.

Find a positive, electric, Fly Fitness studio near you & join the revolution. One incredible community & all of your favorite workouts in a single fitness studio. Book cycle, barre, HIIT, strength, yoga or Pilates class with one of our high-energy, signature formats design to leave you feeling empowered. 
View our latest sweat schedule, meet our team & book your best sweat. 
FLY CLASSES 
Cycle - The energy, the ambiance, the playlist - this is Fly cycling. Clip into a group fitness class that gets all the details right. Your motivation & output have never been higher. 
Strengthen - Power up with weights, resistance & treadmill circuits to build your strength to new limits. Build for balance & change, our strength, HIIT and weightlifting series will have you leveling up. 
Sculpt - Tone your muscle definition while engaging underworked muscles in our fiery barre, yoga & Pilates series workout classes. 
Pilates Reformer - Fly reformer classes combine the meticulous technique of traditional Pilates with the pacing of megaformer classes to Application Description produce our signature high-energy Fly burn on the reformer. 
FLY STUDIOS 
Explore our Fly studios & meet the team in a city near you. Find all the details on the latest intro offers, theme classes & the need-to-knows of your next Fly class. Explore the brands that our in-studio boutiques stock and the amenities that will make Fly your home way from home. 
FLY PHILOSOPHY 
When motivation wanes, community prevails. Fly is built around the idea that fitness isn’t a trend, it’s a lifestyle. Fly fitness isn’t just a gym, it is a place to belong and thrive. To stick with a lifestyle, we believe we must build deep connections with others–from our team to our members and our members to each other. All of our Fly classes are build around one philosophy: 
WE LISTEN TO WHAT WE KNOW INSTEAD OF WHAT WE FEAR. OUR ENERGY IS POSITIVE, OUR VIBE ELECTRIC. WE MAKE EVERYBODY FEEL LIKE A SOMEBODY. WE LET GO OF THOUGHTS THAT DON’T MAKE US STRONG. OUR TRUTH IS AUTHENTICITY, WE HAVE NOTHING TO PROVE. WE ARE A COMMUNITY OF PEOPLE WHO ASPIRE TO BE AWESOME, SEEKING OPPORTUNITIES & REJECTING EXPECTATIONS. TOGETHER & AS INDIVIDUALS, WE ARE AMAZING. WE ARE FLY. 
See the latest from our Fly community @lnkfeelsfly on Instagram

- Soft and fast speed of sound response

Do you like diorama bricks and tycoon game?
Download and try My Music Tower!

bluejetty:00136610:ios.description:
Linky AI is a Top1 AI chat bot, offering free and immersive AI conversations with unique characters. Whether you want to talk, roleplay, or enjoy a fantasy AI experience, Linky AI lets you interact with anime personas, virtual friends, and soulful AI partners. With advanced AI voice and text features, you can call, message, or even engage in deep AI-driven story simulations. From casual entertainment to meaningful online interactions, Linky AI brings magic to your AI world. 
■ Chat with Millions of Unique AI Characters
Linky AI lets you connect with a vast range of AI characters—whether from anime, games, movies, or history. 
Each AI has its own unique voice, personality, and backstory, offering diverse interactions and making conversations come to life.
■ Create and Share Your Own AI Characters

bluejetty:00092303:ios.description:
Find what you want to watch, when you want to watch it and forget about binge-watch blindness.
Gatsby is a way to find the best TV shows and movies on Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Hulu, HBO, Apple TV+ and others. You can recommend and share what you watch with your friends and get suggestions based on what you like.
What is Gatsby?
Gatsby is an app that unlocks all of the TV Shows and Film content you could ever want.
Discover shows and movies across all of the streaming platforms, add them to your watchlist and recommend them to your friends with our built-in social sharing features.
With Gatsby, you will never not have a new series or movie on the go!
Download the app and instantly start surfing for incredible, undiscovered titles that you can start watching right now.
What is Binge-watch blindness?
Binge-watch blindness occurs when you get comfy on the couch, switch on your favorite streaming service, spend ages searching for something to watch and, in the end, settle for something you have already watched multiple times before.
Why waste your time watching something you have already watched before when you could be indulging in a brand new series?!
Grab life by the remotes and get properly stuck in to the best titles the world has to offer you.
How to make the most out of Gatsby
When you download the app, you will be asked to tell us what you have watched recently and what you have your eye on.
With this information, we sort through thousands of titles available on the streaming services you have access to and start recommending the best shows to you.
While you’re at it, invite your friends along for the ride. Recommend titles between you, chat about what you’re watching (minus the #spoilers) and even post your own content all through the same app.
Keep coming back to the app to get personalized and up to date recommendations.
With Gatsby, you will never complain about what’s on the TV again.

Follow us on Instagram: https://instagram.com/tv_gatsby
Support, Feedback, or Questions please email support@gatsby.tv
Privacy Policy: https://www.gatsby.tv/policy

bluejetty:00074175:ios.description:

SponsorBlock lets you skip over sponsors, intros, outros, subscription reminders, and other annoying parts of YouTube videos. SponsorBlock is a crowdsourced browser extension that let's anyone submit the start and end time's of sponsored segments and other segments of YouTube videos. Once one person submits this information, everyone else with this extension will skip right over the sponsored segment.
You can also skip over non music sections of music videos.
This is open source and the entire database is public.

bluejetty:00157688:ios.description:
Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic: A Free, Relaxing Color-Sorting Puzzle Game
Immerse yourself in the delightful world of color-matching with Water Sort Puzzle - Color Magic, a water sort puzzle game crafted to both stimulate your mind and calm your spirit. Perfect for casual play, brain-boosting exercises, stress relief, offline enjoyment, or family-friendly fun, this captivating water color sort game has something for everyone to enjoy.
— Water Sorting Game With a Simple One Finger Control —
Whether you're playing a water pouring game or a liquid sort game, the easy one finger controls make it accessible for everyone. This feature nicely fits commuters looking for a bottle filling game to play on the go or anyone who prefers intuitive touch controls for their gaming experience.
—Color-Matching Puzzle Gameplay—
Experience the joy of solving color puzzles in this water sort game. Match the same-colored water in glasses until each color is separated into its own glass. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a relaxing bottle filling game puzzle to enjoy during short breaks or a parent seeking an educational yet fun bottle filling game for your children, this water sorting game is suitable for all ages.
—Thousands of Unique Levels—
Never run out of fun with thousands of unique, addictive levels in this captivating bottle filling game. Every puzzle in Water Sort Puzzle - Color Magic is thoughtfully designed to keep you engaged and entertained. If you enjoy keeping your mind sharp with logic challenges, this water sort puzzle game delivers endless bottle filling puzzles to conquer.
— Offline Mode —
Enjoy the free water sort game of Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection, making it suitable for long flights, commutes, etc. Ideal for anyone needing some fun offline bottle filling game entertainment.
— Free-to-Play Water Sort Puzzle —
Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic is completely free to download and play. There are no subscriptions required, making it a truly free water sort game experience. Try the bottle filling game free of change and enjoy endless color-sorting puzzles without any cost. This is great for casual gamers who want an engaging bottle filling game without any financial commitment.
— A Water Sorting Game With No Penalties or Time Limits —
Play at your own pace with no penalties or time limits. Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic is designed to be a relaxing and stress-free experience. Whether you're enjoying a water sort game or a fill tube game, you can take your time and solve each puzzle without pressure. A nice relaxing bottle filling game for those looking to unwind after a long day.
- Water Color Sort Extra Flask Option -
Stuck on a challenging level in the fill the bottle game? Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic gives you an extra flask to help you out. This feature offers more flexibility and options to solve the puzzle. It's an excellent feature for players who enjoy problem-solving and need that little extra help to get through tough puzzles.
- Stress-free Bottle Filling Game -
Made a misstep? No worries! Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic lets you effortlessly undo your actions. Whether you’re tackling a water sorting challenge or mastering a water pouring puzzle, you can quickly fix mistakes and stay on track. It’s perfect for players who enjoy experimenting with diverse strategies and techniques.
- Fill The Tube Game For Brain Exercise -
If you find yourself stuck, Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic lets you restart the water sort puzzle and try a new strategy. This feature supports brain exercise by encouraging different ways to solve puzzles.
Experience brain-teasing water sort puzzles with Water Sort Puzzle -Color Magic. Whether you're playing to unwind, challenge your brain, or enjoy family-friendly fun, this water sorting game has it all. Embrace the addictive gameplay of free water sort games and discover endless hours of entertainment.

bluejetty:00025409:ios.summary: GhostTube SEER is the world's first AI-powered paranormal investigative tool. The app combines theories of spiritual communication and the human psyche, mind and interpretation using the power of modern-day artificial intelligence. GhostTub
bluejetty:00025409:ios.description:
GhostTube SEER is the world's first AI-powered paranormal investigative tool. The app combines theories of spiritual communication and the human psyche, mind and interpretation using the power of modern-day artificial intelligence. GhostTube SEER adds a new dimension to experimental spiritual communication that is unmatched by traditional tools and experimental techniques.
GhostTube SEER uses your mobile device's actual sensors to measure and react to changes in your environment - It reacts by selecting words from the pre-populated word bank when specific environmental signatures are detected. It then runs selected words through an advanced artificial intelligence algorithm to produce unique, AI-generated visuals. It can also be used with GhostTube Lens, the world's first virtual reality headset for paranormal investigators, for a more immersive experience and adding a whole new dimension to your paranormal experiments.
Features included with the GhostTube SEER artificial intelligence paranormal app:
- Ghost dictionary with thousands of pre-loaded words
- Magnetometer to measure and react to magnetic changes, including the potential presence of EMF
- AI-art generator using advanced artificial intelligence algorithms
- Gallery to manage AI-generated art
- Can be used with GhostTube Lens headset for sensory deprivation experiments*
- Low light video filters to aid video filming in dark places
- Customizable skins and filters to enhance and personalize videos
- Access to GhostTube paranormal community and database with details on over 1000+ haunted places around the world.
*Some features may require in-app purchases, and/or may not be available in all regions.
For more paranormal investigation and ghost hunting tools, check out our other apps.
GhostTube offers in-app purchases and subscriptions. Refer to our website for a full list of terms and conditions: https://ghosttube.com/terms
GhostTube is intended for use and enjoyment on real paranormal investigations and is a suitable substitute or supplementary device for many of the devices used on a typical investigation. But you need to keep in mind that the afterlife is a theoretical concept. It is often categorized as paranormal because the phenomena is not supported or explained by the natural laws of science currently understood and accepted in the scientific community. Paranormal tools in general are designed to measure and react to changes in the environment only. As such, paranormal tools should never be relied on to make important life decisions, as a form of definitive communication, or to cope with grief or loss. Words or sounds generated do not represent the views or opinions of the developer or its affiliates, and they should never be interpreted as instructions or requests.

bluejetty:00067969:ios.description:
Welcome to "Fake Island: Demolish!" - your ultimate offline city smash game. Get ready to demolish iconic structures worldwide with a simple and satisfying gameplay experience. This demolition game, based on real physics and gravity, lets you destroy various structures, including buildings, skyscrapers, towers, castles, and even fake landmarks. Unleash destruction, wreak havoc, and enjoy the thrill of tearing down the world!
Are you ready for the destruction of the world's famous buildings? Just place dynamites properly and fire. Demolition is now more fun! Smash solar panels and landmarks. This is an offline city smash game.
If you like destruction games and want to destroy cities and destroy buildings you will enjoy our building destruction game. Break houses and enjoy demolition and destruction.
Fake Island: Demolish is a building demolition game based on real physics and gravity. You need to place the TNTs in the available slots in the builds. Buildings, skyscrapers, lighthouses, power plants, industrial structures, dilapidated buildings are just some different types of structures in the game. You also get to destroy world-famous landmarks. They are not real landmarks but fakes of the original ones. Smash city with amazing buildings. Teardown buildings with one of the best games in the world
As a result of successful demolitions; You get contract offers from mayors of world cities. Each new 10 stars brings a new contract to demolish a 'fake landmark' on the Fake Island. If you don't want to wait to get enough stars to play Landmarks, you can unlock them with diamonds and play instantly. Smash solar buildings with this new game.
KEY FEATURES
City Smash Galore: 
Demolish city landscapes with a variety of structures, from buildings and skyscrapers to lighthouses and power plants. Tear down dilapidated buildings and iconic landmarks.
Explosive Gameplay:
Place TNT strategically in available slots and witness the spectacular results. The game is a perfect mix of strategy and explosive action. Watch as the destruction unfolds with real physics and gravity at play.
Worldwide Chaos:
Embark on a global demolition spree! Receive contract offers from mayors of world cities as you accumulate stars. Each milestone unlocks a new opportunity to demolish a fake landmark on the renowned Fake Island.
Star Power:
Accumulate stars through successful demolitions. Every 10 stars bring exciting new contracts. If you can't wait, use diamonds to unlock and play instantly. It's your chance to be the ultimate demolisher and ruler of destruction.
Simple Yet Addictive:
Enjoy a relaxing yet highly addictive gameplay experience. This game is suitable for all ages, making it the perfect choice for family and friends gatherings. Build your demolishing legacy offline, anytime, anywhere.
Free and Fun:
Download this entertaining game for free and embark on a journey of destruction. It's not just a game; it's a brain exercise wrapped in explosive excitement.
Offline Domination:
Play without the need for an internet connection. Whether you're on a plane, in a waiting room, or simply offline, the demolition fun never stops.
Iconic Structures:
Experience the thrill of destroying a variety of iconic structures. From famous landmarks to everyday buildings, each demolition is a unique and satisfying experience.

● Can be played offline.

● Variety of iconic buildings
● Fun for all ages: The best game for family and friends gatherings!

● Simple and highly addictive gameplay.
● Play without the internet.
● Play offline.

bluejetty:00186064:ios.name: Waypoint EDU
bluejetty:00186064:ios.summary:
Waypoint EDU is a fun, educational augmented-reality scavenger hunt game for classrooms and families.
• New in 3.0, updated for the latest OS, and now you can transfer Hunts between devices wirelessly.
• New in 2.4, improved 3D graphics wi
bluejetty:00186064:ios.description:
Waypoint EDU is a fun, educational augmented-reality scavenger hunt game for classrooms and families.
• New in 3.0, updated for the latest OS, and now you can transfer Hunts between devices wirelessly.
• New in 2.4, improved 3D graphics with ARKit 2.0!
• New in 2.3, create your own Indoor Hunts with up to 5 Waypoints!
• New in 2.0, play Indoors! Use our beautifully designed printable Waypoint Cards to play right in your classroom.
• Teachers (or parents) use Waypoint EDU to create engaging augmented reality geocaches (“Hunts”).
• Setting up a Hunt is very simple – enter a few details, draw a Playfield directly on the map, and enter quiz questions for your curriculum.
• Teachers can transfer Hunts to student devices using AirDrop.
• A game of Waypoint EDU is a great reason for teachers to take their classes outside.
• Includes two sample Hunts. Students can learn about ancient wonders of the world like Stonehenge and the Pyramid of Giza and groundbreaking inventions like the telephone and the lightbulb via scale-model AR.
Please note: the Outdoor mode in Waypoint EDU requires a device with GPS+Cellular to play, though non-cellular devices can be used to create. Indoor mode requires iOS 11.3 or later.
Get outside (or stay inside) and Hunt!
