bluejetty:00063890:ios.name: Pioneer Remote App
bluejetty:00063890:ios.summary:
Pioneer Remote App is an application that allows users to enjoy their favorite music at home on compatible Pioneer & Elite products.
The Pioneer Remote App lets you intuitively operate compatible Pioneer products (control the volume, select
bluejetty:00063890:ios.description:
Pioneer Remote App is an application that allows users to enjoy their favorite music at home on compatible Pioneer & Elite products.
The Pioneer Remote App lets you intuitively operate compatible Pioneer products (control the volume, select the input source and listing mode, etc.), granting more sophisticated and convenient control. Don’t miss out on this opportunity to enjoy innovative AV entertainment.
Main Features
1. Play music in each room or every room
- Lets you play music from music streaming services such as Pandora, Tune in, Spotify, Amazon music, DEEZER and TIDAL, your music library on your smart device, or your NAS drive on compatible products.
- You can play your music via radio, Bluetooth and USB.
2. Lets you intuitively operate remote control functions (control the volume, select the input source and listing mode, etc.), granting more sophisticated and convenient control over Pioneer stereo systems.
3. AV receiver sound quality adjustment feature
You can adjust the equalizer settings, the channel levels of individual speakers, and the bass and treble settings to adjust sound quality to suit your own particular preferences.
4. Operation of connected Pioneer product（home theater product such as AV amplifier）
Let you control a Pioneer Blu-Ray Disc player or TV that is connected to an AV amplifier or home theater product via HDMI.
5. Dirac Live-enabled products measure automatic sound field correction. In addition, filters can be edited.
*By setting the “Network Standby” menu item in the unit’s initial settings to ON, you can use this application to turn on the power of the unit.
Compatible models
Network ready AV receivers/ Network Audio Player/ Hi-Fi/ Mini Component/ Wireless Speaker/ Speaker bar in April 2016 or later
■ Please note
・To use Application it needs to read and agree Terms of Service.
・All models require a firmware update to use Pioneer Remote App.
・The device on which Pioneer Remote App is installed and the FireConnect compatible model must be connected to the same router.
・Available music service depend on regions.
・Why Device's location is needed? Answer: In order to set-up your wireless devices which are located around you, SSID and Access Point info is needed. There is no other purpose to use the information of Device’s Location.

bluejetty:00073223:ios.description:
Sudoku Blast is a simple and enjoyable puzzle experience designed for players who love number logic and clear puzzle solving. With a clean layout, smooth controls, and carefully designed challenges, it offers comfortable gameplay for both beginners and experienced players.
Enjoy a variety of Sudoku puzzles at your own pace. Start with easy levels, build your solving skills, and take on more challenging grids as you progress. Every puzzle follows classic Sudoku rules and focuses on logical thinking and a satisfying solving experience.
Sudoku Features
● Thousands of Sudoku puzzles for different skill levels
● Clean and simple design for comfortable gameplay
● Helpful hints to guide your solving process
● Pencil notes to track possible numbers
● Daily Sudoku challenges with fresh puzzles
● Easy-to-advanced difficulty progression
More Ways to Play
When you're in the mood for something different, explore two additional puzzle games designed to complement your Sudoku experience with different kinds of mental challenges.
● Arrow Master – Challenge your observation skills and directional reasoning with engaging arrow puzzles.
● One Line – Explore spatial reasoning and logical thinking through creative one-line puzzles.
Complete your first Sudoku level to unlock both mini-games, then find them on the home screen whenever you're ready for a change of pace.
Whether you enjoy a quick puzzle break or a more challenging number puzzle, Sudoku remains at the heart of the experience, with a little extra variety whenever you want it.
Start solving today and enjoy Sudoku puzzles at your own pace.
Privacy Policy: https://www.hungrystudio.com/privacyus.html
Terms of Use: https://www.hungrystudio.com/serviceus.html

bluejetty:00161836:ios.name: MyBible
bluejetty:00161836:ios.summary:
MyBible is an application - a platform through which we want to bring the Bible closer to young people and thus make Bible study attractive, being easier to follow.
MyBible's vision is to promote the reading and study of the Bible among yo
bluejetty:00161836:ios.description:
MyBible is an application - a platform through which we want to bring the Bible closer to young people and thus make Bible study attractive, being easier to follow.
MyBible's vision is to promote the reading and study of the Bible among young people by providing them with the useful and quick tools they need. We want to show all young people that the same words, written many years ago, can be just as relevant and relevant today. Now, however, everything is easier to access. Because the Bible deserves all the best, we have prepared a site (www.mybible.ro), but also an application for mobile phones and tablets, through which young people can be closer to the Bible, no matter where they are or what activity.
Read and Listen:
The MyBible site and application give you the opportunity to read more versions of the Bible, both in Romanian and in other languages. Versions can also be read in parallel and studied using the tools provided by MyBible. We also offer you, free of charge, the Audio Bible produced by Radio Vocea Speranței, recited by the radio producer, Ioan Paicu. Each chapter of the Bible is audio-recorded and can be listened to online at www.mybible.ro or downloaded from the MyBible application. Once downloaded, the audio Bible can be accessed offline. Another resource available to you is the Youth Devotional that you receive every day, on your phone or tablet, through this application. MyBible also gives you access to Bible verses on various topics that will help you in your spiritual development. Finally, we offer an Interactive Bible Study Plan, which can be accessed and used both on the site and in the application.
Study:
For an in-depth study of the Bible, we provide a guide to the Adventist Bible Commentary, which can be accessed from each Bible verse. As a user, you can use the note system to gather various ideas from each Bible verse and then sort these ideas into categories to help you understand the Bible. Also, for a systematic study of the Bible, we offer you several materials in pdf format, texts that address topics of interest, especially for young people.
Unload:
Download the free MyBible for iOS app now and install it on your mobile phone or tablet. You will have the same user account both on the site and in the application. You will also have access to your notes, the Bible Study Plan, and your favorite verses.
By downloading the application, you can have full access, even offline, to different versions of the Bible, but also to the Adventist Bible Commentary. In addition, if you download various books from the Audio Bible, you can listen to them offline.

Life and Health Publishing House

Hope TV
Radio Vocea Speranței

apple-macos:6763833379.name: WindTrac: Marine Weather Map
apple-macos:6763833379.description:
WindTrac shows the wind the way it actually moves, and with WindTrac Pro it keeps working when the signal is gone. Download the forecast for where you're heading and the live, animated map of wind, waves and weather goes with you: offshore, into the mountains or onto a plane.
Instead of a grid of arrows or a table of numbers, tens of thousands of particles flow with the forecast wind, speed as colour, direction as motion. The gust front, the light-air hole and the wind bending around a headland are obvious at a glance.
Built for kitesurfers, windsurfers and wing foilers, sailors and boaters, surfers, paraglider pilots and anglers. Anyone who plans the day around the wind and the water.
What makes it different
A forecast that works offline. Most weather apps go blank without a connection. With WindTrac Pro, pick an area and the layers you need, and every forecast hour comes with you, along with the timeline, the animation and the map itself. Keep several areas saved.
Eight forecast models in one app. Switch between NOAA GFS, the NOAA GEFS ensemble mean, DWD ICON and the high-resolution ICON-EU, ECMWF IFS HRES and the ECMWF AIFS AI model, plus two wave models. When the models disagree, you see it straight away.
Numbers where they matter. The strongest gusts, the calmest patches, the biggest waves and the warmest and coldest spots are labelled on the map automatically.
Read the wind
Tap anywhere for the exact speed in knots, km/h, mph or m/s, or switch to gusts to see what you will really be reefing, depowering or scrubbing a launch for. The altitude slider runs from 10 m up through 850, 700, 500 and 250 hPa, from a paraglider launch to the jet stream.
Read the sea
Significant wave height and direction, animated so you can watch a swell roll towards your beach, plus peak and mean wave period to tell a short, choppy wind sea from a long-period groundswell before you load the car. Heights in metres or feet.
Plan the session, the passage or the flight
Drag the timeline to any time in the forecast, or press play and watch a weather system cross the map in seconds. Rain, snow, low cloud and temperature (°C or °F) are a tap away. Save favourite spots and show times in your zone, the spot's or UTC.
Storm Watch
In the US and Canada, official watches and warnings from the National Weather Service and Environment Canada are drawn on the map. Tap one for the full text. Follow hurricanes with the National Hurricane Center's forecast cone, track and 34-knot wind field, which moves with the timeline so you can see when tropical-storm-force wind could arrive. All of it can be switched off.
Free and Pro
The live map, every layer and model, labels, playback, Storm Watch, five saved spots and the next 24 hours of forecast are free, with no ads and no account. WindTrac Pro is an optional subscription that adds offline maps, the full multi-day forecast and unlimited saved spots.
Privacy Policy: https://windtrac.app/privacy
WindTrac is a planning aid, not a substitute for official forecasts and warnings. It is an independent app, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by NOAA, the US National Weather Service, the National Hurricane Center, Environment Canada, ECMWF, DWD, or any other agency whose public data it displays.

apple-macos:6820558776.name: FortyNote
apple-macos:6820558776.description:
FortyNote is a notes app that opens from your phone, not from the network.
Your notes are encrypted on your phone before they are uploaded. We store ciphertext.
WRITE ANYTHING
Headings, lists, checkboxes and tasks, tables, callouts, toggles, code, links, photos, sketches, diagrams, scans, files and voice notes. Colour, highlight, fonts and alignment. Shortcuts as you type, and undo and redo on the keyboard bar.
FIND IT LATER
Tap search and type any word you remember. Matches appear as you type, across every note's title and body.
You rarely remember the title. You remember a word that was in it - tokyo, boiler, cabinets. That is enough.
Words in photos and scans are read on your iPhone, so search finds them too.
WORKS WITHOUT A SIGNAL
Sign in once. Every launch after that reads your notes from the phone and syncs quietly behind you. Write on a plane or on the subway; it catches up when you reconnect.
TASKS AND REMINDERS
Add a task anywhere in a note, give it a due date, flag it. The Tasks screen gathers every task into Overdue, Today, Upcoming, No due date and Completed. Reminders arrive even with the app closed. A calendar shows what is due.
ORGANISE
Notebooks and stacks, tags, pinned notes, shortcuts, saved searches, filters, and a library of templates. Note history lets you put back an earlier version.
TEAMS
Share notebooks with the people on your team. Invite by email, set who manages what, and leave any time.
AI, WHEN YOU ASK FOR IT
Summarise, improve the writing, translate, or ask questions of your notes. Nothing is sent until you agree, and you can turn it off. Or use your own AI key.
YOUR DATA, YOURS TO MOVE
Back up and restore, import from Google Keep and other apps, export as Markdown or web pages, print or save as PDF.
THE SAME NOTES EVERYWHERE
FortyNote runs on the web and on Windows. The same notes, the same notebooks, the same settings.
